2021-02-01.kline: Price rallied from a low near the early-window dip to a sharp peak around the middle-right of the window, then fell back over several red candles to near the lower part of the range. The peak gave back essentially the whole rise, and the latest green candle closes in the lower-middle part of the range, below the halfway point, forming an inverted-V shape.
2021-02-01.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars cluster in the early and middle part of the window, while the recent bars are visibly shorter. The volume spike sits near the rally peak, and the red down days in the decline carry smaller volume than the earlier moves.
2021-02-01.combined: The rally on heavier volume followed by a decline on lighter volume suggests the selling pressure after the peak is not very forceful and the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Price is in the lower half of the range while volume fades, so the top is tentative rather than fully confirmed.

2021-02-02.kline: Price swings choppily within a broad range without a clear trend: early lows sit near the bottom of the window, the highest wicks cluster in the middle-to-late part, and the latest green candle closes around the upper-middle of the range, not near the window high. No breakout or breakdown from the earlier range is visible, and no clean reversal shape stands out.
2021-02-02.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. A few red days show taller bars earlier in the window, but the most recent days are about as active as the earlier ones, and up and down days carry similar volume.
2021-02-02.combined: Sideways price action with flat volume gives no strong evidence of direction, so the window reads as consolidation. A breakout would need a close above the window highs on clearly rising volume, which is not present here.

2021-02-03.kline: Price swings back and forth between a high near the top of the window and lows in the lower-middle area, with a brief rally mid-window that gives back much of its gain, so there is no clear direction. The latest red candle closes around the middle of the range, not near the highs or lows.
2021-02-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the earliest bars are the tallest, and the most recent days show visibly smaller bars. Up and down days both show modest volume, with no single day standing out at the end.
2021-02-03.combined: Choppy price action on fading volume suggests a lack of conviction from buyers and sellers, which fits a consolidation. A decisive move on a volume increase would be needed to confirm a breakout or breakdown.

2021-02-04.kline: Price swings choppily within a wide, sideways range with no clear direction: a sharp drop to near the window low around the middle of the window, a spike to near the window high mid-to-late in the window, and a modest recovery into the final few days. The latest green close sits in the upper-middle part of the range, not at the high, so it does not mark a clean breakout or uptrend.
2021-02-04.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no single day standing out sharply; the tallest bars are early in the window and the most recent days trade at similar levels to earlier ones. Up (green) and down (red) days carry comparable volume, so volume shows no strong surge on the late rally.
2021-02-04.combined: Flat volume alongside sideways, choppy price action suggests no strong conviction from either buyers or sellers, so the consolidation reading is not confirmed by any volume expansion.

2021-02-05.kline: The price path falls from a high near the top of the window to a low near the bottom around the middle-late bars, then rises over the final several sessions. The rebound recovers most of the decline, and the latest red candle closes in the upper half of the range, though below the earlier highs. The low forms a V-shaped bottom.
2021-02-05.volume: Volume contracts over the window, with an early green spike near the start and taller red bars during the sell-off. The most recent bars are clearly lower than the earlier volume, and the latest red day is one of the smallest. The shrinking volume means the rebound is happening on lighter participation.
2021-02-05.combined: Price is recovering on falling volume, which suggests the rebound lacks conviction and the bottom reversal is not yet confirmed. A rise on lighter volume is weaker than one backed by heavy buying, so the recovery needs higher volume to validate it.

2021-02-08.kline: After a sharp drop to the lower part of the window, price recovered through a series of green days with a red pullback in the middle, then the final day is a strong green candle that closes near the top of the 20-day range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window. The latest close sits at or near the window high, so price leaves the prior range upward.
2021-02-08.volume: Volume is flat, staying roughly at the same level across the window, with no clear surge. The tallest bars are early on and the most recent green day is above the average level but not dramatically larger than earlier bars, and red down days show similar volume to green up days.
2021-02-08.combined: The breakout price move is not backed by a volume surge, so the upside break is less convincing than it would be on rising volume. Traders would want to see follow-through on higher volume in the next few sessions to confirm the breakout.

2021-02-09.kline: Price starts the window with choppy red and green candles near the middle-to-lower range, bottoms around the 8th bar, then rises in steps through the back half. A large green candle near the end carries price to the window high, and the latest small red candle closes in the upper part of the range just below that high, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-02-09.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop, though the tallest bar sits on the large green up day near the end. The latest day is a red session on moderate, not elevated, volume.
2021-02-09.combined: Rising prices on roughly flat volume give only modest confirmation of the uptrend, since the advance is not backed by a clear expansion in participation. The strong green day with the largest volume supports the recent push higher.

2021-02-10.kline: Price spent the first part of the window moving sideways to lower, then climbed, with a prior swing high in the middle of the window. In the last 3 days, large green candles carried the close above those earlier highs, so the latest close sits at or near the top of the 20-day range.
2021-02-10.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained increase. The most recent green days show a couple of taller bars, but they are not clearly larger than the earlier bars, and red down days are not noticeably heavier.
2021-02-10.combined: The price break above the earlier highs is not backed by a clear volume surge, so the breakout is less convincing than it would be on heavy volume. Traders would likely want to see volume rise on follow-through days to confirm it.

2021-02-11.kline: Price spent the early and middle part of the window choppy and mostly sideways to lower, with several red and green candles between roughly the lower third and middle of the range. Over the last 7 to 8 sessions it climbed steeply, and the final two green candles close at or near the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier range, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2021-02-11.volume: Volume was low to moderate early in the window, with a few heavier red days in the middle. It expanded over the final sessions, with the last three to four bars the tallest in the window, and those high-volume bars are all green, matching the up days.
2021-02-11.combined: Rising price on rising volume, with the largest volume landing on the up days that take price above the prior range, confirms the breakout.

2021-02-12.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, dips with several small red and green candles, then climbs in a steady rise with a large green candle near the top. The window high is at the right side, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below that high, so the pattern is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-02-12.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the most recent days clearly higher than the early days. The tallest volume bars cluster in the last several sessions, and the latest bar, a red down day, is still well above the early-window levels.
2021-02-12.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, with heavy trading on the advance. The latest red day on high volume hints at some selling near the highs, so the trend is strong but short-term profit-taking is visible.

2021-02-16.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window, dips into a small base of red and green candles in the lower-middle area, then climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows to the top right. The latest close, a green candle, sits near the window high in the upper part of the range, with no clear close above a prior range that would qualify as a breakout.
2021-02-16.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, mid-window bars are lower, and the last several days show the tallest bars in the chart. Large green up-day bars cluster on the recent rally, with red down-day bars mixed in but generally smaller than the advancing volume.
2021-02-16.combined: Rising prices on rising volume suggest the uptrend has strong participation and is being driven by buyers. The pattern is still a trend rather than a confirmed breakout, so the next key check is whether price holds the recent highs on continued heavy volume.

2021-02-17.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from a low area about a third of the way up the range near the middle-left to a cluster of highs at the right edge. Pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles in the middle, are small relative to the overall climb, and the latest red candle sits near the top of the range, close to the window high.
2021-02-17.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest bars appearing in the last several sessions, including a large green up day and a tall red day near the right edge. Earlier bars are shorter and more mixed, so the recent days stand out as the heaviest trading.
2021-02-17.combined: Rising prices on rising volume support the uptrend, showing buyers are active as the stock makes new highs. The most recent red day on heavy volume is a mild caution that sellers are present near the top, but it does not change the overall rising pattern.

2021-02-18.kline: Price starts near the upper-middle of the window, dips to a low about a quarter of the way up the range around the middle-left bars, then climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows with a strong green run into the window high near the right side. A small pullback of red candles follows the high, and the latest green close sits in the upper part of the range, roughly three-quarters of the way up.
2021-02-18.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge or fade, matching the flat state. The tallest volume bars come on several green up days in the rally and on a red day near the top, while the quiet bars cluster in the early and middle-left part of the window.
2021-02-18.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by participation. The lack of a volume expansion on the latest up move means the trend has no clear extra conviction behind it.

2021-02-19.kline: Price starts in the upper-middle of the range, drops to a low near the window's lower end around the sixth to eighth candles, then rises through the rest of the window to a high near the top in the later candles. The latest candles pull back a little from that high but still sit in the upper part of the range, so the window is an uptrend with pullbacks inside the rise.
2021-02-19.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. Several bars in the middle and late window rise to the highest levels, including a tall green bar in the middle-right, while the most recent bars stay at moderate levels similar to earlier days.
2021-02-19.combined: Rising prices with volume that stays at a similar level do not show a strong new buying push, so the uptrend is intact but lacks volume confirmation of acceleration. The recent pullback on ordinary volume looks like a normal pause within the rise rather than a sign of reversal.

2021-02-22.kline: Price rallies from near the window low on the left to a high near the top of the range, with the strongest advance in the middle-right of the window. The last several days pull back on small red and green candles, and the latest day is a long red candle that leaves the close about 60% of the way up the range, still above the midpoint, so this reads as an uptrend with a pullback rather than a reversal.
2021-02-22.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state. The tallest bars cluster around the strongest green rally days in the middle and right, while the most recent bars are moderate, with the final red day not standing out.
2021-02-22.combined: Price rose over most of the window on volume that was heavier during the advance, but the recent pullback has not drawn unusual volume. Steady volume with a higher close above the midpoint supports the uptrend without confirming a breakout.

2021-02-23.kline: Price rose from the lower left of the window through several green candles to a peak near the top of the range around the 15th-16th bars, then fell over the following four or so days with red candles and a large red drop near the right. The last two bars show a small green bounce, and the latest close sits near the middle of the range, roughly half the rise given back, forming an inverted-V style top.
2021-02-23.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent days are about as large as earlier bars, with no clear surge or drying up. The tallest bars occur mid-window on green up days, while several red down days in the later part of the window carry similar-sized volume.
2021-02-23.combined: The rally came on heavy green volume, but the decline did not show a clear volume expansion, so the top looks like a gradual loss of momentum rather than a high-volume capitulation. The flat volume means the reversal signal is only moderately confirmed.

2021-02-24.kline: After a strong rally to near the window high, price fell over several red days to the window low, then rebounded over the last two green candles to about two-thirds of the way up the range, so the latest close sits in the upper half. The rebound recovers most of the prior decline, but the shape is a sharp fall followed by a partial recovery rather than a clean, deep V.
2021-02-24.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained rise or fall. The tallest volume bars come mid-window, on green rally days and on red decline days, while the most recent bars are moderate and close to earlier levels.
2021-02-24.combined: The rebound off the window low is not backed by a volume surge, so the recovery looks tentative. Price and volume together do not strongly confirm a durable bottom yet.

2021-02-25.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to a peak near the window high around the middle-to-late bars, forming a rounded inverted V. The last several days are mostly red and give back most of the rise, and the latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, in the lower half.
2021-02-25.volume: Volume is low and mixed early in the window, then builds toward the end, with the rightmost bar as the tallest volume bar of the window, a clear spike. That spike falls on a red down day, and the late-window red bars carry heavier volume than the earlier green days.
2021-02-25.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp down day confirms the reversal: sellers are pushing price lower with conviction after the rally stalled, which supports the inverted-V top rather than a small pullback.

2021-02-26.kline: Price climbed from the lower left in a multi-day rise to a peak near the top of the window around the middle-right bars, then fell over several red days, giving back most of the advance. The latest red close sits in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted-V shaped top.
2021-02-26.volume: Volume was moderate through the rise and became heavier as price turned down, with a sharp spike on the final day, far above the window's normal level. The largest bars are red, so the heaviest trading came on down days.
2021-02-26.combined: Heavy volume on the latest down day alongside a fall through the lower half of the range suggests selling pressure is confirming the top reversal.

2021-03-01.kline: Price climbs over the first ~12 days, mostly on green candles, to a peak near the top of the window, forming a rounded inverted-V top. It then falls over about six days, with a long red candle near the window low, giving back nearly the entire rise. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range after only a small bounce.
2021-03-01.volume: Volume is low to moderate through the early rise, then builds into the decline. A clear spike appears on a red down day about two to three sessions from the end, far above the window's normal level, and volume falls off on the final red day.
2021-03-01.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp down day alongside the fall from the peak supports a reversal top, since selling pressure dominated after the rally. The lower volume on the latest bars suggests the decline is losing momentum, so confirmation would need price to hold below the prior swing.

2021-03-02.kline: Price climbs for about nine days from the left-side lows to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over the last seven or so days and gives back nearly all of the rally. The latest close sits near the bottom of the range, forming an inverted-V shape that is a reversal top.
2021-03-02.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, while the most recent down days show the tallest bars, with one red spike near the right edge standing well above everything before it. Up days earlier in the window carry smaller volume than the late red sessions.
2021-03-02.combined: Heavy volume on the falling red days after the peak suggests real selling pressure rather than a quiet pullback, which supports the reversal-top reading. The rally's high-volume peak has given way to a sharp decline, so the top looks confirmed.

2021-03-03.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the middle-right, then falls over several days in an inverted-V shape, giving back most of the advance. The latest candle is a long red bar closing near the window low, so the close sits in the lower part of the range.
2021-03-03.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, and volume climbs into the later sessions. The tallest bar is a red down day near the late decline, and the most recent bars stay elevated, consistent with expanding volume.
2021-03-03.combined: Heavier volume on the falling red days alongside the price drop from the peak suggests selling pressure is confirming the top reversal.

2021-03-04.kline: Price rose from the left side of the window to a peak in the middle-to-right area, then fell over the following several days, giving back most of the rise. The latest close sits near the window low in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted V shape.
2021-03-04.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained rise or fall as the price declines. A few red down days, most notably one tall bar near the right side and the most recent bar, stand out as spikes, but they do not form a clear trend in volume.
2021-03-04.combined: The price fall on flat volume suggests the reversal from the peak lacks strong volume confirmation, so the inverted V top is not backed by a surge of selling. Still, the price giving back most of the rise and closing near the lows indicates the bullish move has faded.

2021-03-05.kline: Price rallied over the first half of the window, with green candles lifting it to a peak near the window high around the middle-left, then fell through a series of red candles that gave back most of the rise. The latest close is a red candle in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, forming an inverted V shape.
2021-03-05.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop, so the recent days look about the same as the earlier ones. The tallest bar is a red down day in the right half, and the most recent red bars are similar in height to earlier bars.
2021-03-05.combined: Price rolling over from the peak with red down days while volume stays flat does not show a strong selling surge, so the reversal is suggested but not strongly confirmed by volume. A volume expansion on further down days would strengthen the top call.

2021-03-08.kline: The window starts with a short rise to a rounded peak near the top of the range around the 7th to 8th candles, then falls for most of the remaining days with small bounces, so the latest red close sits near the bottom of the window range. The early rise is too brief to offset the longer decline.
2021-03-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall relative to earlier days. One tall red bar stands out near the middle of the window, and the most recent red bars are not much larger than earlier ones.
2021-03-08.combined: Falling prices on roughly steady volume show a persistent sell-off without a clear surge in selling pressure or a capitulation spike. The lack of a volume change means the downtrend is not confirmed by strong new participation.

2021-03-09.kline: Price rallies from the left edge to a peak in the first third of the window (around bars 3-5), then falls over most of the window with only small green bounces, forming a lower-high, lower-low sequence. The latest candle is a small green bounce near the bottom of the 20-day range, well below the window high.
2021-03-09.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest red bar (a large down day) in the middle-right and several tall bars over the last five days, well above the quieter early bars. Most of the high-volume days are red down days, while the most recent green day carries noticeably higher volume than the early window.
2021-03-09.combined: Heavy volume on falling days alongside a steady price decline confirms persistent selling pressure and supports the downtrend. The latest green bounce on only moderately higher volume looks like a weak relief rally rather than a reversal.

2021-03-10.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the window high at the left to near the window low at the right, with a few small bounces (green candles) along the way. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the bottom, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-03-10.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are mostly modest, while the largest spike occurs in the middle-to-late window and the most recent several days stay elevated. Most of the high-volume bars are red down days, with a few green up days mixed in.
2021-03-10.combined: Falling prices on rising volume suggest the selling pressure is building and the downtrend is gaining conviction rather than fading.

2021-03-11.kline: The 20 candles fall from a high near the top of the window to a low near the bottom, with several small green bounces along the way. The window high is at the start, and the lowest lows come around the middle-to-late bars. The latest close is a small green candle in the lower part of the range, well below the window high and not closing below prior lows, so it is a downtrend rather than a breakdown.
2021-03-11.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, which matches the flat state. The main standout is one tall red bar around the middle of the window on a down day, while the recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones and do not show a clear increase or drop.
2021-03-11.combined: Price keeps falling on volume that is not expanding, so the selling shows no sign of exhaustion or capitulation. The recent green bounces come on ordinary volume, so they do not confirm a reversal and the downtrend still stands.

2021-03-12.kline: Price starts near the top of the 20-day range and falls across most of the window, with small bounces along the way. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range after a sharp late drop to near the window low, followed by a small green rebound over the last few days. This is a downtrend, not a reversal, since the rebound is small and the latest close remains low.
2021-03-12.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, so the recent days are not noticeably heavier or lighter than earlier ones. The tallest bar is a red down day early in the window, and several mid-to-late red down days carry above-average volume, while the final green bars are moderate.
2021-03-12.combined: The falling price with mostly even volume shows steady selling without a clear surge of conviction. The recent green bounce on similar volume is weak support and does not yet signal a reversal of the downtrend.

2021-03-15.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, stepping down from near the window high at the left to near the window low around the middle-right, with a brief green bounce partway through. The last few sessions recover part of the drop, but the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high, so this is a downtrend with a bounce rather than a reversal.
2021-03-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, as the measured state indicates, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bar is a red down day near the middle of the window, and the most recent green up days show volume at or slightly below the earlier levels.
2021-03-15.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest the downtrend is continuing without strong selling climax or accumulation. The recent green bounce lacks volume conviction, so it does not signal a reversal yet.

2021-03-16.kline: Price falls from a high near the top of the window at the left to a low near the bottom around the middle-right, with several small green bounces along the way. A partial rebound over the last several days lifts the latest red close to roughly 40% up the range, so it stays in the lower half of the window range.
2021-03-16.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest spike is a tall red day in the first half of the window, while the most recent days show smaller bars, mostly green with a moderate red bar on the last day, clearly below the earlier volume levels.
2021-03-16.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume suggest the selling pressure is fading, but the rebound has not recovered enough to signal a reversal, so the downtrend pattern holds.

2021-03-17.kline: Price fell steeply for most of the window, from near the top of the range to a low near the bottom around the middle-to-late part of the window, forming a V-shaped bottom. Over the last several sessions it rallied on mostly green candles and recovered roughly half or more of the decline, with the latest close in the upper half of the range but below the window high.
2021-03-17.volume: Volume is contracting: it spiked on the early large red selloff day and stayed elevated through the decline, then fell to lower bars on the recent green rally days, with the latest days among the lowest volume of the window.
2021-03-17.combined: The rally off the low is occurring on shrinking volume, which suggests weak buying conviction and makes the V-bottom reversal less confirmed. Price recovery alone does not yet show strong accumulation, so follow-through would need volume to pick up.

2021-03-18.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a series of red candles and a steep drop to a low near the bottom around the middle-late portion of the window. A partial rebound with green candles lifts price to roughly the upper-middle of the range, but it recovers less than half of the fall. The latest candle is red and closes in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2021-03-18.volume: Volume is contracting: the chart shows a tall red spike early in the window, followed by mostly lower bars through the rebound and the most recent days. The recent bars are small, with green and red days alternating and no volume surge on the latest down day.
2021-03-18.combined: Falling price with shrinking volume suggests selling pressure is easing, but the rebound lacks volume and is too small to confirm a reversal. The window still reads as a downtrend with a weak bounce, not a confirmed bottom.

2021-03-19.kline: The price path falls from a high near the top of the window to a low near the bottom around the two-thirds mark, with a sharp drop and several lower highs. A partial bounce of roughly 40-50% of the fall follows, but the latest green close sits in the lower part of the range, so the window reads as a downtrend with a bounce rather than a bottom reversal.
2021-03-19.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bar is early on, and volume trends lower with smaller bars in the final week, consistent with the contracting volume state. The recent up days (green) and down days (red) both show modest volume, with no standout surge on the latest sessions.
2021-03-19.combined: Falling prices on contracting volume suggest the decline is losing momentum and selling pressure is fading, but the lack of volume on the recent bounce means it does not yet show a confirmed reversal. The downtrend stays intact until price reclaims the mid-range on expanding volume.

2021-03-22.kline: Price fell steeply from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late part of the window, then rallied in a V-shaped recovery over the last several sessions. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly 55-60% of the way up from the window low, so the rebound recovered more than half of the decline.
2021-03-22.volume: Volume was heaviest during the sharp decline, with several tall red bars, and then faded. Recent sessions show visibly smaller bars, so volume is clearly contracting into the rebound, with the latest days well below the earlier peak.
2021-03-22.combined: The rebound is occurring on shrinking volume, which suggests limited conviction behind the recovery and makes the reversal less than fully confirmed. Buyers are lifting price without the heavy participation seen during the sell-off.

2021-03-23.kline: Price fell steeply from the top of the window to a low near the bottom about two-thirds of the way across, forming a V-shaped bottom. Price then rebounded over several sessions, recovering roughly half of the decline, and the latest red candle closes near the middle of the range, just above it.
2021-03-23.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the heavy red volume bars in the early-to-middle selloff give way to smaller bars in the rebound, and the most recent sessions are clearly lower than the earlier peak volume, with green and red bars mixed.
2021-03-23.combined: The recovery is occurring on falling volume, which suggests limited buying conviction behind the bounce and leaves the reversal unconfirmed. The latest close sits only around the middle of the range, so the V-shaped recovery needs stronger volume and a close higher in the range to be confirmed.

2021-03-24.kline: Price opens the window near the upper range, then falls steeply for several days to a low near the window's bottom around the 10th day. It then rebounds over the remaining days, recovering roughly 55-60% of the decline, and the latest red close sits in the upper half of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2021-03-24.volume: Volume is contracting, with the heaviest red selling bars early in the window during the steep decline. Volume falls off as the decline ends, and the rebound days show mostly lighter volume with the most recent bars clearly lower than the early-window peaks.
2021-03-24.combined: The sharp, high-volume selloff followed by a rebound on lighter volume suggests selling pressure is fading, which supports a V-shaped reversal. The rebound lacks strong volume confirmation, so the recovery should be treated as tentative.

2021-03-25.kline: The window opens near the top of the range and falls sharply over about the first eight days, with long red candles driving it to the window low near the right-center. A partial bounce of several green and red candles then lifts price to roughly the middle-upper part of the range, but it stalls well below the early highs. The latest close sits in the lower-middle part of the range, so the decline dominates and the bounce is not a reversal.
2021-03-25.volume: Volume contracts across the window: the largest bars come from the heavy red selling days early on, and the bars grow shorter toward the right. The most recent sessions trade at clearly lower volume than the early selloff, with a mix of green and red bars.
2021-03-25.combined: Heavy volume on the early down days confirms the selling pressure, and the lighter volume on the recent bounce and latest session suggests weaker participation behind the rebound. This supports a downtrend that is losing momentum rather than a confirmed reversal.

2021-03-26.kline: The window opens near the high with a steep run of red candles that drops to a low near the window's bottom around the seventh day, forming a V-shaped fall. Price then rebounds over several green-heavy days to roughly the upper-middle of the range, and the latest green candle closes in the upper half, recovering most of the earlier decline.
2021-03-26.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the largest bars come from the early red selloff days, but the recent green days sit at about the same height as the earlier bars, so there is no clear volume surge or drop-off.

2021-07-15.kline: Price climbs in a steep, stair-stepped rise from the lower part of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-late bars, then rolls over into a sharp multi-day decline that gives back roughly two-thirds of the advance. The latest candle is a long red body closing near the bottom quarter of the range, so the shape reads as an inverted V or rounded top.
2021-07-15.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bars come early, including the tall red and green spikes on the left, while the middle and later bars are noticeably smaller. The final red day shows a modest pickup relative to the few sessions before it but remains well below the early peaks.
2021-07-15.combined: The advance came on heavy early volume, and the subsequent decline on lighter volume suggests selling pressure is not strongly confirmed by participation. This is consistent with a fading top, but the lack of heavy volume on the drop leaves the reversal less convincing.

2021-07-16.kline: Price climbs through the first two-thirds of the window with mostly green candles, peaks near the top of the range in the middle-right, then falls over several sessions with large red candles that give back most of the rally. The latest candle is a small green bar sitting near the bottom of the range, so the close is in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted V.
2021-07-16.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay within a similar band across the window, with the tallest bar on the far left and no sustained surge on the decline or the final bounce. The red down days on the fall do not carry noticeably heavier volume than the green up days earlier.
2021-07-16.combined: The price fall came on volume no heavier than the rally, so the top lacks volume confirmation and the reversal is only moderately supported. Traders would want a close below the recent swing lows on rising volume before treating the inverted V as confirmed.

2021-07-19.kline: Price climbs for several days from the lower part of the window to a peak near the upper end of the range, then falls over several sessions and gives back most of the rally, forming an inverted V (rounded top). The latest green candle sits near the bottom of the range, in the lower half.
2021-07-19.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The last few bars are somewhat taller, matching the sharp red sell-off days and the final green bounce, but they do not stand out enough to change the flat reading.
2021-07-19.combined: The rise and fall in price come with roughly flat volume, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume, though the sell-off still gave back most of the gain and leaves the latest close in the lower half.

2021-07-20.kline: Price rises for about 12 days from the window low to a peak near the window high, then falls for about 6 days, giving back most of the rise in a rounded inverted-V top. The latest close sits in the lower quarter of the range, well below the peak.
2021-07-20.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the tallest bars coming in the sell-off days near the end, mostly red down days. Early green up days carry lighter volume, and the final bar is elevated but below the peak.
2021-07-20.combined: Heavy volume on the declining red candles confirms the selling pressure behind the top, so the rise has reversed downward with conviction.

2021-07-21.kline: The window rises from the lower-middle range to a peak near the window high around the 10th to 11th candles, then falls sharply through several large red candles to the window low near the 17th candle. The last three candles are green and recover roughly half of that decline, leaving the latest close about 55% up the range, in the upper half. This is a V-shaped bottom after a rounded top.
2021-07-21.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: early bars are moderate, mid-window bars are mixed, and the tallest bars appear during the sharp selloff (red) and in the rebound days near the end (green). The most recent day is a green bar of moderate height, lower than the spike just before it, so volume is high but not peaking on the last day.
2021-07-21.combined: Heavy volume on the steep decline followed by higher-volume green rebound days suggests selling pressure is exhausting and buyers are stepping in, which supports a V-shaped bottom. Confirmation is still limited because the rebound covers only three days and the latest volume is below the recent spike.

2021-07-22.kline: Price rallied for about seven to eight days in a series of green candles, peaking near the upper part of the window, then fell over roughly eight days, giving back most of the rise with a head-and-shoulders-like inverted V shape. The latest candles sit in the lower half of the range, near the window low, after only a small bounce.
2021-07-22.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the earliest bars moderate and the bars from the middle onward noticeably taller. The tallest bars come from the red down-days of the sell-off, and one tall green bar near the peak stands out, so heavy volume accompanies the decline.
2021-07-22.combined: Rising price on moderate volume during the rally gave way to a falling price on heavier volume during the sell-off, which supports a top reversal and suggests selling pressure has taken control.

2021-07-23.kline: The window rises from a low near the left side to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-right, then falls sharply to the lowest lows near the bottom about two-thirds of the way across, forming a V-shaped bottom. Price then recovers over the last few days, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly 55-60% of the way up.
2021-07-23.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars occur in the middle of the window during the early selloff, while the most recent days show moderate, similar-sized bars, so volume does not expand as the price recovers.
2021-07-23.combined: The fall followed by a partial recovery that regains more than half the decline suggests a bottoming reversal, but flat volume during the rebound means it lacks strong conviction. Confirmation would need rising volume on the up days.

2021-07-26.kline: Price rises from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high around the middle-right of the early section, forming a rounded top, then falls through the middle and drops to near the window low before a small bounce. The latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, well below the peak, giving back most of the rise.
2021-07-26.volume: Volume contracts over the window, consistent with the measured state: the heaviest bars cluster on the large red selling days in the middle and the tall green day near the peak, while the final several bars are visibly smaller, with the last two red days showing the lowest volume.
2021-07-26.combined: The fall on shrinking volume suggests selling pressure is fading rather than accelerating, so the top is plausible but not strongly confirmed. A reversal would be more convincing if the decline were met by heavier volume or if the later bounce attracted rising volume.

2021-07-27.kline: Price rose over the first half of the window, peaking near the top of the range around the eighth day, then fell over several days to lows near the bottom, giving back most of the rise. The window ends with a partial bounce, and the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, forming an inverted-V shape.
2021-07-27.volume: Volume is contracting: the earlier window has larger bars, including a tall green spike and several tall red bars during the sell-off, while the final several days show clearly smaller bars. Recent down days carry less volume than the heavier selling earlier.
2021-07-27.combined: The rise-then-fall shape with the latest close in the lower half points to a top, and the fading volume on the recent bounce suggests weak buying interest and little conviction behind the partial recovery. This supports the reversal reading, though it is not confirmed until price breaks lower.

2021-07-28.kline: After a sharp multi-day slide from near the window high down to the window low, price rebounds over about six days, recovering a bit more than half of the drop, forming a V-shaped bottom. The latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, roughly mid-to-upper range.
2021-07-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars cluster in the middle of the window during the selloff and the sharp rebound, while the last several bars are noticeably shorter. The final days show modest volume on mostly red bars and a smaller green bar at the end.
2021-07-28.combined: The recovery from the low is happening on shrinking volume, so the rebound lacks strong participation and is less convincing as a confirmed reversal. Price has regained more than half of the decline, which supports the bottom pattern, but the fading volume suggests the upside may stall without a volume pickup.

2021-07-29.kline: The window opens near the top of the range, then falls steeply for several days to a low near the window bottom, forming a V-shaped bottom around the middle of the window. A rebound of several days follows, recovering roughly half of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range.
2021-07-29.volume: Volume contracts over the window, consistent with the contracting state. The heaviest volume comes on the sharp selloff and the bottom area, with a tall green spike during the early rebound, while the most recent days show much smaller bars, including the latest up days.
2021-07-29.combined: The rebound is supported by strong volume only at the bottom and early recovery, and the latest rally days are on lighter volume, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed. Traders would want volume to expand on up days to validate the bottom.

2021-07-30.kline: Price falls steeply from near the window high through a V-shaped low about two-thirds of the way through the window, then rises over the final several days. The recovery has regained roughly half of the decline, and the latest close sits near the middle of the range, slightly above it.
2021-07-30.volume: Volume is contracting: the heaviest bars cluster during the sell-off and at the low, including a tall green spike, then bars shrink steadily to the smallest levels on the most recent days. The recent up days carry noticeably lighter volume than the earlier down days.
2021-07-30.combined: The rebound is occurring on falling volume, so the recovery lacks conviction and does not yet confirm a durable bottom. A strong move above the prior swing high on expanding volume would be needed to validate the reversal.

2021-08-02.kline: Price opens the window near the upper range, then drops steeply over several days to a low near the middle-to-late part of the fall, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then rises over roughly the last 8-9 days, recovering about two-thirds of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range but below the window high.
2021-08-02.volume: Volume is contracting: the heavy-volume selloff days and the big green spike near the low were followed by progressively smaller bars, and the most recent days are clearly lower than the earlier part of the window. Volume is largest on the steep down days and at the bottom, while the recovery days show modest bars.
2021-08-02.combined: The rebound is occurring on shrinking volume, so the V-shaped recovery lacks strong volume confirmation and may be less convincing as a durable reversal. The fall had heavier participation than the recovery, so buyers have not yet matched the earlier selling pressure.

2021-08-03.kline: Price opens near the top of the window, slides in small steps, then drops sharply into a V-shaped low about three-quarters of the way through the window, where large red candles and a big green candle mark the trough. The rebound runs for several days, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, roughly 60% of the way back from the window low toward the high, so the shape reads as a V-shaped double-bottom-style recovery.
2021-08-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early and mid-window bars are tall, with the largest spike on the green bar at the low, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter and steady, and the final bar is only modestly higher than the one before it. The up days during the recovery are not carrying larger volume than the earlier selling.
2021-08-03.combined: The recovery from the low is real on price, but rising prices on shrinking volume suggest the bounce is not strongly supported, so the reversal is tentative until volume picks up on up days.

2021-08-04.kline: The window starts mid-range, then falls sharply for several days to a low near the window bottom, roughly two-thirds of the way through, forming a V-shaped bottom. Price then rises for most of the remaining days and recovers most of the drop, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range near the window high.
2021-08-04.volume: Volume is contracting: the heavy-volume bars are concentrated in the early selloff and around the bottom spike, while the most recent days show clearly lower volume bars, including several modest-volume green up days at the right edge.
2021-08-04.combined: The price recovery is occurring on shrinking volume, which weakens confirmation of the V-bottom reversal. The rebound would need stronger volume on up days to be convincing.

2021-08-05.kline: After an early decline that bottomed near the lower part of the window around the 11th candle, price rallied steadily on mostly green candles, and the latest close sits at the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part of the range. This is a V-shaped recovery that closes above the prior range upward.
2021-08-05.volume: Volume is contracting: the large spike on the heavy red selling days in the middle of the decline has faded to much smaller bars. The most recent green up days are noticeably lower than the earlier volume, with the final bars roughly flat and low.
2021-08-05.combined: Price breaking above the earlier range while volume keeps shrinking means the breakout lacks volume confirmation, so it is weaker and needs follow-through on higher volume to be trusted.

2021-08-06.kline: The window opens near the upper part of the range, then falls steeply for about eight days to a low near the window bottom, forming a V-shaped bottom. The following rise lasts about twelve days, recovering almost all of the fall, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range close to the window high.
2021-08-06.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the large red selling days and the tallest green spike come in the early and middle part, while the recent bars are clearly smaller. The last several sessions show modest green up-day volume with a smaller red bar at the end.
2021-08-06.combined: The V-shaped recovery on declining volume suggests the selling pressure has faded, but the lighter volume on the rebound means the reversal is not strongly confirmed yet. Rising prices on quieter volume point to a cautious bottoming rather than a decisive new uptrend.

2021-08-09.kline: Price falls sharply for about the first 8 bars, from near the window high to a low around the middle-left, then rallies for the rest of the window in a V-shaped recovery. The latest close sits near the top of the range, close to the window high, so the decline is almost fully recovered.
2021-08-09.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bars come early, on the heavy red selloff days and a tall green bar at the low, while the recent bars are visibly smaller. Green up days mid-rally carry moderate volume, and the last few red days show the lowest volume of the window.
2021-08-09.combined: The V-shaped recovery is backed by heavy volume at the selloff low, but the rally itself is on fading volume, so the recovery lacks strong confirmation. The shrinking volume into the latest close suggests the upward move is losing momentum.

2021-08-10.kline: After an early sharp drop to a low near the middle-left of the window, price rallied across most of the 20 days with a stair-step of higher highs and higher lows, reaching the window high near the right edge. The last few days show a mild pullback of red candles from that high, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, about two-thirds of the way up, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout or reversal.
2021-08-10.volume: Volume is contracting: the tall volume bars from the early selloff and the strong green day in the first half give way to noticeably smaller bars over the recent days. The most recent red down days are among the lowest-volume bars in the window, and the green up days in the rally were mostly on moderate volume.
2021-08-10.combined: Price is still making higher highs in an uptrend, but volume is shrinking as the price pulls back, which suggests the rally is losing momentum and the pullback is light-volume rather than distribution. The pattern stays an uptrend, but the fading participation is a caution that the trend may stall if buyers do not return.

2021-08-11.kline: Price fell sharply from the top of the window to a low near the bottom in the first few days, then rallied steadily for about 12 days to a window high near the far right. The last four days are red and pull back about half or more of that rise, leaving the latest close in the lower-middle part of the range, so the shape is a rounded top after a V-shaped bottom.
2021-08-11.volume: Volume is highest in the first few bars and then trends lower, with the most recent bars clearly below the early-window levels. The rally days show a few green bars with moderate volume, and the final red down days carry relatively light volume.
2021-08-11.combined: The rally came on modest, mostly declining volume and the pullback is also on light volume, so the reversal top lacks strong selling conviction. The pattern is still a top, but the volume pattern suggests the decline may be a gradual loss of momentum rather than a forceful breakdown.

2021-08-12.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, rises across most of the 20 days to a peak near the window high around the 15th day, then pulls back in the final few sessions. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, well above the window low, so the rise is intact despite the pullback.
2021-08-12.volume: Volume is highest in the first few sessions, with the tallest bars at the start of the window, and then steadily shrinks. The most recent days show small red and green bars, clearly below the early-window levels, and the last bar is also small.
2021-08-12.combined: Price is still higher across the window, but the pullback is happening on falling volume, which suggests weakening participation and less conviction behind the advance. The uptrend is intact, but the lack of volume on recent moves is a caution.

2021-08-13.kline: The window starts low on the left, climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows with several red pullbacks inside the rise, and peaks near the top of the range about three-quarters of the way through. A sharp retracement then pulls price back toward the middle of the range, and the latest green candle recovers to sit in the upper part of the range, so the rise is still intact.
2021-08-13.volume: Volume is clearly contracting: the tallest bars occur on the earliest days of the window, and volume steps down to smaller bars through the middle and into the most recent sessions. The latest bars are modest in height, and the green up-day at the far right is smaller than the early bars.
2021-08-13.combined: Price is still making a net advance on shrinking volume, which suggests the uptrend is losing momentum and buyers are less committed. The pattern remains an uptrend, but declining participation on the recent rally days is a caution that the advance may stall.

2021-08-16.kline: The window starts near the lows, rises through a series of green and red candles to a peak near the window high, then falls sharply for several days, giving back roughly half of the rise. The latest candles bounce back toward the upper part of the range, with the last close sitting about three-quarters of the way up, so the pattern reads as an uptrend with a pullback rather than a top reversal.
2021-08-16.volume: Volume is contracting: the early red and large green bars are tall, while the recent bars are visibly shorter and cluster in the lower-middle of the volume scale. The most recent day shows only moderate volume, with no spike on the latest up or down moves.
2021-08-16.combined: The rebound toward the upper range is happening on lower volume than the earlier advance, so it is a weak confirmation of the uptrend. The fading volume suggests the recent bounce lacks strong buying conviction.

2021-08-17.kline: Price rose from the lower left of the window to a sharp peak near the window high around the middle-right, forming an inverted V, then fell over about six to seven days with several red candles. The fall gave back roughly two-thirds of the rise, and the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range.
2021-08-17.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the tallest bars appear on the early green rally days, while the recent red decline days sit at moderate levels similar to mid-window volume. The last few bars are not noticeably higher or lower than earlier activity.
2021-08-17.combined: The falling price on steady, non-expanding volume suggests the reversal is driven by gradual distribution rather than heavy selling, so it weakly supports the top reversal without strong confirmation.

2021-08-18.kline: Price rose over roughly the first half of the window, with green candles stepping up to a peak near the window high, then fell over several days in a mostly red run. That forms an inverted-V shape. The decline has given back most of the rise, and the latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, in the lower half.
2021-08-18.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The first bar is among the tallest, and the most recent red bar is still fairly tall, while the mid-window bars are mostly moderate. Green up days and red down days carry similar volume.
2021-08-18.combined: The rise and fall with flat volume suggests the selling pressure in the decline is not unusually heavy, so the top is a tentative reversal rather than a confirmed one. Confirmation would require the decline to continue on rising volume.

2021-08-19.kline: Price rallied for several days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high, then fell over the next several days in a rounded, inverted-V shape back to near the window low. The latest candle is a green day with a long upper wick reaching the top, but its close sits in the lower half of the range, having recovered only part of the decline.
2021-08-19.volume: Volume was mostly moderate and flat through the window, then the most recent day shows a volume spike, far above the normal level, on a green up day. The second-to-last day was a red day with only moderate volume.
2021-08-19.combined: The heavy volume on the latest green day shows strong buying interest and a sharp bounce, but with the close still in the lower half after giving back most of the rally, it does not yet confirm a new uptrend. The spike should be watched for follow-through to see whether the top has ended or the decline is only pausing.

2021-08-20.kline: After a rally to a peak about two-thirds up the range, price fell back to near the window low, then rose sharply over the last two sessions. The latest green candle closes at the top of the chart, above the earlier swing high, so price has left the prior range upward.
2021-08-20.volume: Volume was modest through most of the window and then climbed in the last few sessions. The final bar is the tallest in the window, far above the prior bars, with the second-to-last day also elevated, which marks a volume spike.
2021-08-20.combined: Strong rising price on sharply higher volume supports the upside breakout, though one session of heavy volume alone does not yet prove follow-through.

2021-08-23.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the window to a rounded peak near the middle-upper area, then fell back through several red candles to a low near the window's lower part. The last three sessions are large green candles, and the latest close sits at the top of the range, well above the earlier highs, so price has left the prior range upward.
2021-08-23.volume: Volume was modest for most of the window, with a mix of red and green days. Over the last three days it surges: the tallest bar is a green up day about two bars before the end, and the latest day is also well above the earlier average, which matches the volume spike state.
2021-08-23.combined: Sharply rising price on heavy volume on the up days confirms the breakout above the prior range. The most recent day still shows elevated volume, which supports the move, though the single biggest volume day is one session earlier.

2021-08-24.kline: Price rose from the lower-left to a peak about two-thirds across, then fell through several red candles to a low near the lower-middle of the range before a sharp rally. The last three days are large green candles that carry the close to the top of the window, well above the earlier peak, so the close is in the upper part of the range and the pattern is a breakout.
2021-08-24.volume: Volume is a spike: the two green days before the last one are far taller than the bars around them, with the most recent of these the tallest bar in the window. The final day's volume is lower but still above the window's typical level, and the red down days in the middle of the window are mostly modest.
2021-08-24.combined: Sharp upside price moves on heavy volume confirm the breakout above the earlier range. The volume fading on the latest close suggests some loss of momentum, so follow-through should be watched.

2021-08-25.kline: After a rise to a mid-window peak and a decline back toward the window low, the last three sessions show large green candles that carry price above the earlier highs to the top of the window range, with the latest close at the window high. The breakout is clear, with the latest close in the upper part of the range.
2021-08-25.volume: Volume stayed modest through most of the window, then surged on the last three sessions, with the tallest bars on the most recent green up days, while the red down days in the middle of the window were lighter.
2021-08-25.combined: Sharply rising price on a volume spike on up days confirms the breakout above the prior range and suggests strong buying conviction.

2021-08-26.kline: Price fell from an early high near the window's upper-middle into a low around the 15th bar, then rallied sharply on large green candles. The last three sessions closed well above the earlier highs, and the latest small red candle sits near the top of the 20-day range.
2021-08-26.volume: Volume expanded sharply as the rally began: the three largest bars come with the big green up days, while the early and middle part of the window was quiet. The final red day's volume is well below the peak but still above the early-window levels.
2021-08-26.combined: Rising prices on sharply rising volume confirm the breakout above the prior range. The small red final day on lower volume than the surge suggests a mild pause rather than a reversal.

2021-08-27.kline: Price fell from the early highs in a steady slide to a low near the middle-to-late part of the window, then rallied sharply over the last several days, with large green candles carrying the close to the top of the range. The shape is a V-like bottom, and the latest close sits near the window high, well above the midpoint.
2021-08-27.volume: Volume stays broadly level across the window, with no sustained surge in the most recent days compared with earlier. The tallest bars cluster around the rally days, but the final sessions are similar in size to the earlier bars, and green up-days and red down-days carry similar volume.
2021-08-27.combined: The sharp recovery from the low, with the close back near the top of the range, supports a bottom reversal in price. Because volume is flat rather than expanding into the latest up-days, the rally is not clearly confirmed by volume, so the reversal is tentative.

2021-08-30.kline: After an early decline and choppy trading near the lows, price rallies sharply over the last several sessions, with several large green candles, and the latest close sits near the top of the window range. The recent highs push above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so price has left the prior range upward.
2021-08-30.volume: Volume stays roughly level with earlier days across the window, so no sustained surge stands out. The tallest green bars cluster during the rally, but the most recent sessions are not clearly heavier than the rest of the window.
2021-08-30.combined: Rising price without a clear volume expansion means the breakout is not strongly confirmed by volume. It needs follow-through on higher volume to be considered reliable.

2021-08-31.kline: After an early decline to a low about a third of the way up the window, price rallied strongly through the later bars, with the largest gains in the last third. The latest close is a small red candle near the top of the range, just below the window high, so the rise holds with only a minor pullback.
2021-08-31.volume: Volume is roughly flat by the stated measure, with recent days about the same as earlier in the window, though the chart shows a clear spike of large green (up) volume bars during the sharp rally in the middle-to-late window. Volume then eases to moderate levels, with the latest few days showing red bars at moderate size.
2021-08-31.combined: The price uptrend is supported by strong up-day volume during the rally, but the flat overall volume and the fading volume in the most recent days suggest momentum is cooling. The pattern still reads as an uptrend, with a watch for further confirmation from volume on the next up moves.

2021-09-01.kline: Price fell for about ten days from the left side of the window, with several red candles and a low near the lower part of the range, then formed a V-shaped recovery. A long-wick green candle marked the turn, and a run of strong green candles lifted price to the window high, with the latest closes near the top of the range.
2021-09-01.volume: Volume was flat overall: the largest spikes came on the green up days in the middle of the rally, while the most recent days are at levels similar to earlier in the window, with no sustained surge at the end. Red down days in the early decline carried moderate volume, and the rally days carried the heaviest volume.
2021-09-01.combined: Heavy volume on the green rally days supports the V-shaped recovery, but volume has not expanded in the latest sessions even as price holds near the highs. The reversal is confirmed by price and early volume, though recent momentum is less convincing.

2021-09-02.kline: The window starts with a choppy decline of small red candles into the lower-left area, then a sharp rally of large green candles carries price to the window high in the right-center area. The last few sessions pull back with red candles, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the peak.
2021-09-02.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with the tallest bars on the big green rally days in the middle of the window and a spike of green bars around the rally. The most recent bars are of similar size to earlier ones, with no clear surge or drop-off at the end.
2021-09-02.combined: The rally on heavy green volume shows buying interest behind the uptrend, while the recent red pullback on steady volume looks like a normal retracement rather than distribution. Because volume has not expanded on the latest down days, the pullback does not signal a reversal yet.

2021-09-03.kline: After an early decline to a low near the left-center of the window, price staged a strong multi-day rally on large green candles that carried it from about the lower third to the upper part of the range. Since then price has moved sideways near the window high with small red and green candles, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the peak highs, so the rise is intact.
2021-09-03.volume: Volume peaked sharply on the big green rally candles in the middle of the window and has contracted steadily since, with the most recent bars clearly lower than the earlier spike. The recent pullback days are on light red bars, and the latest up day is also on modest volume.
2021-09-03.combined: Heavy volume on the rally days confirms the advance, but the shrinking volume during the recent sideways pullback suggests momentum is fading. The pattern remains an uptrend without a confirmed breakout, so the trend is intact but losing conviction.

2021-09-07.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, with a few small up and down candles, then rallies strongly through the middle of the window to the upper range. Since then it has moved sideways-to-slightly-lower near the window high, with small candles and a wick reaching the top, and the latest green candle closes about mid-to-upper range, below the earlier highs, so there is no breakout.
2021-09-07.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bars came during the sharp mid-window rally, with several green days well above average. Volume then falls off steadily, and the most recent days show small bars, with the last day's green bar only moderate.
2021-09-07.combined: The rise was driven by heavy buying volume, but as the price stalls near the highs on lighter volume, upward momentum is fading. The uptrend remains intact on price, but the declining volume suggests the advance is losing conviction.

2021-09-08.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window with small candles, then rallies sharply in the middle, with several strong green days lifting it toward the window high near the right-center. The rally stalls near the top, with small red and green candles and a few pullbacks, and the latest candle is a red day with its close in the upper part of the range, so the window is an uptrend with a late pullback rather than a reversal.
2021-09-08.volume: Volume is highest during the sharp green rally in the middle of the window, with the tallest bars on the strongest up days. Volume then steadily drops, and the most recent days show smaller bars, with the latest red day among the lighter-volume bars.
2021-09-08.combined: The high-volume surge behind the rally confirms the uptrend, but volume fading while price holds near the highs suggests the upward momentum is weakening. The uptrend remains intact, though buyers are less forceful than during the rally.

2021-09-09.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, dips to a low near the left-middle, then rallies strongly with large green candles to a high near the right side. The latest several days are choppy near the upper part of the range, and the latest close, a red candle, sits in the upper half, so the window is an uptrend with a pullback inside the rise rather than a reversal.
2021-09-09.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bars are the large green days during the mid-window rally, while the most recent days show smaller bars, mostly red, that are clearly lower than the earlier peaks.
2021-09-09.combined: Price rose on heavy volume during the big rally, which supports the advance, but the recent price action is holding near the highs on lighter volume, so the uptrend is intact yet losing momentum.

2021-09-10.kline: Price rallied strongly from the lower-left of the window into the upper range, with a steep run in the middle bars that climbed to near the window high. The last several sessions moved sideways near the top with mixed red and green candles, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact despite the pullbacks.
2021-09-10.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bars came during the early-middle rally, and the recent bars are visibly smaller and mixed in color, with no volume surge on the latest up day.
2021-09-10.combined: Price is still rising overall, but the fading volume on the recent near-high candles suggests the uptrend is losing momentum rather than being confirmed by heavy buying.

2021-09-13.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, dips slightly, then rallies strongly on several large green candles to a high about two-thirds of the way across. The rally then flattens into choppy, mixed-color candles near the window high, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range just below that high.
2021-09-13.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bars are the green up-days during the rally at the start, and volume falls steadily into the most recent days, which are smaller and mostly at or below the earlier average. Up-days and down-days in the recent stretch have similar, modest volume.
2021-09-13.combined: The rise is supported by heavy volume, but price has been holding near the highs on lighter volume, which suggests waning momentum. The uptrend structure remains intact, but a breakdown from the recent flat top would need a stronger volume push to confirm.

2021-09-14.kline: Price rallies strongly from the lower-left of the window through a series of large green candles to the upper range, then flattens into choppy, mostly sideways trading near the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the peak, with only a shallow pullback, so the rise is not reversed.
2021-09-14.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bars come in the early green rally days, and the bars shrink steadily toward the right. The most recent sessions show only moderate, mixed red and green volume, all clearly below the early peaks.
2021-09-14.combined: The uptrend is intact, but it is losing momentum: the price advance was driven by heavy buying volume early on, while recent gains and pullbacks occur on lighter volume. This fading participation suggests the trend may be consolidating rather than accelerating.

2021-09-15.kline: After a sharp rally from near the window low over the first several days, price stalls near the upper part of the range, with the last dozen or so candles moving sideways in a tight band of alternating red and green bodies just below the window high. The latest close sits near the top of the range, and the pullback is small, so this is a flat consolidation after the rise rather than a reversal or breakdown.
2021-09-15.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars are the large green up-days during the early rally, and volume falls steadily toward the most recent days, which are mostly small bars with a mix of red and green. Up-days carried the heaviest volume and the sideways days trade on noticeably less.
2021-09-15.combined: Heavy volume on the rally days followed by lighter, mixed-direction volume during the sideways action suggests the advance is losing momentum and the stock is pausing without conviction. Neither a breakout nor a breakdown is confirmed yet.

2021-09-16.kline: Price rallies strongly from the lower left of the window through roughly the first 8 to 9 candles, with the big green bars carrying it well up the range. The advance then flattens near the window high, with mixed small green and red candles, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the recent highs.
2021-09-16.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tall green bars on the early rally days give way to shorter bars, and the most recent days are the smallest in the chart. Up and down days both become lighter toward the right, with no sign of heavy selling or buying at the end.
2021-09-16.combined: The price is still in the upper part of its range, so the uptrend holds, but the rise is losing momentum as volume fades. Without volume expansion on new highs, the sideways action near the top could develop into a consolidation or a reversal if the price starts to slip.

2021-09-17.kline: Price rose sharply from the lower left of the window, with the first big green candles lifting it to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window. Since then it has pulled back on mostly red candles, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, about 60% up, so the pullback is too small to count as a reversal.
2021-09-17.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars, especially the tall green surge and the bars near the peak, are much larger than the bars in the later part of the window. The final bar is red and taller than the few before it, but it is still well below the early volume.
2021-09-17.combined: The price pullback from the high is happening on shrinking volume, which suggests selling pressure is weak and the uptrend is losing momentum rather than reversing. Without a volume surge on the down days, the pattern stays an uptrend, but the lack of strong buying on recent rises is a caution.

2021-09-20.kline: Price rallied from a low start to a peak near the top of the window around the middle-right candles, then drifted down through a choppy range with several red candles. The final candle is a large red day that gaps well below the recent lows and closes near the bottom of the window, leaving the prior range downward. The latest close sits at the very bottom of the 20-day range.
2021-09-20.volume: Volume stays roughly level with the earlier part of the window, with no sustained surge. The final red day shows a tall bar, but it is not much larger than the earlier high-volume days, and the bars alternate between green and red without a clear trend.
2021-09-20.combined: The sharp drop on the last day is a clear break below the prior range, but volume does not expand convincingly on that move, so the breakdown is only partly confirmed. A stronger signal would need heavier volume alongside the decline.

2021-09-21.kline: The window trades in a mid-range band with several rallies and pullbacks, then the last two sessions are red and gap sharply below the lows of the earlier part of the window, with the latest close near the bottom of the chart's range. The price leaves the prior range to the downside, which fits a breakdown.
2021-09-21.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no clear surge or drying up, and the most recent bars are about as large as the earlier red and green bars. The two latest red days carry moderate, not exceptional, volume despite the gap down.
2021-09-21.combined: The sharp drop below the prior range on only average volume suggests the breakdown is not strongly confirmed by heavy selling. It still signals weakness that needs follow-through, so the downside break should be watched closely.

2021-09-22.kline: Price starts in a choppy middle range, peaks near the window high around the middle of the window, then falls through a series of red candles to near the window low before a single green bounce on the latest day. The latest close sits in the lower-middle of the range, below the window's midpoint, so the window as a whole is a decline with a one-day bounce.
2021-09-22.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no clear surge or drying-up, so the recent days look about the same as earlier ones. The tallest bars sit mid-window on red down days, while the latest green day's bar is no larger than the typical bar.
2021-09-22.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest selling pressure without a climax, so the downtrend has not clearly reversed. The latest green bounce on unremarkable volume looks weak and does not yet confirm a reversal.

2021-09-23.kline: The window drifts sideways-to-lower with several red and green bars in the upper-middle of the range, then a sharp multi-day drop carries price to the window low near the end. Three strong green days then rebound most of the way back, so the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, a V-shaped bottom, though well below the window high.
2021-09-23.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear surge: the recent bars are roughly the same height as earlier bars in the window. The rebound's green days carry moderate volume, similar to the red down-day bars, and the tallest volume spikes come earlier in the window.
2021-09-23.combined: The rebound off the low is not backed by a volume surge, so the bottom reversal is only weakly confirmed. Price recovering on steady rather than expanding volume suggests a tentative bounce that still needs follow-through.

2021-09-24.kline: Price falls for most of the window from a mid-to-high start down to a low near the window bottom around the middle-to-late bars, forming a V-shaped bottom. The last several days rise in green candles and recover roughly half of the decline, leaving the latest close in the upper half of the range.
2021-09-24.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no bar standing far above the rest. The larger red bars sit during the decline, while the green bars at the right are moderate and not especially tall, matching the flat volume state.
