2021-09-24.combined: The rebound is occurring on volume that is no heavier than the selloff, so the recovery lacks strong volume confirmation. The V-shaped reversal is supported by price alone, and it would be more convincing if rising days attracted clearly higher volume.

2021-09-27.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, with lower highs and lower lows from the upper area toward the bottom of the range. The lowest lows sit near the right-center of the window, followed by a bounce with several tall green candles, but the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2021-09-27.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent days are about as large as the earlier bars, with no clear surge or drop. The largest red and green bars are spread across the window, and the recent green up days are not noticeably heavier than the earlier down days.
2021-09-27.combined: The downtrend remains intact because the bounce is not supported by a clear pickup in volume and the latest close is still in the lower part of the range. Without heavier buying on the rebound, the recovery looks weak rather than a confirmed reversal.

2021-09-28.kline: The window falls from the upper part of its range near the left side to the lowest prices at the right edge, with a green bounce in the middle (roughly the 12th to 16th candles) that does not reverse the decline. The latest red candle closes near the window low, in the lower part of the range.
2021-09-28.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge or drop in the most recent days. Red and green bars appear at similar heights, and the final red bar is not noticeably larger than earlier bars.
2021-09-28.combined: Falling prices on flat volume suggest the decline is steady rather than driven by heavy selling. Without a volume surge on the down days, the downtrend lacks strong conviction, so a reversal is not indicated.

2021-09-29.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from highs in the upper part of the range early on to lows near the bottom at the end, with a mid-window bounce that recovers only part of the drop. The latest close sits near the window low in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-09-29.volume: Volume is flat, staying roughly the same level in the recent days as earlier in the window. The chart shows several tall red bars on down days, including a high red bar near the right, alongside a few green bars of moderate height during the bounce, with no sustained surge or drop-off.
2021-09-29.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest persistent selling pressure without a clear spike of conviction. Volume does not confirm a capitulation or a reversal, so the downtrend reading stands on price alone.

2021-09-30.kline: Price starts near the top of the window and falls across most of the 20 days, with a few green bounces along the way, such as a green candle mid-window and a small rally near the middle-right. The window high sits near the start and the low is at the far right, so the latest green close is near the bottom of the range.
2021-09-30.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout and no sustained surge in recent days. A few taller red bars stand out, including one near the right side, and the bars are mixed between red and green days.
2021-09-30.combined: The decline continues without a clear volume surge, so the selling is not showing strong conviction or capitulation. Flat volume with a falling price is consistent with a steady downtrend rather than a confirmed reversal.

2021-10-01.kline: Price falls across most of the window from a higher start, with a few bounces such as the green candles near the middle and a large green day in the middle-right. The latest candles are red and sit near the bottom of the window range, so the close is in the lower part of the range and the shape is a stair-step decline rather than a clean breakdown.
2021-10-01.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear rise or fall from the start of the window to the end. Several large red bars appear in the middle and late window, while some green up days carry similar volume, so the volume chart does not show a clear expansion or contraction.
2021-10-01.combined: Falling prices with no decisive change in volume suggest steady selling pressure without a volume-driven capitulation or breakdown. The downtrend stays intact unless later closes move clearly back up the range on rising volume.

2021-10-04.kline: Price fell through most of the 20-day window after a short green rally near the middle, then dropped steeply over the final few sessions. The latest red candle closes near the window low, well below the lows of the earlier part of the window, so it sits in the bottom of the range.
2021-10-04.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with tall red bars early on and a mix of red and green bars of similar height later. The most recent days do not show a clear surge above earlier levels, even though the final candle is a large red down day.
2021-10-04.combined: The sharp drop to new lows on volume that is no higher than earlier in the window gives only weak confirmation of the breakdown. Traders would likely want to see volume expand on the downside break to trust it more.

2021-10-05.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from the upper part of the range down toward the window low, with a brief green rally mid-window that fails to hold. The latest candle is a green bounce that closes in the lower part of the range, not near the window high.
2021-10-05.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. Several red down days have tall bars, while the most recent green day's bar is similar in height to the earlier bars.
2021-10-05.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume support the downtrend without showing strong selling pressure. The latest green bounce on ordinary volume is too weak to suggest a reversal.

2021-10-06.kline: The window starts in the upper-middle of the range, rallies with a few green candles to a high in the early-middle section, then falls through a series of mostly red candles to near the window low. The latest candle is a small green bounce that leaves the close in the lower third of the range, so the overall path is a downtrend with a minor bounce at the end.
2021-10-06.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off, so the flat state holds. A few red down-days stand out as tall bars, and the most recent days show moderate-to-high bars that are similar in size to earlier ones.
2021-10-06.combined: Price is still falling overall while volume shows no clear expansion, so the latest green bounce lacks volume conviction and does not signal a reversal. The downtrend remains the better read unless later volume and price confirm a turn.

2021-10-07.kline: Price rose over about six sessions in the middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range, then fell for about eight sessions to a low near the bottom around the right-middle, leaving an inverted-V shape. The latest candle is a small red bar sitting just below the midpoint of the range, having given back more than half of the rise.
2021-10-07.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout and no single day standing out as a spike. The recent red down days carry volume comparable to earlier days, and the last few green days are not notably heavier.
2021-10-07.combined: The peak followed by a sustained decline that retraced most of the rise, with the latest close in the lower half, suggests a top, but volume does not confirm it with a surge on the selling days. The reversal signal is therefore only moderately supported.

2021-10-08.kline: Price drifts lower across most of the 20 days, with a green rally in the middle of the window that fails to hold. Lows cluster near the window bottom around the mid-late bars, and the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, roughly a third of the way up from the window low.
2021-10-08.volume: Volume stays at roughly the same level through the window, with several tall red bars early and in the middle and no sustained surge or drop. The most recent bar is shorter than most, but recent volume is about the same as earlier volume, which fits the flat reading.
2021-10-08.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest a persistent downtrend without a clear sign of capitulation or accumulation. The lack of a volume surge on the recent decline means the move has not yet shown the conviction that would confirm a breakdown.

2021-10-11.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, starting from a high area near the top, with one brief green spike around the first third that fails to hold. Lower highs and lower lows persist into the right side, and the latest green candle sits near the bottom of the range, in the lower part of the window's range.
2021-10-11.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge in the recent days. The tallest bars are red down days in the middle of the window, while the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones and alternate between red and green.
2021-10-11.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the downtrend is persisting without strong conviction or capitulation from sellers. The lack of a volume surge on the latest bounce means it does not signal a reversal.

2021-10-12.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from candles near the top of the range on the left to a cluster of lower candles on the right, with a large green rally candle mid-left as a brief interruption. The latest close sits in the lower part of the window range, near the recent lows.
2021-10-12.volume: Volume is flat, with bars of similar height from the start of the window to the most recent days. The tallest bars cluster in the middle, around the heavy red down days, while the last several days show moderate green and red bars without a clear surge.
2021-10-12.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest a persistent downtrend without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. The lack of a volume surge on the recent bounce means it does not signal a reversal.

2021-10-13.kline: Price rises briefly to a peak near the window high around the middle of the window, then falls over most of the remaining days down toward the window low near the lower part of the range, with only small bounces inside the decline. The latest candle is a small green body that closes in the lower half of the range, well below the peak.
2021-10-13.volume: Volume is contracting: the early red down-day bars are the tallest in the window, while the bars over the most recent days are clearly shorter, and the last few bars are only modest in height. The largest volume spikes occur on red days during the decline, while the recent green and red days show less activity.
2021-10-13.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume suggest that selling pressure is fading, but the close is still in the lower half and there is no volume surge on any bounce, so this does not yet confirm a bottom or a reversal.

2021-10-14.kline: Price falls from elevated levels early in the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late bars, then recovers in a V-shaped rebound of several green days. The rebound retraces roughly half or more of the decline, and the latest green candle closes in the upper half of the window range, near the upper-middle area.
2021-10-14.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red down-day bars are tall and near the top of the volume scale, while the most recent green up-day bars are noticeably shorter, consistent with the contracting volume state.
2021-10-14.combined: The recovery from the low is occurring on shrinking volume, so the rebound lacks strong participation and the reversal signal is only moderately confirmed. Continued buying on rising volume would be needed to strengthen the bottom reversal.

2021-10-15.kline: The price falls from a rally peak near the upper-left of the window down to a low around the middle-right, then rebounds through several green candles. The bounce recovers more than half of the decline, and the latest green close sits in the upper half of the 20-day range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2021-10-15.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars are on the early red down days and a few early green days, while the recent bars, including the rebound days, are noticeably shorter. Recent up days are not accompanied by heavier volume than the earlier selling.
2021-10-15.combined: The rebound is supported by price gains but on shrinking volume, so the recovery looks less convincing than the earlier selloff and needs further confirmation to be a durable reversal.

2021-10-18.kline: The price falls for several days from an early peak near the top of the window into a V-shaped low about two-thirds of the way across, then rallies over the last several days in strong green candles. The rally recovers most of the decline, and the latest close sits near the upper end of the range, just below the window high, but it does not clear the early peak, so this is a V-shaped reversal bottom rather than a breakout.
2021-10-18.volume: Volume stays at a similar level across the window, with the tallest red bars early and near the start of the decline and smaller bars in the middle. The most recent green up days show volume roughly in line with the earlier window, with no clear surge.
2021-10-18.combined: The rally off the low is not backed by a clear increase in volume, so the reversal has only average participation and is not strongly confirmed yet.

2021-10-19.kline: Price fell in a steep V-shaped decline from the early high-range green candles down to a low near the lower-middle of the window, then rose over several green days back up to the upper part of the range. The rebound recovers most of the drop, and the latest close sits near the top of the window, so this reads as a V-shaped bottom.
2021-10-19.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the latest days. The tallest bar is a red down day near the middle of the window, while the recent green rally days show moderate bars similar to the earlier readings.
2021-10-19.combined: The V-shaped recovery on roughly steady volume shows a rebound without strong conviction behind it. Because volume did not expand on the rally, the reversal is plausible but not yet confirmed by heavy buying.

2021-10-20.kline: Price fell from the upper area in a steep decline to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late part of the window, then rose over several days in a V shape, recovering most of the drop. The latest candle is a small red bar in the upper part of the range, near the top of the window, so the close sits in the upper half.
2021-10-20.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars are red down-day spikes early in the window, while several green up-day bars during the rebound are about as large as the recent red bars, and the final bars are moderate and slightly lower.
2021-10-20.combined: The V-shaped recovery with the latest close in the upper half suggests a bottoming reversal, but flat volume means the rebound lacks strong conviction. Volume on the up-days is not clearly heavier than on the down-days, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2021-10-21.kline: After a steep fall to a deep low around the middle of the window, price rallied in a sharp V-shaped recovery and broke above the earlier highs in the last 1-3 sessions. The latest green candle closes near the top of the 20-day range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window.
2021-10-21.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red down days carry the tallest bars, while the recent sessions, including the strong final green day, show clearly smaller bars than earlier in the window.
2021-10-21.combined: Price breaking above the prior range on shrinking volume is a weaker breakout signal, since the advance is not backed by expanding participation. The contracting volume suggests the move needs follow-through volume to confirm it.

2021-10-22.kline: The window starts near the upper-middle of the range, falls for about nine days to a low in the lower-left area, then rallies for about eight days in a V-shaped recovery. The latest candle is a red bar near the window high, so the close sits in the upper part of the range and the rally recovers most of the earlier fall.
2021-10-22.volume: Volume is flat, as the state says: the early red selling days carry tall bars, the middle of the window is lighter, and the rally days are only moderate. Volume does not clearly grow into the latest days, and the tallest bars belong to the early decline.
2021-10-22.combined: The rally off the low recovers most of the decline, but volume does not expand on the up days, so the V-shaped reversal lacks volume confirmation. The latest red day near the high also shows some hesitation after the rise.

2021-10-25.kline: The window opens with high red candles near the upper part of the range, then falls to a trough about 40% of the way through, and then rallies steadily through the final eight or so days. The last three candles are green and close near the window high, above the highs of the early part of the window, so price has left the prior range to the upside, with the latest close at the very top of the range.
2021-10-25.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained expansion or contraction: the tallest bars are early red down-days, and the most recent days are moderate and similar to the earlier levels. The recent green up-days do not stand out with unusually large bars.
2021-10-25.combined: Rising price to new highs on volume that is no larger than earlier in the window only weakly confirms the breakout, so the move is less convincing than one backed by a clear volume surge.

2021-10-26.kline: After a mostly steady climb from the lower-left of the window, the final day is a long green candle that closes near the window high and well above the highs of the earlier bars, so price leaves the prior range upward. The latest close sits in the top part of the range.
2021-10-26.volume: Volume rises sharply on the final day, which is the tallest bar in the window by a wide margin and a green up day. Volume was moderate and mostly green through the climb, with the spike standing well above the rest.
2021-10-26.combined: A sharp rise to new highs on a volume spike suggests the breakout is confirmed, since heavy buying supports the move out of the prior range.

2021-10-27.kline: Price drifts up from a low area with small red and green candles, then climbs in steps toward the top of the window. The second-to-last day is a large green candle that gaps well above the earlier highs and reaches near the window high, so price leaves the prior range upward. The latest day is a smaller red candle that closes in the upper part of the range, just below that spike.
2021-10-27.volume: Volume is quiet early in the window and rises through the middle, then spikes to the window's tallest bar on the second-to-last day, which is a green up day. The latest day's red bar is well below that spike and near the average level of recent bars.
2021-10-27.combined: The heavy volume on the large green breakout day confirms the upward break from the prior range. The lighter volume and red close on the latest day suggest some hesitation after the spike, but the breakout remains intact.

2021-10-28.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, with a few red pullback candles in the early and middle sections that do not reverse the rise. The latest green candle sits in the upper part of the range, below the spike high set a few days earlier near the window top, so it does not clearly break out.
2021-10-28.volume: Volume spikes on a large green day near the end of the window, well above the surrounding bars, and then falls back to moderate levels on the last few sessions, with the final day only modestly above the recent average.
2021-10-28.combined: Rising price on a volume spike on an up day supports the uptrend, but volume fading on the latest sessions suggests the upward momentum is cooling and the trend needs fresh buying to continue.

2021-10-29.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20-day window, starting from lower-left candles and rising to a sharp surge of large green candles in the final days. The latest close sits near the window high, in the upper part of the range, with only small red pullbacks along the way.
2021-10-29.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, mid-window bars are mostly lower, and the most recent days show the tallest green bar in the window along with several elevated bars. The biggest spikes fall on up days, while the few red down days are comparatively smaller.
2021-10-29.combined: Rising price on rapidly expanding volume confirms the uptrend, as buyers are increasingly active into the latest closes near the highs.

2021-11-01.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left to the upper right across the 20 days, with small pullbacks along the way, forming a staircase-like rise. The latest close sits near the top of the window range, and the most recent candles are green.
2021-11-01.volume: Volume is expanding: the early bars are moderate, the tallest bar appears in the late-middle of the window on an up day, and the most recent green bars are higher than the early-window volume, while the red down-day bars stay comparatively small.
2021-11-01.combined: Rising prices on rising volume, with heavier volume on up days than on down days, support the uptrend and suggest buying interest is strengthening into the latest close.

2021-11-02.kline: The price path climbs from low levels on the left to the top of the window on the right, with a few small red pullbacks along the way. The last one to three green candles close above the highs of the earlier window, including the spike high from the long-wick day near the middle-right, so the latest close sits at the very top of the range and leaves the prior range upward.
2021-11-02.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with no sustained surge in the most recent days compared with earlier in the window. The tallest bar is a green day in the middle-right of the window, and the final green bars are moderate to somewhat above average, similar in height to earlier bars, so the volume chart does not show a clear build-up on the breakout days.
2021-11-02.combined: Rising price to new highs on volume that is not expanding is a weaker confirmation of the breakout, so the move needs follow-through on higher volume to be fully trusted.

2021-11-03.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left of the window to near the window high on the right, with small red pullbacks along the way. The latest red candle sits near the top of the range after a slight pullback, so the rise is intact.
2021-11-03.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained build-up or fade. One tall green bar in the middle-late stretch stands out, while the most recent days are moderate and similar to earlier levels, and red and green days are mixed in amplitude.
2021-11-03.combined: Rising prices on broadly steady volume suggest an orderly uptrend without strong confirmation of acceleration. The mid-window volume spike on an up day supports buying interest, but the latest red day on average volume is a mild caution.

2021-11-04.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left through the window, with a few small red pullbacks and a mid-window push to higher highs. The last day is a large green candle with a long upper wick that closes far above the earlier highs, near the top of the window range, so it breaks out of the prior range upward.
2021-11-04.volume: Volume is mostly moderate and rising through the window, with one mid-window green spike. The last day is a green bar that towers over every other bar in the window, a clear volume spike on an up day.
2021-11-04.combined: A sharp rise to the top of the range on a massive volume spike confirms the breakout, though the long upper wick shows some intraday selling pressure.

2021-11-05.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left through small pullbacks, then a very large green candle in the last few days jumps to near the top of the window and closes well above the earlier highs. The latest red candle pulls back only slightly and sits in the upper part of the range, near the top of the window.
2021-11-05.volume: A volume spike appears on the big green breakout day, roughly three to four times the typical bars in the window, and the latest red day is also elevated though lower than the spike. Earlier volume was modest and mixed between green and red bars.
2021-11-05.combined: The surge in volume on the large up day, followed by heavy but lower volume on a small down day, supports the breakout above the prior range. Price holding near the highs on elevated volume suggests the breakout is credible, though the follow-through is still short.

2021-11-08.kline: The window starts near the bottom with small candles and rises steadily, with the price path curving upward more steeply toward the end. Around the second-to-last day a large green candle closes well above the highs of the earlier window, and it is followed by a red candle with a long upper wick that reaches near the window high. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the top, above the earlier highs, so the price leaves the prior range upward.
2021-11-08.volume: Volume is quiet and fairly even for most of the window, then spikes sharply on the large green breakout day, which is far above the earlier levels. The following red day also trades heavily, while the latest green day shows lower volume than the spike but still above the window's normal level.
2021-11-08.combined: Heavy volume on the strong green breakout day confirms the upward move out of the prior range. The high-volume red day with a long upper wick suggests some selling pressure near the highs, so the breakout's follow-through on the last day needs continued volume to stay convincing.

2021-11-09.kline: Price climbs steadily across the 20 days from low on the left to near the window high on the right, with small red pullbacks inside the rise. A large green candle with a long upper wick sits about three days from the end, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the top of the window.
2021-11-09.volume: Volume is mostly modest and rises gradually, then spikes sharply on the large green up day about three days from the end. The following red day trades heavily but below that spike, and the final red day trades at a moderate level.
2021-11-09.combined: The heavy volume on the large green up day supports the advance, and price stays in the upper range, consistent with an uptrend. The red days after the spike come on lower volume than the spike, so the selling looks like a pause rather than a reversal.

2021-11-10.kline: Price climbs steadily from the lower left in a staircase of small green candles, then a large green candle lifts it above the earlier highs near the right side of the window. The last few days reach the window high with a tall red candle, followed by a small pullback, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, well above the earlier consolidation.
2021-11-10.volume: Volume expands clearly: the earlier bars are modest and fairly uniform, while the largest volume bar of the window lands on the big green breakout candle, with further high-volume bars on the red and green days that follow. The highest-volume days are mostly up days, with one high-volume red day during the pullback.
2021-11-10.combined: Rising price on sharply expanding volume confirms the breakout above the prior range, although the high-volume red pullback shows some supply near the highs. The latest green day on still-elevated volume suggests buyers are still active.

2021-11-11.kline: Price climbs through most of the 20-day window, starting from low levels and accelerating into a steep advance with several wide-range candles near the end. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, roughly three-quarters of the way up from the window low, below the highest wick of the final rally, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2021-11-11.volume: Volume expands as the window progresses, with the largest bar of the window appearing on a green up day in the rally and several high-volume bars following it. Early bars are small and fairly even, while the final several days show clearly taller bars on both green and red days.
2021-11-11.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, since heavy buying accompanied the advance. The heavier red-day volume after the peak shows some selling pressure, so the trend is strong but should be watched for signs of exhaustion.

2021-11-12.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right across the 20 days, with a few small pullbacks along the way. A large green candle and a tall red candle near the right push to the top of the window range, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, roughly 75-80% of the way up, below the window high. The shape is a rising staircase rather than a breakout above a prior range.
2021-11-12.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are small, while the bars from the middle to late window are larger, with a very large green spike on a big up day and a tall red bar right after it. Recent days stay elevated relative to the early window, though the final bars are somewhat lower than the peak.
2021-11-12.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, with heavy buying on the big up day. The late-window volume is less intense than the spike, so the trend is intact but the most recent move shows less momentum.

2021-11-15.kline: The window starts near the lows, rises steadily through most of the 20 days, and includes a large green rally candle about two-thirds of the way through. The highest point is a tall red candle near the top of the range, and the latest closes sit in the upper-middle part of the range, below that peak.
2021-11-15.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the largest spike on the big green rally day and another heavy red day right after it. Volume stays elevated in the most recent days, mostly on green up days, and remains well above the quiet early bars.
2021-11-15.combined: Rising prices on heavy, expanding volume support the uptrend, but the high-volume red day near the top shows sellers were active at the peak. Recent price and volume are holding up, so the trend is intact without a confirmed breakout.

2021-11-16.kline: Price climbs from low bars on the left to the upper part of the window, with a sharp spike of a large green candle and tall red wicks near the window high around the middle-right. The latest close is a green candle sitting roughly in the upper-middle of the range, below the window high, so the rise is intact without a breakout or reversal.
2021-11-16.volume: Volume is flat across the window: a single large spike on the big green up day stands out, while the surrounding days show moderate, similar-sized bars, and the most recent bars are about as large as earlier ones rather than swelling or shrinking.
2021-11-16.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend continues but without fresh volume-driven momentum, so the spike's volume was not sustained. Price holds in the upper range while volume gives no clear confirmation of a new leg higher.

2021-11-17.kline: Price rises strongly across most of the window, starting from a low near the left edge with small up and down candles, then climbing steadily to a big green rally candle about two-thirds of the way through and a tall red spike near the window high. The last several days move sideways just below that high, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, roughly three-quarters of the way up. This is a rally with a sideways digestion near the highs, not a breakout above the earlier highs.
2021-11-17.volume: Volume is flat, as the state says: recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones. The tallest bar is the green volume spike on the large up day in the middle of the window, and the bars after it are moderate and mixed between red and green without expanding.
2021-11-17.combined: Rising price over most of the window with a heavy volume day on the big rally supports the uptrend, but flat volume in the recent sideways trading shows no new buying push to confirm a further advance.

2021-11-18.kline: Price climbs from the lower part of the window to near the window high, with a large green up day around the middle-right and several higher highs after it. The latest candle sits near the top of the range, but its close stays below the tall red candle's high, so it does not clearly break out and the pattern is an uptrend.
2021-11-18.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in activity. The tallest bar is the large green up day, and the most recent red bar is also fairly tall, but the bars around them stay at similar levels, consistent with a flat volume state.
2021-11-18.combined: Price rising to the upper part of the range without a clear volume increase suggests the uptrend is steady but not strongly confirmed by participation. The spike on the big up day shows buying interest, but it has not been sustained by higher volume in the most recent days.

2021-11-19.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window to the upper part of the range, with a large green bullish candle in the middle that marks the strongest up move. After that, candles move choppily near the upper levels with small pullbacks, and the latest green candle closes near the window high.
2021-11-19.volume: Volume is flat overall: the tallest bar is on the large green up day in the middle, and later bars settle at moderate levels similar to earlier days. A tall red down day appears late in the window, followed by smaller green and red bars, so up and down days show no clear volume edge.
2021-11-19.combined: The rising price path with the latest close near the top supports the uptrend, but flat volume gives little conviction that the advance is accelerating, so the trend lacks strong volume confirmation.

2021-11-22.kline: After a rise from the lower left, price spent several days in a sideways band near the middle-upper range, then the last two or three candles climbed above the highs of that band. The final red candle has a long upper wick to the window high, and its body sits in the upper part of the range, so the latest close is near the top of the window.
2021-11-22.volume: Volume is roughly flat: the recent bars are similar in size to earlier ones, with no clear surge on the breakout days. The tallest bar is an early green up-day spike, and the most recent red and green bars are of moderate height.
2021-11-22.combined: Price is leaving the prior range upward, but volume is not expanding on the breakout days, so the move lacks volume confirmation and is less convincing than a breakout on rising volume.

2021-11-23.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from low levels on the left to higher highs near the right, with a large green surge around the eighth day followed by a sideways-to-up stretch. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the recent highs, without clearly clearing the earlier window high.
2021-11-23.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the tallest bar on the early surge day and several tall bars in the last six or seven sessions, which is higher than the quiet early days. Both green and red days carry elevated volume recently, and the most recent up day is also strong.
2021-11-23.combined: Rising prices on rising volume in the recent sessions support the uptrend, though the lack of a close clearly above the prior range means it is not yet a confirmed breakout.

2021-11-24.kline: After a rise from low levels, price made a large green surge around the 6th bar and then traded sideways in a middle band for about 10 candles. The last 3 to 4 candles climbed into the top of the window, with a tall red candle reaching the window high. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, above the highs of the earlier mid-window consolidation.
2021-11-24.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the largest bar early on at the big green surge and then lower volume in the middle. Volume rises again in the most recent days, with several tall bars on the right, including a large red day and a sizable green day near the end.
2021-11-24.combined: Rising price into new highs on rising volume supports a breakout from the prior range. The recent expansion in volume suggests real participation, though the single heavy volume spike early in the window is the one earlier outlier.

2021-11-26.kline: Price climbs from low levels on the left to a high-wick peak near the right side of the window, with pullbacks along the way. The latest red candle closes around the upper-middle of the range, a little below the recent peak, so the rise is intact rather than reversed.
2021-11-26.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. The largest bar is an early green day, and tall red bars appear mid-to-late in the window, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones.
2021-11-26.combined: Rising prices over the window with flat volume give a mildly constructive uptrend, but volume is not expanding on the advances, so it offers no added confirmation. The recent red day on moderate volume looks like a pullback within the trend rather than a reversal.

2021-11-29.kline: Price climbs from near the bottom of the 20-day window to near the top, with a large green candle early on and a sharp spike high around two-thirds of the way through. Pullbacks along the way are shallow, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below the window high.
2021-11-29.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the tallest bar comes early, around the large green move, and the most recent days are at moderate levels similar to the middle of the window rather than surging. Up and down days carry similar volume, with no clear build-up on the rally.
2021-11-29.combined: The rising price with steady, unremarkable volume shows a grinding uptrend without strong accumulation or a volume-driven breakout. The latest close is near the top, but the lack of volume expansion means the trend is not yet strongly confirmed.

2021-11-30.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from low candles on the left to higher candles on the right, with a large green surge in the early-middle part and a tall red spike near the top of the range. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the window high, so the pattern is an uptrend with some sideways pullbacks inside the rise.
2021-11-30.volume: Volume is flat: the bars on the right are roughly the same size as those earlier in the window, with the largest bar appearing early and a few tall bars in the middle, while the most recent days show moderate, unremarkable volume. Up and down days carry similar volume, so no single day clearly stands out.
2021-11-30.combined: Rising prices on roughly unchanged volume suggest the uptrend is intact but lacks strong buying conviction in the recent days. The pattern is an uptrend, though the flat volume means the advance is not being driven by a volume surge.

2021-12-01.kline: The window starts near the lower part of the range, then rises through several green candles to a tall spike near the window high around the middle-right. Price pulled back into the middle of the range, and the last few candles bounce in the upper-middle area, so the latest close sits about halfway to upper-middle of the range, below the peak.
2021-12-01.volume: Volume is flat: the early green bar is tall, but the recent bars are roughly similar in height to those earlier in the window, with no clear surge. Up and down days show mixed volume with no consistent pattern.
2021-12-01.combined: Price rose across most of the window with a pullback, but the latest close is not near the window high and volume has not expanded on the advance, so the uptrend is only moderately supported.

2021-12-02.kline: The window starts near the lower part of the range with a large green candle, then trades sideways in the lower-middle area before a sharp rally lifts price to the window high around two-thirds of the way through. Later candles hold in the upper-middle range, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, below the spike high.
2021-12-02.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with the tallest bar at the start and a large red-day spike in the middle of the rally, while the most recent days sit at moderate levels similar to earlier in the window.
2021-12-02.combined: The rise is supported by volume that is not clearly expanding, so the advance looks steady but not strongly confirmed, and the latest green day on modest volume suggests the uptrend is intact without a clear surge of buying.

2021-12-03.kline: Early in the window price trades in a low, choppy range with small mixed candles, then gaps up sharply around the middle of the window to a higher band with a tall spike near the window high. The last several days move sideways within that upper band, and the latest red candle closes about midway up the range, with no clear breakout above the earlier highs.
2021-12-03.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are about the same size as earlier bars, with no clear surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster near the start and middle of the window, and the recent red and green days are moderate in size.
2021-12-03.combined: The sideways trading after the step up, with volume flat and no expansion on the latest days, gives no confirmation of a breakout or breakdown. The pattern reads as consolidation after the earlier rise.

2021-12-06.kline: The price rises from a low in the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top, around the spike high in the middle-right, then falls back over the final several days. The latest close is a green candle near the bottom of the range, so the rise was more than fully given back in an inverted-V shape.
2021-12-06.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days. The tallest red bars appear in the early and middle sections, and the latest bars are about the same height as earlier ones, with up and down days mixed.
2021-12-06.combined: The price reversal from the top is not confirmed by a volume shift, since recent volume is no heavier than earlier in the window. The fall from the peak is therefore not backed by a clear increase in selling pressure, so the top reversal signal is less convincing.

2021-12-07.kline: After an early decline to lower levels around the middle-left of the window, price rallied in steps from about the window's lower third to near the window high, with some red pullback days along the way. The latest green candle sits in the upper part of the range, though below the highest wicks.
2021-12-07.volume: Volume is roughly flat: bars alternate between high and moderate levels across the window, and the most recent days are about the same size as earlier ones, with no clear surge or drop-off. The tallest volume bars occur on a mix of red and green days.
2021-12-07.combined: The rise is not backed by any increase in volume, so the uptrend lacks volume confirmation. Price has been climbing, but the steady volume suggests the move is not gathering strong momentum.

2021-12-08.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the 20-day range with sideways, choppy candles, then rises in steps through the middle and upper part of the window, with the highest wick near the middle-right. The last few days pull back somewhat, and the latest red candle closes around the middle of the range, below the window high.
2021-12-08.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest red bars come in the middle of the window on down days, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier levels, and the last bar is a red day of average size.
2021-12-08.combined: The rise on mixed, similar-sized volume shows no strong institutional conviction, and the recent pullback on unremarkable volume suggests a pause rather than a clear reversal. The uptrend holds, but it is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2021-12-09.kline: Price rose from a low-to-mid left side to a peak near the upper part of the window around the middle-right, then fell over several days with lower highs in an inverted-V shape. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, after giving back most of the rally.
2021-12-09.volume: Volume is flat overall, with the tallest bars early in the window around the first sharp red spikes and moderate, similar-sized bars toward the end. Up (green) and down (red) days show no clear volume lean as the price fell.
2021-12-09.combined: The falling price on steady, unremarkable volume suggests the rally has lost momentum without strong selling conviction, so the top looks tentative and needs confirmation from further declines.

2021-12-10.kline: Price rises from the lower-middle of the window to a sharp peak near the window high around the middle of the 20 days, then falls over the following days with a few partial rallies, and finishes with a long wick near the window low. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, giving back most of the earlier rise, which forms an inverted-V shape.
2021-12-10.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge or drying up. A few red bars in the early-middle section are the tallest, while the most recent bars sit at similar, moderate levels with no strong spike on the final down days.
2021-12-10.combined: The rise-then-fall shape with the latest close in the lower half suggests a top, but flat volume means the decline is not backed by heavier selling, so the reversal signal is only moderately supported.

2021-12-13.kline: Price starts mid-to-high, rises to a spike high in the early-middle of the window, then drifts lower through a choppy series of red and green candles. The latest candle is a long red bar closing near the bottom of the 20-day range, so the window shows a broad decline with bounces along the way, not a sharp breakdown.
2021-12-13.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no clear surge: the tallest bars occur early, while the most recent red down days are moderate and about the same size as earlier bars. Up and down days show similar volume, so no single day stands out strongly.
2021-12-13.combined: Steady price declines on roughly flat volume suggest a gradual downtrend without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. Without a volume surge on the latest down days, the decline does not yet look like a capitulation or a confirmed breakdown.

2021-12-14.kline: Price rises from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high around the fifth to sixth candle, then moves sideways in the upper-middle range before a multi-day decline. That decline gives back most of the rise and ends with the latest small green candle near the window low, in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted-V-style top.
2021-12-14.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or drying up. A few tall red bars early on near the peak stand out, and the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones, so the decline is not accompanied by a clear volume surge.
2021-12-14.combined: Price falling back from the peak on steady volume gives only modest confirmation of the top, since selling pressure does not clearly intensify. The reversal signal is therefore suggestive rather than strongly confirmed.

2021-12-15.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from mid-range near the start to the lower part of the range by the end, with several green bounces along the way. The window high is near the left-middle area, the window low sits near the right side, and the latest green candle closes in the lower half of the range.
2021-12-15.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars are early in the window, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones, with down days and up days mixed.
2021-12-15.combined: Falling prices on flat volume suggest the downtrend lacks strong conviction, and the recent green bounce on modest volume does not yet show a reversal. Without a volume expansion, the pattern remains a downtrend rather than a breakdown or reversal.

2021-12-16.kline: Price drifts lower across the 20 days, starting from a high near the top of the range with a tall wick, falling with several red candles and a deep green wick near the window low in the later part. A small green rebound in the final days recovers only part of the decline, and the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend with a minor bounce rather than a reversal.
2021-12-16.volume: Volume stays roughly flat: the first bar is tall, mid-window bars vary without a clear trend, and the most recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones. Recent green up-days are not clearly heavier than the red down-days.
2021-12-16.combined: The downtrend continues on steady volume, so the selling pressure shows no sign of fading or intensifying. The lack of a volume surge on the late bounce suggests the rebound lacks conviction.

2021-12-17.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from highs near the top of the chart on the left to lows near the bottom on the right, with a few green bounces along the way. A sharp drop near the end pushes to the window low, followed by a partial rebound, and the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, not far above the window low.
2021-12-17.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the early red spike is not sustained, mid-window bars are moderate, and the recent green and red bars are about as large as earlier ones rather than clearly expanding or shrinking. Volume is not building on either the decline or the late rebound.
2021-12-17.combined: The price decline is not accompanied by a clear volume surge, and the late bounce also lacks strong volume support, so the downtrend reading rests on price structure alone. Without a volume expansion, a reversal to the upside is not confirmed.

2021-12-20.kline: The window starts near the top of the range with a large red candle and then falls in a stepped pattern, with several green bounces along the way. The highs are in the first few days and the lows come in the last few sessions, so the latest small green candle sits near the bottom of the window range. Prices fall across most of the window and the latest close is in the lower part, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2021-12-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the first bar is tallest, the middle bars dip, and the most recent bars are about as tall as the earlier ones, with no clear surge or drop-off. Red and green days carry similar volume, so no single day stands out strongly.
2021-12-20.combined: Falling prices on volume that is not expanding suggest the decline is steady rather than capitulating, and the latest green day on similar volume is a weak bounce that does not confirm a reversal. The downtrend therefore remains intact without strong volume confirmation either way.

2021-12-21.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, stepping lower from a high near the upper-left area to a low near the bottom, with a long lower wick on a green candle around the middle-right. The latest candles are small and sit in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so the rally early in the window does not change the downtrend.
2021-12-21.volume: Volume stays at broadly similar levels across the window, consistent with the flat volume state. The tallest bars sit on red down days in the middle and right-hand section, while the most recent bars are not noticeably higher than earlier ones.
2021-12-21.combined: Falling prices on steady volume point to ongoing selling pressure without a clear surge of capitulation or accumulation. Volume does not confirm a reversal, so the downtrend appears intact.

2021-12-22.kline: The window starts near the top of its range and falls across most of the 20 days, with mostly red candles and a few green bounces, including a long-wicked green candle in the middle and a green rebound near the end. The window high sits at the start and the low is near the final stretch, and the latest green close sits in the lower part of the range, about a quarter of the way up from the window low.
2021-12-22.volume: Volume is flat: bars stay at similar heights through the window, with a few taller red bars in the middle and early-middle days and no dramatic surge in the most recent sessions. The last few bars are moderate and in line with earlier levels, so recent activity is not notably heavier than before.
2021-12-22.combined: Price keeps sliding on steady, unremarkable volume, so the downtrend lacks a strong selling climax or fresh conviction. The recent green bounces also occur without a volume increase, so they do not suggest a reversal.

2021-12-23.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, with the highs near the start and the lows in the later-middle section, then a small rebound over the last few candles. The rebound recovers only a minority of the decline, and the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the window range, so this is a downtrend with a bounce rather than a reversal.
2021-12-23.volume: Volume is flat overall: bars stay at similar heights from the start to the end of the window, with a few taller red and green bars in the middle. The most recent bars are not notably larger than earlier ones, and the latest bar is red, so the up and down days carry similar volume.
2021-12-23.combined: Falling prices on steady volume show a persistent sell-off without a volume spike that would signal capitulation. The late rebound also occurs on unremarkable volume, so it does not yet confirm a reversal and the downtrend pattern holds.

2021-12-27.kline: The window starts near the top of the range and falls over about 14 sessions with lower highs and lower lows, ending near the window low. The last 5 to 6 sessions form a rally that recovers roughly two-thirds of the decline, a V-shaped bottom, and the latest green close sits in the upper half of the range.
2021-12-27.volume: Volume contracts: the early and middle sessions carry the tallest bars, especially the heavy green bars during the rally and the large red bars during the decline, while the most recent sessions show clearly smaller bars. The latest day is a red down day on lower volume than the rally days before it.
2021-12-27.combined: The rebound is occurring on shrinking volume, which weakens confidence that the reversal is real. Confirmation would need the rally to continue on rising volume.

2021-12-28.kline: The window shows a V-shaped reversal: price falls from near the window high to a low in the lower-left portion of the range, then rallies over several green days and recovers roughly two-thirds of the decline. The latest red candle closes around the middle of the range, slightly above halfway up, below the rally's peak.
2021-12-28.volume: Volume is contracting: the large red-day volume bars early in the window give way to smaller bars in the recent days. The latest rally days show modest green volume bars, and the most recent red day's volume is lower than the earlier peaks.
