2022-02-23.kline: Price rallied over several days into a cluster of highs near the top of the window, then fell for about six sessions, giving back most of that rise as an inverted-V shape. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range, in the lower half, so the rise has been largely reversed.
2022-02-23.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, while the most recent sessions show the tallest bars, and the last several red down days carry the heaviest volume.
2022-02-23.combined: Heavy volume on the falling red days alongside the decline from the highs suggests sellers are taking control and the top reversal is being confirmed. The rally's volume was weaker than the recent selling volume, which supports a reversal rather than a pullback.

2022-02-24.kline: Price rose over the first half of the window from a low near the early days to a peak near the window high around the 11th-12th sessions, then fell over the following several days, giving back more than half of the rise. The latest green candle sits near the bottom of the range, so the close is in the lower half and the shape resembles an inverted V.
2022-02-24.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are mid-height, while the later sessions, including several tall red down-day bars and a tall final green bar, are clearly higher than the early readings.
2022-02-24.combined: Rising volume on the decline from the peak suggests selling pressure is strengthening, which supports the reversal-top reading, though the final green up day on higher volume leaves some uncertainty about a near-term bounce.

2022-02-25.kline: Price rallied from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high around the middle-right candles, then fell back to a low near the bottom of the range in the later sessions, giving back essentially all of the rise, forming a rounded inverted-V top. The final candles recovered part of the drop, leaving the latest close roughly mid-range to slightly below it.
2022-02-25.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. The largest bars cluster around the peak with red down days, while recent bars are of similar size to earlier ones, so no day stands out strongly.
2022-02-25.combined: The rally on mixed volume and the decline on heavier red-day volume near the top suggest sellers took control after the peak, but flat volume overall gives only weak confirmation of the reversal. Watch whether the latest recovery attracts higher volume.

2022-02-28.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then fell sharply over several sessions, giving back more than half the rise and reaching the lower part of the range. The latest candles recovered partway, leaving the final close near the midpoint of the range, so this is an inverted-V style top rather than a full reversal.
2022-02-28.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent days trade at about the same level as earlier in the window. The largest bars cluster around the price peak and the early part of the decline, and several red down days carry volume as large as the green up days, with no clear surge on the latest sessions.
2022-02-28.combined: Flat volume does not confirm the reversal: the sell-off happened without a clear volume expansion, and the partial recovery is not backed by stronger buying. The top pattern is therefore tentative, and a close back below the midpoint on rising volume would strengthen it.

2022-03-01.kline: Price rises from the left side to a peak in the middle-right of the window, forming an inverted V, then falls sharply to a low near the right-of-center. A small green bounce follows, and the latest red candle closes near the middle of the range, roughly half the range above the window low. The fall gives back more than the rise.
2022-03-01.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are similar in size to the earlier ones, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster around the peak and the subsequent sell-off, and the last few bars are moderate and mixed in colour.
2022-03-01.combined: Heavy volume on the down days after the peak suggests distribution and selling pressure, which supports the reversal from the top. The recovery bounce on only moderate volume shows weak buying interest, so the reversal is not yet confirmed as a new uptrend.

2022-03-02.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, with a tall red spike near the window high early on, then falls across most of the window in choppy red and green candles to a low near the 16th bar, where a long green candle sits near the window low. The last few days bounce back into the middle of the range, so the latest close sits in the lower-to-middle part of the range and does not recover the earlier highs.
2022-03-02.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with no strong surge at the end. The tallest bars cluster around the middle of the window on red down days, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar in height to the earlier ones, which matches the flat volume state.
2022-03-02.combined: The bounce at the end of a falling window comes on volume that is not clearly higher than before, so it does not confirm a reversal and the downtrend bias remains. Heavier volume on the red down days in the middle suggests selling pressure was stronger then.

2022-03-03.kline: Price rises from the left-middle of the range to a peak near the window high around the middle-right, then falls over several days to a low near the window floor, with a tall green candle at the bottom. The latest candles rebound only partway, and the final close sits in the lower half of the range, so this forms a rise-then-fall inverted-V shape.
2022-03-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the heaviest bars cluster in the middle, during the rise and the sharp decline, while the most recent sessions show clearly smaller bars. The volume bars alternate red and green in line with the recent down and up days, with the latest bars the smallest in the window.
2022-03-03.combined: Heavy volume during the decline confirms selling pressure, but the fading volume during the recent partial rebound suggests weak buying interest and less conviction behind the reversal, so the top is not strongly confirmed.

2022-03-04.kline: Price rises from the lower-middle of the range through several green days to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over several days, including a large red candle and a long green bar near the bottom, giving back most of the rise. The latest candle is red and closes in the lower half of the range, forming a rounded top after an inverted V-shaped rise and fall.
2022-03-04.volume: Volume climbs to a peak in the middle of the window, around the heavy red selling days, and then contracts steadily. The most recent bars are clearly lower than the mid-window peak, with the final days at low levels.
2022-03-04.combined: Heavy volume on the mid-window decline followed by fading volume on the latest days suggests the top formed on strong selling, but the recent weak volume points to waning selling pressure rather than fresh distribution, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2022-03-07.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak in the upper-middle bars, then falls over most of the remaining days with only a partial bounce mid-window. The window high sits near the early-middle peak, and the latest close is a red candle near the window low, in the lower part of the range.
2022-03-07.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars cluster in the middle of the window, around the peak and the early selloff, and they shrink steadily toward the right. The last several days, which are mostly red, show the lowest volume in the window.
2022-03-07.combined: Falling price on shrinking volume suggests the downtrend is still in place but selling pressure is fading, so the bearish signal is only weakly confirmed.

2022-03-08.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high cluster on the left down to a low near the right edge. Bounces, such as the green candles in the middle, are small and do not reverse the decline. The latest green candle sits near the bottom of the window range, in the lower part.
2022-03-08.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars come in the early and middle part of the window, and the recent bars are clearly shorter. The last few days show a small rise in volume bars, but they stay well below the earlier peaks.
2022-03-08.combined: Falling prices on shrinking volume suggest the selling pressure is fading rather than being driven by heavy participation. This supports a downtrend that is losing momentum, but it does not yet show a reversal.

2022-03-09.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range on the left to a low near the bottom on the right, with several bounces along the way such as the green candles mid-window. The latest close is a small green candle sitting in the lower part of the range, well below the early highs.
2022-03-09.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, consistent with the flat state. The tallest red bars come in the early-to-middle stretch, and the most recent bars are moderate in height with no spike, so volume is not expanding into the latest days.
2022-03-09.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume show a grinding decline rather than a high-conviction selloff. The lack of a volume surge on the recent down moves means the downtrend lacks strong confirmation, though the price structure still favors continued weakness.

2022-03-10.kline: The 20-day window falls from near the top of its range at the start to near the bottom by the middle, with a few green bounces along the way. The window high is at the start and the low sits near the lower-middle, around day 16. The latest candles are small green bars that recover somewhat, leaving the latest close in the lower part of the range, so the overall pattern is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2022-03-10.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, as the volume state indicates: bars are similar in size from start to finish, with the largest bars in the early-middle part and a gradual, modest decline toward the right. No single day stands out sharply, and the most recent days are not markedly higher or lower than earlier days.
2022-03-10.combined: The falling price path is not accompanied by a surge or collapse in volume, so the downtrend shows no clear increase in selling conviction. The late small green rebound on steady volume suggests only a mild bounce rather than a confirmed reversal.

2022-03-11.kline: The window opens near the top of the range with a tall red candle, then falls in a series of lower highs and lower lows, with only a brief green bounce in the middle. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so the fall is the dominant move.
2022-03-11.volume: Volume is roughly flat overall, as the volume state indicates: the early bars are fairly tall, the middle has a few higher peaks, and the most recent bars are at similar levels to earlier in the window. Down days such as the recent red bars carry volume about the same as the up days.
2022-03-11.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest a persistent downtrend without a clear volume surge to confirm a capitulation or a reversal. The lack of strong volume on the bounces hints that buyers are not yet pushing the stock back up.

2022-03-14.kline: Price peaks in the first few sessions near the top of the window, then falls over most of the 20 days with a few sharp green bounces, including a large green day near the middle-late window. The latest close is a red candle in the lower part of the range, close to the window low.
2022-03-14.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat state. The tallest bars sit on the early red and green days, and the recent bars are of similar height with no clear surge, mixing red down days and green up days.
2022-03-14.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest a grinding downtrend without a volume-driven selling climax or a clear accumulation signal. Price and volume do not confirm a reversal.

2022-03-15.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting from the upper part of the range near the early highs and stepping lower with small bounces along the way. The latest candle is green but sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high and near the lower half of the range.
2022-03-15.volume: Volume is contracting: the early red and green bars are the tallest, with the largest spikes near the start of the window, while the recent bars are noticeably shorter, though the final green bar edges up somewhat. Up and down days are mixed in the recent stretch, with no sustained volume surge on the rising days.
2022-03-15.combined: Falling prices on contracting volume suggest selling pressure is fading rather than a new buying wave, so the downtrend is not confirmed to be reversing. The small recent bounce lacks strong volume support, so it does not yet signal a reversal bottom.

2022-03-16.kline: Price starts near the window high and falls over most of the 20 days, with small bounces along the way, to a low in the lower part of the range around the middle-to-late window. It then rallies on a series of green candles, recovering roughly two-thirds of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2022-03-16.volume: Volume stays at a similar level throughout the window, with no clear surge or drop-off. The tallest bars are on early green days, and the recent rebound days show moderate volume that is not notably higher than earlier bars.
2022-03-16.combined: The recovery from the low is not accompanied by a volume expansion, so the rebound lacks strong volume confirmation. The V-shaped bottom is still visible on price, but it would need follow-through on rising volume to be convincing.

2022-03-17.kline: Price fell from near the top of the window through a series of red candles to a low near the bottom around the middle-right of the window, then rebounded over several green days to finish near the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped double-sided reversal. The rebound recovers most of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range but below the window high, so this is not a breakout.
2022-03-17.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with no clear surge in the most recent days compared with the earlier part of the window. Some earlier bars are tall, and the recent green up days are about as large as the earlier red down days, so volume does not clearly expand on the rebound.
2022-03-17.combined: The price rebound is not accompanied by a clear increase in volume, so the recovery from the low looks less convincing than a V reversal backed by heavy buying. Confirmation would need volume to rise on the up days in the coming sessions.

2022-03-18.kline: Price fell from the early part of the window into a low near the middle, then recovered in a V-shaped rebound with several green up days. The last green candle closes at the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part of the range, so price leaves the prior range upward.
2022-03-18.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with the most recent days about the same size as earlier bars and no clear surge. The latest green up days carry moderate, similar-sized volume, while some of the red down days in the middle of the window were also comparable.
2022-03-18.combined: The breakout is supported by rising price but not by a volume surge, so the move is less convincingly confirmed. Traders would want to see higher volume on the breakout days before treating it as strong.

2022-03-21.kline: After a choppy first half that held mostly in the middle-to-lower part of the range, price rallied sharply over the last 4-5 candles, with the latest green candle closing near the top of the window. The final closes sit clearly above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so price has left the prior range upward.
2022-03-21.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no clear surge on the recent rally days compared with earlier sessions. Green up-day bars and red down-day bars are both mixed in size through the middle, and the latest green bars are about as large as the earlier ones.
2022-03-21.combined: Price is breaking out to the upside, but volume is not expanding on the move, so the breakout is less convincing and needs confirmation from higher volume on follow-through days.

2022-03-22.kline: Price starts near the middle of the range, drifts down to a trough about two-thirds through the window, then rallies in a steep run of green candles. The last three or so candles push above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the latest red candle closes near the window high in the upper part of the range.
2022-03-22.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge. Some earlier days, such as the tall green bars near the start and the middle, are as large as the most recent bars, and the latest red bar is only moderate in size.
2022-03-22.combined: Price is leaving the prior range upward, but the rally is not backed by a clear rise in volume, so the breakout is only weakly confirmed and needs follow-through on heavier volume.

2022-03-23.kline: The window starts mid-range, drops to a low around the middle-left, then rallies in a steep run of green candles to the highest prices of the window, with the last few days printing above the earlier highs. The latest candle is red and sits in the upper part of the range, just below the window high.
2022-03-23.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear surge in the recent days compared with earlier in the window. The tallest bars are on the first day and on a green up day near the end, while the last two red days show moderate volume similar to the mid-window bars.
2022-03-23.combined: The price has pushed above the earlier range on volume that is no bigger than before, so the breakout is not strongly confirmed by volume. Rising price on steady volume suggests a tentative breakout that needs follow-through on higher volume to be trusted.

2022-03-24.kline: After a decline from the early mid-range to a low near bars 9-10, price rallied in a series of green candles, with a brief red pullback near the top of the rise. The final candle is a large green bar that closes near the top of the 20-day range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2022-03-24.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window: the early bars are mostly moderate, while the rally and the final session show the largest bars, with the last bar the tallest of all and coming on a green up day. The red bars near the top of the rally also carry relatively high volume, but the most recent green session stands out most.
2022-03-24.combined: Strong rising price on the highest volume of the window confirms the upward breakout, indicating buyers are pushing price above the prior range with conviction.

2022-03-25.kline: Price fell from the top of the window to a low near the bottom around the middle of the window, then rose steadily with a few small pullbacks to a high near the right edge. The latest close is a red candle in the upper part of the range, close to the window high and not clearly above the prior range, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2022-03-25.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the tallest bars clustered in the most recent sessions, including a large green up day near the end. The latest session is red but still carries heavy volume, so the volume chart shows activity rising as price climbs.
2022-03-25.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, with heavy buying on the up days near the end. The high-volume red day at the top is a caution that sellers are active near the highs, so the trend needs to hold on the next sessions.

2022-03-28.kline: Price falls from the left side of the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the 8th to 9th candles, then rallies for most of the remaining days to a high near the window top. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, close to the window high.
2022-03-28.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off, so the recent days are not markedly heavier than earlier ones. The tallest bar falls on a large green up day in the later rally, and a few red down days show moderate volume.
2022-03-28.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume suggest the advance is orderly but lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest close near the top of the range supports the uptrend without signaling a breakout.

2022-03-29.kline: Price bottoms in the lower-middle of the window around the 9th to 10th bars, then rises in a long run of mostly green candles to the top of the range. The latest candle is a red day with a wick near the window high, so the close sits in the upper part of the range, with pullbacks inside the rise but no fresh breakout beyond the early highs.
2022-03-29.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. A tall bar appears in the middle-to-late section, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier levels.
2022-03-29.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume show a steady uptrend without strong accumulation or a volume-driven acceleration. The pattern is supported by price but not by a clear volume expansion.

2022-03-30.kline: Price starts high on the left, drops to a low about a quarter of the way in, then rises across most of the window with several pullbacks, including red candles near the right. The latest candle is a red day that sits in the upper part of the range, just below the window high.
2022-03-30.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with no sustained surge or drop-off in recent days. The tallest bar is a green up-day near the right-middle of the window, and the most recent bars are moderate and mixed between red and green.
2022-03-30.combined: Price rising on roughly steady volume suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong conviction. The latest red day on average volume is a minor pullback rather than a sign of distribution.

2022-03-31.kline: Price starts with a choppy stretch near the window low, then rises across most of the window in a series of higher highs and higher lows, forming a steady staircase-like advance. The window high is set near the right side, and the latest close, a small red candle, sits in the upper part of the range just below the recent peak, so this is an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2022-03-31.volume: Volume is flat overall, with bars of similar size across most of the window and no sustained surge or fade. A few green up-days stand out with taller bars, and the largest spike is a red down-day near the late part of the window, while the most recent bars are moderate and close to the window average.
2022-03-31.combined: Rising prices are only partly supported by volume, since the strongest volume spike came on a down-day and the latest sessions are not clearly heavier than earlier ones. This suggests the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by volume.

2022-04-01.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from the lower part of the range with a few choppy red and green candles, then rallying strongly into the upper range near the window high. The last few days show a shallow pullback of red candles, leaving the latest close in the upper part of the range, so the rise is not reversed.
2022-04-01.volume: Volume is flat, as the stated volume state indicates: most bars sit at similar heights across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The one standout is a tall green bar on an up day late in the rally, and the recent red down days carry only moderate volume.
2022-04-01.combined: The steady rise on roughly flat volume shows the uptrend without a clear volume-driven confirmation, and the modest volume on the recent pullback suggests a mild pause rather than distribution. Watching for volume to expand on the next up move would be needed to strengthen the trend signal.

2022-04-04.kline: Price climbs from the lower part of the window to a high near the right side, with several pullbacks along the way, and the latest bar is a green candle sitting in the upper part of the range, about two-thirds of the way up. The fall from the peak retraces only roughly a third of the rise, so it is a pullback within an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2022-04-04.volume: Volume is flat: recent bars are roughly the same size as earlier ones, with a single tall green spike in the middle of the window and a few red bars near the end of similar height to the bars before them. Up and down days show no clear volume dominance.
2022-04-04.combined: Price is still rising overall and the latest close holds in the upper range, but volume is not expanding on the advance, so the uptrend lacks strong volume confirmation.

2022-04-05.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with a few choppy candles, then rises in a steady run to the window high near the 15th to 16th bars, with the latest close about 60% up the range after a pullback of roughly 40% of the rise over the last five red candles. The rise dominates the window, so this is an uptrend with a pullback inside it rather than a reversal.
2022-04-05.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the most recent days compared with earlier bars. The tallest bar is a green up day in the middle-late part of the window, while the recent red down days show moderate volume similar to the earlier bars.
2022-04-05.combined: Rising prices on broadly steady volume suggest the uptrend is intact, but the lack of a volume surge on the recent pullback or the latest move gives little extra confirmation of further strength.

2022-04-06.kline: Price rises strongly from the left side of the window to a peak near the window high around two-thirds of the way across, forming an inverted-V top. The last several sessions are mostly red and give back most of that rise, and the latest red close sits in the lower part of the range, well below the peak.
2022-04-06.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or collapse. The tallest bars cluster on the big green up days in the middle, while the recent red down days are moderate, and the final red bar is one of the taller bars of the late stretch but not clearly above earlier peaks.
2022-04-06.combined: The price reversal from the peak is not backed by a volume surge, so the top looks like a gradual rollover rather than a high-conviction distribution. Recent declines on steady volume suggest sellers are in control, but confirmation would need heavier volume on continued down days.

2022-04-07.kline: Price rises steadily from the lower left of the window to a peak near the window high, around the right-center, then falls back over several days in a rounded inverted-V shape. The decline gives back roughly 60% of the rise, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, below the midpoint.
2022-04-07.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained expansion or contraction. The largest spike is a single tall green bar on a rising day in the middle of the rally, while the red down-day bars during the decline are moderate and similar in size to earlier bars.
2022-04-07.combined: The rally was not clearly backed by rising volume, and the peak came with one isolated high-volume up day. The decline on steady, unremarkable volume gives no volume confirmation of the reversal, so the top is plausible but of modest conviction.

2022-04-08.kline: Price rises for roughly the first dozen sessions from a low on the left to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over the last several sessions, giving back most of the rise, forming an inverted V (a rounded top). The highs cluster near the window high around the peak, and the latest red close sits near the bottom of the range, in the lower half.
2022-04-08.volume: Volume is flat: bars vary from day to day with no sustained trend, and the recent bars are about the same height as those earlier in the window. The tallest bar is a green up day in the middle-to-early part of the window, while the final sessions include red down days of ordinary size.
2022-04-08.combined: The price top formed on fairly steady volume with no clear surge on the rally or the decline, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume. The falling prices on unremarkable volume suggest a gradual loss of upward momentum rather than heavy selling.

2022-04-11.kline: Price climbs steadily from near the window low to a peak near the top of the range about two-thirds of the way through the window, forming an inverted V with several up days before the top. The subsequent decline runs through most of the remaining days and gives back most of the rise, leaving the latest close near the bottom of the range.
2022-04-11.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained increase or decrease. The tallest bar is a green up day in the middle-to-late rise, and the recent red down days are similar in height to earlier bars.
2022-04-11.combined: The falling price is not accompanied by a volume surge, so the decline lacks strong selling conviction. The inverted-V top is still intact, but the flat volume means the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2022-04-12.kline: Price climbs from the left side of the window through a series of green candles to a peak near the upper part of the range, then turns down with a string of red candles. The window high sits near the right-center, and the latest close is near the bottom of the range, giving back most of the rise in an inverted-V shape.
2022-04-12.volume: Volume stays broadly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. The tallest bar is a green up day near the early-middle of the window, and the red down days later in the window are roughly as large as the earlier bars, with no clear surge or drying up.
2022-04-12.combined: The price fall from the peak is not accompanied by a volume surge, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Still, the declining price with steady, unremarkable volume is consistent with an inverted-V top that has rolled over and left the latest close in the lower half of the range.

2022-04-13.kline: Price rises for about the first seven days, from a low-middle start to a peak near the window high in the left-middle, then falls for most of the remaining days, forming a rounded inverted-V top. The latest close is a small green candle near the window low, in the bottom part of the range, so the rise has been largely given back.
2022-04-13.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bar is an early green day, and the recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones, mostly red on the down days with the final day moderate.
2022-04-13.combined: The rise and fall on roughly unchanged volume suggests the reversal lacks strong volume conviction, though the sustained decline still points to a top. The last green day on steady volume is a weak bounce and does not yet confirm a recovery.

2022-04-14.kline: Price rises over roughly the first 8-9 bars to a peak near the top of the window, forming a rounded inverted-V top, then falls for most of the remaining bars to the window low. The latest close sits near the bottom of the range after a small green bounce near the end, so the fall gives back more than the rise.
2022-04-14.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat state, with one tall green spike early on and taller red bars during the mid-to-late decline. Up days and down days show no clear volume pattern, though the most recent green day is only moderate.
2022-04-14.combined: The falling price on heavier red-day volume in the late window supports the reversal from the top, but the lack of a clear volume surge makes that confirmation weak. The pattern suggests sellers have taken control, with no strong evidence yet of a fresh bottom.

2022-04-18.kline: After a brief rise to a high near the top of the window in the first few days, price falls steadily for most of the window, with the latest closes sitting near the window low. Two small green candles at the end show a slight bounce, but the latest close remains in the lower part of the range.
2022-04-18.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish. One tall green spike early in the window stands out, and recent days show volume roughly in line with earlier days, with no clear surge.
2022-04-18.combined: The steady decline on mostly unchanged volume suggests a persistent but not capitulative sell-off, so the downtrend is intact. Volume does not confirm any reversal, and the small late bounce is not supported by a volume increase.

2022-04-19.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range around the middle of the window down to a low near the bottom at the right side. A few small mixed candles and a small green bounce near the end sit close to that low, and the latest close is in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.

2022-08-08.kline: Price climbs from the lows near the left of the window to the highs near the right, with a few red pullback days along the way such as a dip in the middle. 2022-08-08.volume: Overall volume is flat, with most bars at similar heights through the window and no sustained surge or fade. The final bar is much taller than the rest, so the most recent day stands out as a single volume spike rather than part of a broader change.
2022-08-08.combined: The uptrend remains intact because the one-day drop does not give back half the rise, but the heavy final-day volume on a down move suggests sellers were active and the pullback should be watched. The flat volume through the rally shows no strong accumulation confirmation for the earlier advance.

2022-08-09.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the 17th to 18th bars, with a pullback in the last few sessions. The latest red close sits roughly in the middle of the range, slightly above the midpoint, after giving back about half of the rally from the lows.
2022-08-09.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with bars of similar height throughout, consistent with the flat volume state. The tallest bar is a green up day near the end of the window, and the latest red day is about as large as earlier bars, so there is no clear surge or drying up.
2022-08-09.combined: The uptrend is intact overall, but the pullback occurred on no clear volume expansion, so the flat volume gives little conviction either way. Confirmation would require higher volume on the next up days to resume the rise.

2022-08-10.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to the upper right of the 20-day window, with several pullbacks along the way, including a red-candle dip in the middle and a multi-day pullback near the end. The window high is near the top right, and the latest green close sits in the upper part of the range, so the rise dominates the window.
2022-08-10.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with most bars at similar moderate heights across the window and no sustained increase in the latest days. One tall green bar stands out near the right side, followed by a red day with elevated volume, and the most recent green day is back at a moderate level.
2022-08-10.combined: Price is still rising overall, but volume is not expanding to support the advance, so the uptrend is not strongly confirmed by volume. The single volume spike sits on a down day and does not signal a breakout or a reversal.

2022-08-11.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to near the top of the range, with pullbacks along the way, most notably a red candle or two in the middle and a red day at the end. The latest red candle has a long upper wick and closes in the upper part of the range but below the window high, so it is an uptrend with a pullback rather than a breakout.
2022-08-11.volume: Volume stays roughly steady through the window, with no sustained surge or dry-up. One tall green bar stands out near the right side, on an up day, and the most recent red day trades on a moderate bar, a bit below that spike.
2022-08-11.combined: Rising price across the window on volume that stays about average suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong conviction. The tall green volume bar on an up day supports the advance, while the red latest day on moderate volume looks like a mild pullback rather than a distribution signal.

2022-08-12.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with several red pullbacks along the way (a series of higher highs and higher lows). The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, near the window high.
2022-08-12.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height from left to right. One tall green bar stands out near the right side, but most days stay close to the window average, and the volume is not clearly expanding or contracting.
2022-08-12.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume suggest an orderly uptrend without strong conviction, so the uptrend is intact but not confirmed by a volume surge.

2022-08-15.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from a lower-middle starting level, with a few small pullbacks (red candles) along the way, and reaches the window high near the right side. The latest candle is green and sits near the top of the range, just below the window high, so the rise holds.
2022-08-15.volume: Volume is flat overall: the most recent bars are roughly the same height as the early bars, with one tall green spike around the middle-late part of the window and a few red down days of moderate size. Recent volume shows no sustained surge or drop-off.
2022-08-15.combined: Rising prices on steady volume suggest an orderly uptrend with no strong new buying or selling pressure, so the pattern is continuation rather than a confirmed breakout.

2022-08-16.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window toward the upper right, with a few red pullback candles along the way, and the latest candle sits in the upper part of the range near the window high. The rise is interrupted by pullbacks but the overall direction is up.
2022-08-16.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, consistent with the flat volume state. The tallest bar is a green up day near the middle-right, and the recent red down days show no clear volume surge.
2022-08-16.combined: Rising prices on roughly flat volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong volume conviction. The advance is intact, but the absence of a volume expansion on the latest moves gives only modest confirmation.

2022-08-17.kline: The price path climbs from lower left to a high near the upper right of the window, with a few red pullbacks along the way. The latest red candle sits in the upper half of the range, about a third of the way down from the window high, so the pullback is too small to count as a reversal.
2022-08-17.volume: Volume is broadly flat, as the stated state says: most bars sit at similar heights, with one tall green spike around the middle-to-late part of the window. The most recent red days show volume near earlier levels rather than a clear surge or drop.
2022-08-17.combined: The steady volume with a single spike suggests the uptrend is not being driven by a sustained surge in participation. Recent pullback days are not accompanied by heavy selling, so the uptrend remains intact but without strong volume confirmation.

2022-08-18.kline: Price rises from the lower-left area to a peak near the top of the window, pulls back to about the lower-middle of the range, then climbs again to near the window high before a small dip and a rebound into the upper half. The latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, below the earlier peak, so the rise is not a clean breakout.
2022-08-18.volume: Volume is flat overall: the most recent days trade at about the same level as earlier in the window. The largest bar is an early green day near the peak, while the recent bars sit at moderate, similar heights with mixed red and green days.
2022-08-18.combined: Rising prices with steady, non-expanding volume suggest the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed by participation. The lack of a volume surge on the latest advance argues against a breakout.

2022-08-19.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then pulls back. It rallies again to a second high near the top of the range, and the last several candles are red, closing in the lower-middle part of the range, so the shape looks like a double top.
2022-08-19.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with no sustained surge in recent days. The tallest bar is a green day near the middle, followed by a few red days with somewhat elevated volume, and the most recent bars settle to levels similar to earlier in the window.
2022-08-19.combined: The rally into the second high on ordinary volume and the lower close on steady volume give a weak, unconfirmed top signal. Without a volume surge on the recent down days, the reversal is not strongly supported.

2022-08-22.kline: Price rallies from near the window low to the top of the range, pulls back to about the middle, rallies again to roughly the same high, then falls through several red candles to finish near the lower part of the range, forming a double top with the latest close in the lower half.
2022-08-22.volume: Volume is flat overall: a single tall green spike appears on the big rally day, then bars settle to similar levels through the window, and the red down days near the end are of ordinary size without a surge.
2022-08-22.combined: The double top with the latest close in the lower half suggests a reversal, but because volume does not expand on the decline, the selling lacks strong confirmation and the reversal signal is only moderate.

2022-08-23.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window to a peak near the window high around the middle-to-late section, then falls over several days with mostly red candles, giving back most of the rise. The shape resembles an inverted V, and the latest close sits near the lower part of the range after a small green bounce.
2022-08-23.volume: Volume is flat overall: one tall green spike early in the window stands out, and after that bars step down gently and stay similar in size, with the red down days on moderate volume and no sustained surge on the decline.
2022-08-23.combined: The fall from the top is occurring on steady rather than heavy volume, and the late small bounce is on light volume, so the reversal shows price weakness without clear volume confirmation.

2022-08-24.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the 9th day, then falls over several days with mostly red candles, giving back well over half of the rise. The latest close is a small green candle sitting in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so this looks like an inverted V reversal top.
2022-08-24.volume: Volume is flat: the largest bar is a single spike on the peak day, then the bars settle to moderate, similar heights across the window, and the most recent bars are close to the earlier levels rather than clearly higher or lower. Red down days carry about the same volume as green up days in the later part of the window.
2022-08-24.combined: The rally was accompanied by a volume spike at the top, but the decline has not shown a volume surge, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Flat volume with price in the lower half suggests the top may be forming, but the signal is only moderately supported.

2022-08-25.kline: After an early rally that peaked in the upper part of the window, price fell over most of the following days into a low near the window bottom, forming a lower-high, lower-low decline. The final day is a sharp green bounce that closes about halfway up the range, well below the window high, so it does not leave the prior range and is too brief to count as a reversal bottom.
2022-08-25.volume: Volume is flat overall: the largest bar is a green spike early in the window, and the red down-day bars through the decline are moderate and gradually easing rather than surging. The final green bar is at a moderate level, not a clear expansion.
2022-08-25.combined: The falling price on steady, unremarkable volume shows a decline without strong selling conviction, and the last-day bounce on only average volume is not enough to signal a trend change. The downtrend remains intact until price reclaims the recent highs on rising volume.

2022-08-26.kline: Price rises from the left side of the window to a peak near the upper part of the range around the middle-early candles, then falls through several red days and gives back most of the rise. Late in the window it bounces with a couple of greens, but the final candle is a large red day that closes near the bottom of the range, forming a rough inverted-V top.
2022-08-26.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state, with one tall spike early on the green rally day and a gradual decline afterward. The final two sessions (a strong green day and a large red day) show modestly higher volume than the middle of the window, but not a sustained increase.
2022-08-26.combined: The advance peaked on a volume spike and then faded on mostly steady volume, so the rise did not show strong sustained buying. The latest large red day closing near the lows is a bearish signal, though its volume is only moderately higher, so the top is suggestive rather than strongly confirmed.

2022-08-29.kline: Price rises for about the first five sessions to a peak near the top of the window, then falls with a few bounces, and the last several candles are large red bodies that drop to the bottom of the range. This forms an inverted-V style top, and the latest close sits near the window low, in the lower half of the range.
2022-08-29.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with bars mostly in a similar band. The tallest bar is an early spike on the peak-area day, and the final red day is a bit higher than the bars just before it, but most sessions sit at similar levels.
2022-08-29.combined: The rally to the peak came with a volume spike, and the decline has mostly proceeded on steady, unremarkable volume, so the reversal lacks clear volume confirmation. Flat volume means the top is not strongly confirmed by heavy selling, though the price path still points to a reversal top.

2022-08-30.kline: Price rallied from the upper-left area to a mid-window high, then drifted lower with small bounces before the last three candles fell sharply, with the final red candle closing near the bottom of the window range and well below the earlier mid-window lows. The latest close sits at the window low, so price has left the earlier range downward.
2022-08-30.volume: Volume is flat overall: the window opens with one tall green spike around the fourth day, then recent bars are roughly similar in size to the earlier ones, with the final red sessions at moderate levels rather than a surge. Down days and up days are mixed in height, so volume does not show a clear expansion on the breakdown days.
2022-08-30.combined: The breakdown is not confirmed by volume, since the sharp final drop comes on volume no larger than earlier activity, which weakens conviction in the move. The pattern is still a breakdown on price, but a volume expansion on the next down day would be needed to strengthen it.

2022-08-31.kline: Price falls from the upper-left area of the window with a few green bounces, then drops sharply in the last several sessions, with the final red candles closing below the lows of the earlier window. The latest close sits at the bottom of the range, near the window low.
2022-08-31.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state. One tall green bar stands out early on, and the final red down days are only modestly above the mid-window levels rather than showing a clear surge.
2022-08-31.combined: The breakdown below prior lows is not backed by a volume surge, so the downside move has only average participation and is less convincing. Confirmation would require heavier volume on the down days.

2022-09-01.kline: Price rises from a dip in the early window to a peak near the upper part of the range around the middle bars, then falls over roughly the last eight to ten days, giving back nearly all of the rise. The latest close is a long red bar at the bottom of the window range, so the shape is a rounded inverted-V top ending in the lower part of the range.
2022-09-01.volume: Volume is elevated in the early and middle part of the window, with a tall green bar near the start, then tapers off during the decline. The most recent day stands out as a spike, the tallest bar in the window and a red down day, far above the normal level.
2022-09-01.combined: The heavy-volume red day at the bottom of the decline suggests strong selling pressure confirming the reversal from the earlier peak. Price falling sharply on a volume spike points to the top being in and continued weakness, though one session alone does not prove the trend will persist.

2022-09-02.kline: After a rise to a peak near the upper part of the window, price fell in steps, with a large red drop around the 17th day. The last two or three candles closed well below the earlier lows near the bottom of the window, so the latest close sits at the window low, a clear breakdown below the prior range.
2022-09-02.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with the tallest bars at the start and in the final red days, but the recent days are not clearly heavier than the earlier ones. The red down days at the end carry bar heights similar to the early and middle sessions.
2022-09-02.combined: The downside break happens with volume that is not clearly expanding, so the breakdown is less convincingly confirmed than it would be on a heavy-volume surge. Falling prices on steady volume still point to continued selling pressure unless volume picks up further.

2022-09-06.kline: Price rises for about seven days from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top, then reverses into a longer decline, forming an inverted-V shape. The latest close sits near the window low, in the bottom part of the range, after giving back all of the rise.
2022-09-06.volume: Volume is fairly steady and moderate through the early rise, with the largest bars on the green up days near the peak. In the last three days a red down day shows a volume spike far above the window's normal level, and the final session is lower but still elevated.
2022-09-06.combined: The heavy volume on the decline confirms that selling pressure drove the reversal, consistent with a top. Price falling on rising volume supports the inverted-V reversal rather than a routine pullback.

2022-09-07.kline: The window starts with a modest rise to a peak about two-thirds of the way across, then falls in a series of mostly red candles with a large red bar near the middle-right, ending near the window low. The latest close, a small green candle, sits in the lower part of the range, just above the window low, so the decline dominates the window.
2022-09-07.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate and mostly flat, while the last several days are clearly higher, with a very tall red bar near the right side and elevated red bars at the end. The heaviest volume falls on down days, so the rise in activity lines up with the selling.
2022-09-07.combined: Rising volume on falling prices suggests sustained selling pressure and supports the downtrend. The small green close on the latest day does not yet show a meaningful reversal, so the bearish pattern still holds.

2022-09-08.kline: The window starts with choppy trading near the top of the range, then a sharp multi-day decline takes price down to the window low, with the last few candles near that low. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range after a small green bounce, so the pattern is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2022-09-08.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, while the later bars are higher, with a very tall red spike on a heavy selling day near the end of the decline. The most recent green up days also carry noticeably larger volume than the early bars.
2022-09-08.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp down days alongside the rising volume into the recent bounce shows strong participation in the decline, so the downtrend is intact, though the higher volume on the last green days hints at some buying interest near the lows.

2022-09-09.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range and stepping lower through a large red candle and a series of smaller red bars. Price bottoms near the window low around the 16th to 17th days, then makes a small green bounce. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so this is a downtrend with only a minor bounce.
2022-09-09.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar size from start to finish. The tallest bar is a red day in the later-middle part of the window during the sell-off, and the most recent days are about the same size as earlier bars, with no clear surge.
2022-09-09.combined: Falling price on mostly unchanged volume suggests the downtrend is steady rather than driven by heavy selling. The small green bounce at the end is not supported by a volume increase, so it does not signal a reversal.

2022-09-12.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the top of the range at the start to near the lows around the middle-to-late bars, with a large red candle and a brief green bounce in the middle. The last few days show a small rise off the lows, but the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, so the decline still dominates.
2022-09-12.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with most bars of similar size. The tallest bar is a red down day about two-thirds of the way through the window, and recent green up days are about as large as the bars early in the window.
2022-09-12.combined: The heavy volume on the big down day supports the selling pressure, but the recent green bounce is not accompanied by a clear volume increase, so it does not confirm a reversal. The overall picture remains a downtrend with a weak recent bounce.

2022-09-13.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from highs near the top of the chart to lows near the bottom, with a few green bounces along the way, including a large green candle mid-window. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so the bounces do not change the downtrend.
2022-09-13.volume: Volume is flat overall, with most bars at similar heights. The tallest bar is a red down day about two-thirds through the window, and the latest day's volume is moderate, not a clear surge above earlier levels.
2022-09-13.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest the selling pressure is persistent but without a volume climax, so the downtrend looks intact and no clear sign of reversal appears yet.

2022-09-14.kline: The price path falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a steep decline, a long red candle mid-window, and lower lows toward the end. A short run of green candles late in the window is a bounce that recovers only a small part of the fall. The latest close is a small red candle sitting in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2022-09-14.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the recent days compared with earlier ones. The one clear spike is a tall red bar in the middle of the window, and the most recent bars are roughly in line with the earlier average. Up and down days carry similar volume, so the chart does not show a clear build-up on either side.
2022-09-14.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the downtrend continues without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. The late green bounce on flat volume does not indicate a reversal, and the one heavy red day shows that sellers were most active at that point.

2022-09-15.kline: The window falls from near its high in the first few bars to near its low around the middle, with a brief bounce in the last several bars that recovers only part of the drop. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the lower-middle, so the decline is the dominant move.
2022-09-15.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bar is a red down day near the middle of the window, and the most recent days show moderate, similar-sized bars, both red and green.
2022-09-15.combined: Falling prices on steady volume suggest the downtrend lacks strong conviction from either side, and the late bounce on unremarkable volume does not signal a reversal. The pattern remains DOWNTREND unless a later breakout occurs on heavier volume.

2022-09-16.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the top of the range on the left to the lower part of the range at the right, with small green bounces along the way. A gap down in the middle leads to a short green rally that recovers only a small part of the decline. The latest close is a green candle near the bottom third of the range, so the window's low sits at the far right and the high sits at the left edge.
2022-09-16.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. One tall red bar about two-thirds of the way through stands out as the largest volume day, and the most recent bars are moderate, with the final green day at a level similar to earlier sessions. Red down days and green up days carry similar volume, so volume does not clearly favor either side.
2022-09-16.combined: Price is trending lower while volume shows no clear expansion, which suggests the decline is not being driven by heavy selling or capitulation. The small rally at the end lacks volume conviction, so it does not signal a reversal. The downtrend remains intact unless later price action shows volume-backed strength.

2022-09-19.kline: Price opens the window near the top of the range, then drops sharply with a large red candle to the middle. It makes a series of lower highs and lows, with a partial green rally from the lower third that stalls, followed by red selling. The latest close is a small green candle near the lower part of the window range, so the trend is down with only brief bounces.
2022-09-19.volume: Volume stays fairly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The most notable bar is a tall red spike in the middle of the window on a down day, and the recent bars are similar in size to the earlier ones, with green and red days mixed.
2022-09-19.combined: The downtrend is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion on the selling, and the recent green bounce occurs on ordinary volume, so it does not signal a reversal. The pattern remains a downtrend with the latest close still in the lower part of the range.

2022-09-20.kline: The window opens near the top of the range, drops sharply in a large red candle, and keeps stepping lower through red candles to a low near the bottom third of the range. A green bounce recovers only part of that fall, and the latest candle is a small red bar sitting in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend with an intermediate bounce.
2022-09-20.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction in the most recent days. The tallest bar appears during the early decline, while the bars on the later bounce and the final days are similar in height to earlier ones.
2022-09-20.combined: Volume shows no clear surge to confirm the selling or the bounce, so the downtrend lacks a volume-driven signal. The latest red close on ordinary volume suggests continued but unconfirmed weakness.

2022-09-21.kline: Price opens the window near the upper part of the range, peaks in the first few bars, then falls over most of the window with several large red candles to a low near the bottom of the range. A brief rebound of green candles lifts price about a third of the way back up, but the latest green candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the lower area of the window.
2022-09-21.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the largest spike is a red day early on, and recent bars are similar in size to earlier bars with no sustained surge. Volume is mixed between red and green days, with no clear build-up on the latest up days.
2022-09-21.combined: The falling price with mostly red days and the flat volume suggest the decline is still in control, and the recent green candles lack volume conviction to signal a reversal.

2022-09-22.kline: Price falls across most of the window, starting near the window high with a tall green candle followed by a large red drop, then a series of lower red candles. A brief green bounce in the middle fails to recover the early highs, and the latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range.
2022-09-22.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bar is a red spike early-to-middle in the window, and the most recent bars are at similar levels to earlier ones, with a mix of red and green days.
2022-09-22.combined: Price keeps sliding while volume stays at a steady level, so the decline lacks a clear volume-driven capitulation or accumulation signal. The downtrend persists, but without volume confirmation it looks like a gradual grind lower rather than a high-conviction selloff.

2022-09-23.kline: The window opens with a large red candle near the top of the range, followed by a series of lower highs and lower lows, with a few green bounces in the middle that fail to recover the earlier levels. The latest candle is a small green day sitting near the bottom of the window range, so the close stays in the lower part of the range.
2022-09-23.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop, though one tall red bar stands out around the early-middle of the window. Recent volume is about the same as earlier, and the latest green days show bars of similar height to the red days.
2022-09-23.combined: Price has been falling across most of the window while volume shows no clear expansion on the down moves, so the selling pressure is not confirmed by a volume surge. The small green bounces near the end do not show increasing volume either, so the downtrend remains the dominant read.

2022-09-26.kline: Price falls from the top-left of the window toward the lower part of the range, with the highs made early and the lows made in the middle-to-late window. A modest green bounce in the later sessions recovers only part of the drop, and the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range.
2022-09-26.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with a tall spike on an early red day and a few taller green and red bars later, but no sustained rise or fall in the most recent days. The heavier bars fall on both up and down days, so no clear volume trend stands out.
2022-09-26.combined: The falling price path with no sustained volume expansion suggests the decline lacks strong conviction from either side, and the late bounce on flat volume does not signal a reversal.

2022-09-27.kline: Price starts near the top of the window and falls across most of it, with a small green bounce around the middle of the window that does not reverse the decline. The latest closes sit in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, after a green spike wick near the late middle. The shape is a stepwise decline rather than a named reversal.
2022-09-27.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, matching the flat volume state, with one tall red spike early on and no sustained surge or drying up. Heavier green bars appear during the mid-window bounce, while the most recent red days are moderate rather than stand-out.
2022-09-27.combined: The steady decline on mostly ordinary volume suggests a persistent downtrend without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. The lack of a volume surge on the recent down moves means the selling is not showing signs of accelerating.

2022-09-28.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a long red candle and stepping lower through a series of red candles with brief green bounces. The latest closes sit near the bottom of the range, with the most recent green candle still in the lower part of the range and well below the window high.
2022-09-28.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the recent days compared with earlier. The chart shows one tall red bar early in the window that stands out, while most later bars sit at moderate heights, with red and green days mixed throughout.
2022-09-28.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the downtrend continues without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. The lack of a volume surge on the recent green bounce means it does not signal a reversal.

2022-09-29.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from candles near the top of the range early on to the lowest candles at the right edge. Brief green bounces interrupt the decline, and a late green spike is followed by a return to the lower part of the range. The latest close sits near the bottom of the window range.
2022-09-29.volume: Volume starts with one tall red bar on the left, then declines to moderate levels and stays roughly steady through the most recent days. Red and green bars are mixed across the window, with no clear surge on either the down or up days, which matches the flat volume state.
2022-09-29.combined: The decline continues on steady, unremarkable volume, so the selling lacks a volume surge that would signal strong conviction or a capitulation low. The downtrend is intact, but without rising volume on down days, a reversal is not yet indicated.

2022-09-30.kline: The 20-day window falls from upper-left to lower-right, with a large red candle near the start, a few green bounces in the middle, and a long green spike near the middle-right that does not reverse the decline. The latest candle is a small green body near the bottom of the window range, so the close sits in the lower part of the range.
