The latest candles, especially the tall green bar near the right, close well above the highs of the earlier window, and the most recent close sits near the top of the range.
2023-03-21.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear expansion. The chart shows one tall green spike early in the window and a tall red spike on a down day near the end, while most bars in between stay at similar moderate levels, so the breakout days do not stand out in volume.
2023-03-21.combined: The price breakout above the prior range is not confirmed by volume, since the latest up days carry no higher volume than earlier bars. The move is valid on price alone but lacks volume support, so it should be treated with more caution.

2023-03-22.kline: After a dip to the lower part of the window around the middle days, price climbed in a series of green candles and then gapped up with a tall green candle near the end. The last few closes sit above the highs of the earlier part of the window, with the latest close near the top of the range, so price has left the prior range upward.
2023-03-22.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with the early bars and recent bars at similar levels. A tall red bar in the middle-late window stands out as the largest volume day, and the latest green up days are not clearly heavier than earlier days.
2023-03-22.combined: The price breakout is not confirmed by volume, since rising prices on flat volume suggest a weaker move that may need follow-through volume to validate it.

2023-03-23.kline: Price was sideways and low in the first half of the window, then climbed steadily from about the middle onward in a sequence of mostly green candles, with the last 2-3 candles closing above the highs of the earlier part of the window. The latest close is green and sits near the top of the 20-day range, with the window high set by the final days.
2023-03-23.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are modest and the most recent days carry clearly higher volume, including a very tall red spike about three-quarters of the way through and a tall green bar near the end. Up days generally carry larger bars in the late stretch, while the largest red bar marks a heavy down day.
2023-03-23.combined: Rising prices on rising, expanding volume support a genuine breakout above the prior range rather than a false move. The heavy red volume spike earlier in the rally is a caution, but the latest green sessions on strong volume confirm buyers are in control.

2023-03-24.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with mixed small candles, then climbs steadily to a high at the right edge. The latest candle is a small red day, but the close still sits in the upper part of the range, so the pattern is an uptrend with a small pullback at the end.
2023-03-24.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. A tall red spike appears in the middle of the window and a tall green bar appears near the end, but the most recent days are not clearly heavier than earlier ones.
2023-03-24.combined: The steady rise in price without a clear increase in volume suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest red day on similar volume is a mild warning rather than a sign of reversal.

2023-03-27.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from lows in the left third and climbing to a spike high near the 16th-17th bars. The last few days pull back with small red candles, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, roughly 75-80% of the way up from the window low.
2023-03-27.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no sustained surge in recent days. The tallest bars are a red day near the middle-right and a green day just before the final pullback, and the last bars are red and moderate, close to earlier levels.
2023-03-27.combined: The uptrend is supported by a higher-low, higher-high price path, but volume is flat rather than expanding on the rally, so the trend is not strongly confirmed by volume. The recent red days on moderate volume look like a normal pullback within the uptrend rather than a reversal.

2023-03-28.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window to near its high on the right, with a large green candle in the middle-right and several higher highs along the way. The last three to four candles are red and pull back from the window high, but the drop is small compared with the rise and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, so this is a pullback inside an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2023-03-28.volume: Volume is flat, so the bars stay at similar heights across the window. The tallest bar is a red down day around the middle-right, and the most recent red bars are of ordinary size rather than surging. Up days (green) and down days (red) are mixed in height without a clear pattern.
2023-03-28.combined: Rising prices on steady volume support the uptrend without showing strong buying conviction. The recent red pullback is not accompanied by a volume surge, so it looks like a mild, orderly pause rather than heavy selling.

2023-03-29.kline: The price path rises from low on the left to near the top of the window on the right, with small pullbacks along the way and a large green candle in the middle-right. The window high sits in the last few days near the top of the chart, and the latest green close is in the upper part of the range, so the window reads as an uptrend with a mild pullback near the end.
2023-03-29.volume: Volume is flat overall: the recent bars are roughly the same size as the earlier ones, with a tall red spike and a tall green spike in the middle of the window and moderate bars on the most recent days.
2023-03-29.combined: Price is rising and closes in the upper range, but volume is not expanding into the recent gains, so the uptrend has only moderate volume support and no clear acceleration signal.

2023-03-30.kline: Price spent the first part of the window in a low, sideways base, then rallied strongly from about the middle of the window, with a tall green candle and a long upper wick that reached the window high. A pullback of several red candles pulled price back from that high, but the final green candles recovered to the upper part of the range, near the window high. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, so this is an uptrend with a pullback inside it.
2023-03-30.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bar, a red day around the middle of the window, marks a volume spike, and volume then falls to small bars on the pullback days. The most recent days show moderate green bars, but they stay clearly below the earlier peak volume.
2023-03-30.combined: The rebound to the upper range is happening on lighter volume than the earlier selloff spike, so the pullback looks like a low-volume correction rather than heavy distribution. However, the uptrend's recent advance is not drawing strong volume, so conviction is only moderate and the trend would need volume expansion on up days to be confirmed.

2023-03-31.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from the lower left with mixed small candles, then climbing through a large green candle in the middle-right and several higher green closes into the final bars. The latest close is a green candle near the top of the window range, so this is an uptrend with pullbacks that do not reverse it.
2023-03-31.volume: Volume contracts over the window, consistent with the measured state: the tallest red spike comes around the middle of the window, and the bars toward the right get smaller. The last few sessions show moderate green bars and lower red bars, so the recent days carry clearly less volume than the earlier peak.
2023-03-31.combined: Rising price on shrinking volume suggests the uptrend is still intact but losing momentum, and the advance is not confirmed by strong participation. Without a close above the prior range on heavy volume, this fits a trend that is still in place rather than a breakout.

2023-04-03.kline: The 20 days climb from a low-to-middle start on the left to the top of the window on the right, with small pullbacks (red candles) along the way and several green bars in the rise. The latest candles sit near the window high, so the close is in the upper part of the range. The rise is steady rather than a sharp breakout, so this is an uptrend.
2023-04-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: it peaks in a tall red spike about two-thirds of the way through and then falls, and the most recent bars are clearly lower than the earlier bars. Up days (green) and down days (red) are mixed in the recent stretch, with the red bars near the end trading on lighter volume.
2023-04-03.combined: Price is still rising toward the top of the range while volume fades from its earlier spike, so the uptrend is less strongly supported by participation. This is a caution rather than a reversal signal, since the price path has not yet broken down.

2023-04-04.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window toward the top-right, with choppy early candles, a large green candle mid-window, and gaps higher later on. The latest candle is a small red body sitting near the upper part of the range, just below the window high.
2023-04-04.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bar, a red day on the left-middle, marks the peak, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter, and the last several days show lower volume than the earlier window.
2023-04-04.combined: Rising prices on shrinking volume suggest the uptrend is losing momentum rather than confirming a new breakout, so the trend is intact but weakening.

2023-04-05.kline: Price starts near the window's high-range in a red selloff to a low around the 3rd-4th bars, then climbs in a steady staircase with a few pullbacks, including a large green surge mid-window. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, a little below the recent swing highs near the right edge.
2023-04-05.volume: Volume stays flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days. The one standout is a tall red spike in the early-middle bars, and the bars near the right edge are moderate and mixed, with the final day red at a middling level.
2023-04-05.combined: The price uptrend is not accompanied by a volume expansion, so the rise lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest red day on only average volume suggests a mild pause rather than a clear trend change.

2023-04-06.kline: Price climbs from low levels on the left to near the top of the 20-day range, with a pullback of red candles in the middle-right of the window. The latest candle is green and sits in the upper part of the range, below the window high, so the rise persists and the pattern is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-04-06.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. One tall red bar stands out early in the window, and the most recent bars are close to the window's typical level, with up and down days mixed.
2023-04-06.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is intact but lack strong volume confirmation. The absence of a volume expansion on the latest up days means conviction behind the move is moderate.

2023-04-10.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with a steep rally in the early and middle bars and a few red pullback candles along the way. The latest green candle sits in the upper part of the range, near the window high, so the rise holds and this is an uptrend rather than a breakout or reversal.
2023-04-10.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The one tall spike is a red down day in the early-to-middle section, while the most recent bars are at moderate levels similar to the earlier sessions.
2023-04-10.combined: Price has kept rising while volume has stayed at about the same level, so the trend is intact but volume does not add strong confirmation. A pickup in volume on the next up days would be needed to make the uptrend more convincing.

2023-04-11.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window toward the upper right, with a tall green rally early on, several smaller red pullbacks along the way, and a series of higher highs. The latest candle is a red bar near the window high, so the close sits in the upper part of the range, consistent with an uptrend.
2023-04-11.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, with one tall red spike early on and otherwise moderate bars of similar height. The most recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones, and the last day's red bar is moderate, which matches the flat volume state.
2023-04-11.combined: Price has risen across most of the window while volume has stayed flat, so the advance lacks strong volume confirmation. The recent red day near the highs suggests some hesitation, so the uptrend is intact but not strongly backed by participation.

2023-04-12.kline: Price climbs from near the window low to a high near the top of the range, with several pullbacks along the way. The last few days are red candles that pull back from the window high, but the latest close still sits in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact.
2023-04-12.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with an early spike on a red day and larger green bars in the first half. Recent bars are mostly red and similar in size to earlier bars, so the latest days do not stand out in either direction.
2023-04-12.combined: Rising prices on steady volume support the uptrend, but the recent red pullback on unremarkable volume suggests the rise is pausing rather than accelerating.

2023-04-13.kline: Price climbs from a low near the left side of the window to a cluster of highs in the upper part of the range, with a large green candle near the bottom early on and tall green candles later. The last several sessions pull back with red candles, but that retracement gives back well under half of the rise, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, so the window reads as an uptrend with a pullback.
2023-04-13.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off; the tallest bars are an early red day and a mid-window green day. Recent days show red and green bars of similar height, so volume does not expand on the latest down days or the up days.
2023-04-13.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is intact but without strong conviction from buyers. The recent pullback on similar volume does not signal a reversal, so the trend picture stays intact but unconfirmed by volume.

2023-04-14.kline: Price rose from the lower part of the window to a peak near the upper range in the middle-to-late section, forming an inverted V, and then fell over several days, giving back roughly half of the rise. The latest green candle sits near the middle of the range, slightly below the window high.
2023-04-14.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with the most recent days about the same as earlier. The tall red bar on the far left stands out, and the green up-days and red down-days show no clear increase during the decline.
2023-04-14.combined: The rise followed by a partial retracement suggests a top, but flat volume does not confirm the reversal, so the signal is only moderately supported. Price weakness without a volume expansion means the downside move lacks conviction.

2023-04-17.kline: Price rose from the lower left of the window to a high near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then fell back through several red candles to the lower-middle area. The last few days bounced with green candles, and the latest close sits in the upper-middle of the range, so the path is choppy and sideways rather than a clean trend or reversal.

2023-04-17.combined: Price swings up and down within a broad range while volume stays about the same, which suggests no strong conviction behind either direction. The window reads as consolidation until a move on heavier volume confirms a direction.

2023-04-18.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, starting from lows near the bottom of the range and rising to highs near the top. A few red pullback candles interrupt the rise, but the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, below the peak highs set mid-window.
2023-04-18.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with the tallest green bars early in the window and mostly moderate bars through the middle. The most recent green up-day is near the average level, so recent volume is not noticeably higher or lower than earlier.

2023-04-19.kline: The window starts with a decline and a low-volume-looking dip to the lower part of the range, then rallies through the middle of the window to the upper range near the window high, with a red pullback in the middle. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, without clearly clearing the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-04-19.volume: Volume is flat overall: the tallest bar is at the far left, and the most recent days are about the same size as the mid-window bars. Up days and down days are mixed in volume height, with no clear surge on the latest green candles.
2023-04-19.combined: Price rising to the upper range on steady, unexceptional volume suggests the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed, since the latest gains are not backed by a volume surge.

2023-04-20.kline: Price oscillates in a wide, sideways range without a clear trend: it dips to a low near the start, rallies to a high in the middle-late part, falls back, then makes another push up before a red day pulls the latest close back to around the middle of the range. No defined shape such as a double top or head and shoulders is clearly visible.
2023-04-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. The tallest bar is a green up day near the end of the window, and the latest red day trades at a moderate level, so volume shows no clear build-up.

2023-04-21.kline: Price moves sideways in a choppy range with no clear direction: it dips to the window low early on, rallies to the upper part of the range in the middle-to-late window, then falls back, and the latest green candle closes only around the middle of the range.
2023-04-21.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained build-up: the most recent bars are close to earlier levels, with one tall green spike in the later part of the window standing out, while up and down days alternate with similar bar heights.
2023-04-21.combined: Choppy price swings around a mid-range close on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the stock is consolidating without conviction, so neither a breakout nor a trend is confirmed.

2023-04-24.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the chart to a peak near the upper part of the range in the first half of the window, then fell back toward the lower third through the middle-right bars, forming a rounded inverted-V top. The latest candles recovered slightly but the last close sits just below the midpoint of the range, in the lower half.
2023-04-24.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the most recent days are about the same as the earlier bars, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest volume bar appears near the price peak, and the volume bars mix green and red without a clear one-sided bias.
2023-04-24.combined: The high-volume bar near the peak followed by a fall on mixed volume suggests the top was distribution, but the lack of a volume expansion on the decline makes the reversal signal only moderately convincing.

2023-04-25.kline: Price rose over the first half of the window from a low base to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-left, then fell back through the middle and right side, with the most recent candle a long red body dropping toward the bottom of the range. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, and the fall has given back more than half of the earlier rise, forming an inverted-V shape.

2023-04-25.combined: The price decline on roughly unchanged volume suggests the reversal is not being driven by heavy selling pressure, so the top is plausible but not strongly confirmed. A sharper volume surge on the next down days would strengthen the reversal signal.

2023-04-26.kline: Price rises over the first half of the window, from low-middle levels to a peak near the window high around the 5th to 8th candles, forming an inverted-V shape. It then falls over several days, with a sharp red drop near the end that takes it back into the lower half of the range, and the latest close sits in the lower-middle part of the range.

2023-04-26.combined: The rally on green days was not clearly backed by heavier volume, and the decline has not come with a volume spike either, so the top looks like a gradual fade rather than a high-conviction reversal. Flat volume gives only moderate confirmation of the reversal.

2023-04-27.kline: Price swings up early in the window to a high near the top, then falls over about eight candles to a low near the bottom around the second-to-last third of the window, with only a weak rebound at the end. The latest red candle closes around the middle-to-upper part of the range, so there is no clear direction and no break outside the prior range.
2023-04-27.volume: Volume is flat: the recent bars are about the same height as earlier ones, with one tall green spike earlier in the window and no clear surge on the latest days. Red down days and green up days are mixed across the window, and the last few red bars are moderate rather than heavy.

2023-04-28.kline: The price path falls from the upper area early in the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-to-late section, then rises over the last several days, with the latest green close in the upper part of the range. This is a V-shaped recovery that is a reversal bottom.
2023-04-28.volume: Volume is flat overall, with bars of similar height across most of the window and no sustained surge. One tall green bar stands out in the middle-right, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier levels.
2023-04-28.combined: The rebound on roughly steady volume suggests the recovery lacks strong conviction, so the reversal bottom is not strongly confirmed by volume. The rising price with no volume expansion is a weaker signal than a breakout on heavy volume.

2023-05-01.kline: After a high start near the upper-middle of the range, price fell through the middle of the window to a low about two-thirds of the way down, then rose sharply over the last three to four candles. The final green candle closes near the top of the window, clearly above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2023-05-01.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height from the start to the end. The final bar is the tallest green bar, but it is not dramatically larger than several earlier days, and the red down days in the middle are about as heavy as the green up days.
2023-05-01.combined: The upside break on the latest days is not backed by a clear volume surge, so the breakout is less convincing than a breakout on expanding volume. Price and volume together suggest a rebound that needs follow-through volume to confirm.

2023-05-02.kline: After a choppy, mostly sideways stretch in the lower-middle of the range, price jumps sharply in the last two sessions: a tall green candle pushes to the top of the window, well above the earlier highs, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, above the prior range. The breakout is a sharp upward move that leaves the earlier consolidation.
2023-05-02.volume: Volume is flat, with recent bars about the same size as earlier bars. The second-to-last green day shows somewhat elevated volume, but the tallest volume bar sits mid-window, and the latest red day is only moderate, so the breakout days do not stand out.
2023-05-02.combined: The upward breakout is not confirmed by volume, since the breakout days carry no clear volume surge over the earlier window. Price leaving the prior range on flat volume makes the move less convincing and needs follow-through to validate it.

2023-05-03.kline: Price swings in a wide, sideways band without a clear direction: it climbs from the lower-middle of the window to a sharp spike near the window high on the second-to-last day, then falls back. The latest red close sits roughly in the middle of the range, below that spike but well above the window low, so it does not break out or down.
2023-05-03.volume: Volume stays flat: the most recent bars are about the same size as the earlier ones, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest green bar sits mid-to-late in the window, and the latest red bars are moderate, not standing out.

2023-05-04.kline: Price drifts in a low, choppy range, then rallies sharply over about five days to a high near the top of the window, forming a rounded-then-peaked top. Three red candles then pull it back to roughly the middle of the range, giving back about 60% of the rally, so the latest close sits in the lower half of the range.
2023-05-04.volume: Volume is flat: recent bars are about the same size as earlier in the window, with one tall green spike during the mid-window rally. The last few red down days carry moderate volume, similar to the earlier bars rather than a clear surge.

Price and volume together suggest the upside momentum has stalled and the stock is giving back gains.

2023-05-05.kline: Price falls from the left side of the window to a low in the middle-to-late section, marked by a long red candle near the bottom of the range, then rallies over several days to a tall green candle near the window high. A few red candles pull back from that high, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, so the decline has been largely recovered in a V-shaped path.
2023-05-05.volume: Volume stays fairly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up in the most recent days. The chart shows a tall green spike early in the window and a larger green bar during the rally, while the red and green bars through the final days are similar in size to earlier bars.

2023-05-08.kline: The window opens with a decline from the upper-middle of the range down to a low near the window bottom around the middle of the window, then a sustained rally of several days lifts price back to the top of the range. The rally recovers the full fall, and the latest green candle closes near the window high, so the shape is a V-style bottom with the latest close in the upper part of the range.

2023-05-09.kline: After an early dip to the lower part of the window, price rises in a series of green candles with small pullbacks, climbing toward the window high near the right side. The latest candle is a red day that sits in the upper part of the range, below the recent highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-05-09.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars are green up days in the early-middle and middle sections, while the most recent days show moderate, similar-sized bars including a red day.

2023-05-10.kline: Price dips to a low near the lower-middle of the window around the middle-left, then climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows to the window high near the right side. The latest candle is a small red day that sits in the upper part of the range, just below the recent highs, so the rise is intact with only a minor pullback.

2023-05-10.combined: The price rise is not clearly backed by heavier trading, since volume is flat while price climbs, so the uptrend is intact but lacks volume confirmation. A pickup in volume on up days would strengthen the case for continuation.

2023-05-11.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window from a low near the middle-left, with a strong rally into a high near the upper end of the range around the 16th-17th candles. The last few candles pull back modestly on red bodies but the latest close stays in the upper part of the range, so this is an uptrend with an inside pullback rather than a reversal or breakout.

2023-05-11.combined: Rising price over the window on roughly even volume gives only modest support to the uptrend, and the recent red pullback on steady volume does not show strong selling pressure. The pattern is intact but volume does not clearly confirm further upside.

The last four to five candles are red and pull back modestly, leaving the latest close in the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact despite the pullback.
