2023-05-12.combined: Rising prices on steady volume support the uptrend, but the flat volume shows no strong buying conviction behind the latest pullback. Watch whether volume expands on the next up days to confirm continuation.

2023-05-15.kline: After an early dip to a low near the middle-left of the window, price rallies through most of the 20 days, with a series of higher highs and the window high set near the right side. The latest green close sits in the upper part of the range but a little below the peak, so this is an uptrend with pullbacks rather than a breakout above the prior highs.
2023-05-15.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the first day and a tall green day around the middle stand out, while recent bars are moderate and similar in height to earlier ones, with no clear surge or drying up. Up and down days are mixed in volume terms, with red bars appearing at similar sizes to green bars in the latter half.
2023-05-15.combined: Price rising on steady, unremarkable volume suggests the uptrend is intact but lacks strong volume confirmation, so the move is orderly rather than driven by a surge of buying interest.

2023-05-16.kline: Price rises across most of the 20 days, from a low near the bottom of the range after an early red spike to a final tall green candle that closes in the upper part of the range, near the window high. Pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles in the middle and late window, are shallow and do not reverse the rise.
2023-05-16.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, matching the flat volume state. One tall green bar in the middle of the window stands out, while the most recent green up day is only moderate, and red down days are not clearly heavier than green up days.
2023-05-16.combined: Rising price with volume that is not expanding suggests a steady uptrend without strong conviction, and the latest close near the high is not confirmed by a volume surge, so it does not signal a breakout.

2023-05-17.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with a sequence of higher highs and higher lows. The last green candle closes at the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward. The latest close sits near the window high.
2023-05-17.volume: Volume stays roughly flat, with bar heights similar across the window. One tall green spike appears in the middle of the window, and the most recent green up days are about as large as the earlier bars, so there is no volume surge into the latest move.
2023-05-17.combined: Rising price to new highs on flat volume gives only weak confirmation of the breakout. Without expansion in volume on the up days, the move may lack conviction and needs follow-through volume to be trusted.

2023-05-18.kline: After a choppy, sideways start near the lower-middle of the range, price climbs in a series of higher highs and higher lows through the middle of the window. The final bar is a long green candle that closes at the top of the window and above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so price leaves the prior range upward.
2023-05-18.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish. The latest green bar is the tallest in the chart, but the overall volume level does not rise far above earlier days.
2023-05-18.combined: The upside breakout is supported by price but not by a clear volume surge, so the move is less strongly confirmed than a breakout on expanding volume. Follow-through over the next sessions would be needed to validate it.

2023-05-19.kline: Price starts low in the window, chops sideways with small bodies, then rises in steps to a sharp run over the last several days, with the rightmost bars reaching the window high. The latest green candle sits near the top of the range, and the last few closes leave the earlier range upward, so this is a breakout.
2023-05-19.volume: Volume was mostly moderate and red-heavy early in the window, then expanded: the last several bars, especially a tall green bar near the end and the high-volume green bars before the final red day, are clearly higher than the earlier bars, matching the expanding volume state.
2023-05-19.combined: Sharply rising price on clearly expanding volume, with heavy green bars on the up days, confirms the upward breakout from the prior range.

2023-05-22.kline: After a choppy stretch of mixed red and green candles through the middle of the window, price rallies sharply in the final days, with the last few green candles closing at or near the window high, well above the earlier range. The latest close sits at the very top of the range, so the move leaves the prior consolidation upward.
2023-05-22.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, and the most recent green days show the tallest bars, including a spike near the end that is clearly above the earlier levels. The surge is concentrated on the up days of the final rally.
2023-05-22.combined: Rising price on rapidly expanding volume confirms the upward breakout from the prior range, suggesting strong buying interest behind the move.

2023-05-23.kline: Price climbs in a staircase from the low left side of the window to the top right, with most of the rise coming in the last several days. A large green candle near the window high is followed by a few small red and green candles that hold near the top, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range just below the peak.
2023-05-23.volume: Volume expands, with the lower-left bars modest and the activity clearly heavier toward the right. The tallest green bar lines up with the big rally day near the top of the price range, and the following red bar is also elevated, while the final few bars stay above the early-window levels.
2023-05-23.combined: Rising price on rising volume, especially on the large green up day, supports the uptrend and suggests buying interest is strong. The small pullbacks near the top happen on comparable volume, so they look like consolidation within the rise rather than a reversal.

2023-05-24.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, with a choppy base early on and a steep advance into the final stretch. The window high sits near the right-center, and the latest green close is in the upper part of the range, about 70% up from the window low, after a small pullback from that high.
2023-05-24.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate and the most recent days are clearly larger, with the tallest bars at the right edge and near the peak. The latest up day has the largest volume, while the red pullback days carry heavy but smaller volume.
2023-05-24.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the uptrend, and the latest green day on the largest volume backs continuation. The heavy volume on the recent pullback days is a caution, but the overall pattern still points to an uptrend rather than a reversal.

2023-05-25.kline: Price climbed in a stair-step rise from the lower left through the middle of the window, and the 20 bars sat in a fairly compact band below the upper quarter of the chart. The rightmost bar is a red candle with long wicks that gaps far above every earlier high, so the latest close sits near the top of the window's range and clearly leaves the prior range upward.
2023-05-25.volume: Volume was flat-to-moderate through most of the window, with a few larger green days in the middle. The final bar's volume is far taller than any other bar in the window, a clear spike, and it is a red (down) day.
2023-05-25.combined: The breakout is supported by a volume spike, but the spike came on a red day with a long wick, so the close is weaker than the gap suggests. Follow-through on the next session with sustained volume would be needed to confirm the breakout.

2023-05-26.kline: Price drifts in a low, choppy range for most of the window, then climbs in the middle and late part on large green candles, with a gap-up candle near the 14th day. On the 19th day a red candle spikes with a long upper wick to the window high, far above the earlier range, and the latest green candle closes near the upper part of the range, well above the earlier highs, so price has left the prior range upward.
2023-05-26.volume: Volume is low and fairly even for most of the window, then rises into the last days. The tallest bar is a red down-day bar on the second-to-last day, a clear spike, and the final green up-day bar is also elevated, roughly half the spike.
2023-05-26.combined: The price breakout is supported by the volume spike, though the spike day closed red after a long upper wick, showing heavy selling near the highs. The elevated volume on the green final day suggests buyers are holding the move above the prior range, so the breakout looks credible but not yet fully confirmed.

2023-05-30.kline: Price drifted in a low, sideways-to-slightly-rising range for most of the window, then climbed steadily before gapping sharply higher in the final few sessions. The latest red candle closes near the top of the window's range, well above the earlier highs, so the price has left its prior range upward.
2023-05-30.volume: Volume was fairly steady and moderate through most of the window, then spiked to the tallest bar in the window on a green up day about three sessions from the end. The last two sessions traded at elevated but lower levels than the spike, with the most recent day a red bar of moderately high volume.
2023-05-30.combined: The sharp volume spike on a rising day alongside the upward gap and the close above the prior range supports the breakout, though the red latest session on still-elevated volume suggests some early profit-taking after the move.

2023-05-31.kline: After a gradual rise from the lower part of the 20-day range, price jumps sharply in the final few sessions and closes well above the earlier highs, which sat around the middle of the range. The latest close is red and sits in the upper part of the range, below the spike high near the top.
2023-05-31.volume: Volume expands clearly into the latest days, with the tallest bar of the window near the end, and the most recent sessions are red at high levels. Earlier in the window volume was modest and mixed between green and red days.
2023-05-31.combined: The breakout above the prior range is backed by a volume surge, which supports the move. However, the latest sessions are red on heavy volume, which suggests some selling pressure near the highs and makes confirmation less certain.

2023-06-01.kline: After a slow, mostly green climb from the lower part of the window, price gaps sharply higher in the final three to four sessions and closes well above the earlier highs, which sat roughly in the middle-to-upper part of the range. The latest close is near the upper end of the window's range, after a spike high on the second-to-last day.
2023-06-01.volume: Volume expands clearly in the final days: the second-to-last session shows the largest bar of the window, and the most recent sessions are well above the quiet early-window bars. Mixed red and green days appear in the recent stretch, with the biggest bars falling on the sharp up-move and the surge session itself being a red down day.
2023-06-01.combined: Price breaking above the prior range on sharply higher volume suggests the breakout is backed by strong participation. The heavy volume on the spike day, even on a red candle, shows active trading at the new levels, though the latest bar's volume is lower than the peak, so follow-through should be watched.

2023-06-02.kline: Price spent most of the early window in a low, tight range near the bottom, then gapped up over the last several sessions in a series of green and red candles, with the most recent candles sitting near the top of the window range. The latest close is red and near the window high, well above the earlier highs, so price has left its prior range upward; the candles show a long upper wick on the spike day.
2023-06-02.volume: Volume was moderate and fairly even early in the window, then rose sharply, with a very tall red bar on the spike day near the right-center and several elevated bars after it. The most recent bars remain well above the early-window average, consistent with expanding volume, and the big bars are mostly on the price-jump days.
2023-06-02.combined: Sharp upward price movement on rising volume supports the breakout out of the prior range, though the latest red day's volume is below the spike, so follow-through is less clear.

2023-06-05.kline: After a sideways base of small candles near the window low, price rallies sharply in the last several days with wide-range candles that leave the earlier range upward, forming a breakout shape. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, near the window high.
2023-06-05.volume: Volume expands: the early bars are low and uniform, while the largest spike of the window is a red day late in the rally, and several recent bars stay elevated before the final day eases somewhat.
2023-06-05.combined: Sharply rising price on expanding volume supports the breakout, though the modest final-day volume suggests some hesitation near the highs.

2023-06-06.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with small candles, then climbs in steps, with a sharp gap-up jump in the middle-right section to the top of the range. The window high is a long wick near the top of the chart, and the latest close sits about three-quarters of the way up the range, below that high. Because the last few days do not close clearly above the earlier highs, this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2023-06-06.volume: Volume is roughly flat: the bars are mostly moderate, with a single very tall red bar mid-to-late in the window and a few tall green bars around it. The most recent bars are similar in size to the early-window bars, so there is no clear volume expansion at the end.
2023-06-06.combined: Price is rising overall while volume stays at similar levels, so the uptrend is steady but shows no added conviction from volume. The large red volume spike on a down day suggests heavy selling was absorbed, and the recent flat volume does not confirm a new leg higher.

2023-06-07.kline: Price climbs from the lower-left of the window through a steady series of green candles to a peak near the window high around the 14th-15th bars, then pulls back. The latest red candle closes in the upper half of the range, well above the window low, so the rise holds and the pullback is not a reversal.
2023-06-07.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, in line with the flat state, though one tall red bar near the peak stands out. Up days and down days are mixed, with the largest bars coming on both green and red days around the peak.
2023-06-07.combined: The rise is supported by price, but flat volume means there is no clear surge of buying conviction behind the advance. The pullback after the peak is not accompanied by a volume spike, so the uptrend structure remains intact without strong confirmation.

2023-06-08.kline: The window starts near the lows, rises through a choppy base, then gaps sharply up in the middle-to-late part to reach the window high near the top of the chart. Price has pulled back slightly from that peak, and the latest close (a small green candle) sits in the upper part of the range, around three-quarters of the way up. The overall path is an uptrend, not a breakout, because the jump happened several days before the last few bars.
2023-06-08.volume: Volume is contracting as stated: the window's largest bar is a red down day about two-thirds of the way through, while the most recent bars are visibly lower and flatter, at roughly mid-height or below. The last few sessions show smaller bars on both green and red days.
2023-06-08.combined: The broader rise is intact, but volume fading into the latest days and a small pullback from the high suggest the uptrend is losing momentum rather than accelerating. The recent green close is not supported by a volume surge.

2023-06-09.kline: Price climbs from low levels on the left to a cluster of higher candles near the top of the window, with a few red pullback days inside the rise. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, well above the window low, so the trend is up with pullbacks rather than a reversal.
2023-06-09.volume: Volume is contracting: a single large red spike near the middle of the window is followed by smaller bars, and the most recent days trade noticeably lighter than that peak. Up and down days both show smaller volume toward the end, with the latest sessions near the low-to-mid level of the volume range.
2023-06-09.combined: Price is still rising overall, but the rise is occurring on shrinking volume after the high-volume selloff spike, which suggests weakening buying interest and that the uptrend lacks strong conviction for now.

2023-06-12.kline: Price climbs from a low near the left side of the window to a peak spike about two-thirds of the way across, with the window high at the top of the range. After that peak, the candles pull back and move sideways in the upper part of the range, with the latest green candle closing around the upper-middle to upper area of the range. The rise holds across most of the window, and the pullbacks don't change that, but the latest close is not above the prior high, so this is not a breakout.
2023-06-12.volume: Volume is contracting: a large red spike appears around the middle of the window, near the peak of the rally, followed by a clear decline to lower, fairly uniform bars over the most recent days. The largest volume bars come on red down days in the middle of the window, while the latest up days carry noticeably less volume.
2023-06-12.combined: The rise is still intact, but the shrinking volume on recent up days suggests the uptrend is losing momentum after the heavy-volume peak. Price is holding in the upper range without the volume expansion needed to confirm a new leg higher.

2023-06-13.kline: The window starts with a low cluster near the bottom-left, rises in stages through a choppy middle with some red pullbacks, and climbs to a higher cluster on the right. The latest green candle sits near the top of the range, near the window high but not clearly above the earlier peak wick, so this is a rising trend with pullbacks rather than a breakout.
2023-06-13.volume: Volume is contracting: the window opens with moderate bars, spikes sharply on one red down day near the middle-left, then steadily shrinks toward the right. The most recent bars are among the smallest of the window, and up and down days are both present at similar low levels.
2023-06-13.combined: Price rising overall while volume fades suggests the uptrend is losing conviction, so the advance is not being strongly backed by buying interest despite the higher close.

2023-06-14.kline: After a low start at the bottom left, price rose into a choppy middle section near the mid-range, with a red spike and wicks around the middle of the window. The last few green candles climbed to a new window high, with the latest close at the top of the range and above the earlier highs, so the price has broken out upward.
2023-06-14.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at similar heights through the window, with one tall red spike in the middle-left on a down day. The most recent green bars are only moderate and do not stand out from earlier days.
2023-06-14.combined: The upward breakout is not confirmed by volume, since the recent up days are no heavier than earlier ones. Price is leaving the prior range without a clear volume surge, so the breakout is weaker than it would be on expanding volume.

2023-06-15.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the range on the left, then climbs in steps through the middle of the window to a high near the top right. The last two green candles close above the highs of the earlier part of the window, including the mid-window peak, and the latest close sits near the top of the range, so the pattern is a breakout to the upside.
2023-06-15.volume: Volume stays at a similar level across the window, with no clear surge on the latest days. The tallest bars come in the middle-left (a red day on heavy volume), while the recent green up days show moderate volume about the same as earlier days.
2023-06-15.combined: Rising price on flat volume means the upside move is not clearly confirmed by heavier trading, so the breakout is less convincing and needs follow-through volume to validate it.

2023-06-16.kline: After a low cluster of small candles at the start of the window, price rallied in stages with a mid-window dip, then surged in the last few sessions to the top of the range. The two final green candles, followed by a red one, closed above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the latest close sits near the window high.
2023-06-16.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained expansion in the most recent days. A tall red spike occurred early on a down day, and the recent green up days show only moderate bars, similar in size to earlier sessions.
2023-06-16.combined: The price breakout above the prior range is not backed by a volume surge, so the move looks less convincing. Rising prices on flat volume suggest the breakout needs follow-through and confirmation from heavier volume.

2023-06-20.kline: After an early dip and a sideways stretch in the middle of the window, price rose through the last several days and the final candles closed above the earlier highs, including the spike high from the early-middle part of the window. The latest close sits near the top of the window range, so the price has left the prior range upward.
2023-06-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat: the tall red spike early in the window stands out, but the most recent bars are similar in height to the mid-window bars and do not show a clear surge. Up (green) days on the right are not noticeably heavier than the down (red) days.
2023-06-20.combined: The breakout is made on steady, not rising, volume, so the move is not strongly confirmed by participation. Price leaving the prior range is still the key signal, but traders would want to see volume expand on the breakout days to validate it.

2023-06-21.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with a few small candles, then rises in steps through the middle, with a brief spike and pullbacks along the way. The latest close, a small red candle, sits in the upper part of the range near the window high, after a series of higher highs and higher lows.
2023-06-21.volume: Volume is flat: the bars are similar in height across the window, with a tall red spike early on and no clear build-up in the most recent days. Volume does not rise noticeably on the strong up days near the end, so it shows no surge.
2023-06-21.combined: The rise is steady and ends near the top of the range, which supports an uptrend. Because volume is flat and does not expand on the latest advances, the move lacks volume confirmation, so the trend is less convincing than it would be on rising volume.

2023-06-22.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with a lone green candle at the low, then rises over most of the 20 days with a choppy middle section of small red and green candles and a few pullbacks. The highest highs sit near the top of the window in the last several days, and the most recent green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below those highs, so this is not a clear breakout above the prior range.
2023-06-22.volume: Volume is flat: the early window has a tall red spike, while the most recent days run at moderate levels similar to the middle of the window, with no clear surge on the latest up days.
2023-06-22.combined: Rising prices on roughly unchanged volume give a steady uptrend without strong volume confirmation, so the move looks orderly but not especially forceful.

2023-06-23.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with mixed candles, then rallies over most of the period, with the strongest green candles in the middle-to-late section and the window high set near the right side. The last few sessions show a modest pullback of red candles, but the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, well below the window high. This is a rise with a small pullback, not a reversal.
2023-06-23.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the leftmost bar is the largest, and the bars decline toward the right. The heaviest green (up-day) volume appears during the mid-window rally, while the most recent red down-days trade on noticeably lighter volume.
2023-06-23.combined: Price is trending higher on a contracting volume profile, so the rally lacks strong volume support for new highs. The recent pullback is occurring on light volume, which suggests mild selling pressure and an uptrend that is intact but not strongly confirmed.

2023-06-26.kline: The window starts with choppy, mostly lower-range trading, then rallies over several days from near the lower part of the range to a peak at the window high around the middle-late bars. The last 3-4 days give back roughly half of that rise in a series of red candles, forming an inverted-V shape, and the latest red close sits in the lower half of the range.
2023-06-26.volume: Volume is fairly even across the 20 days with no clear surge or drop. The tallest bars appear early in the window, the most recent days are moderate, and up (green) and down (red) days show similar volume heights.
2023-06-26.combined: The rally and the subsequent pullback occurred on similar volume, so the volume does not confirm a strong distribution or reversal. The top pattern is therefore a price-driven signal that would need further confirmation from volume on the next down days.

2023-06-27.kline: Price fell to a low near the middle of the window's left side, then rallied strongly to the window high around the 16th day, forming an inverted-V shape. A sharp multi-day pullback with large red candles followed and gave back much of the rally, leaving the latest green close around the middle of the range, just below the midpoint.
2023-06-27.volume: Volume is steady across the window with no major surge or drop-off, so the flat state holds. The largest bars sit on early red days and some rally-phase green days, while the most recent red days show moderate volume rather than a climax.
2023-06-27.combined: The rally carried price up on mostly green days with reasonable volume, but the pullback came without a clear volume spike, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. The pattern suggests a possible top forming that needs follow-through to be confirmed.

2023-06-28.kline: Price rallied from the lower part of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-to-late days, then pulled back roughly a third of that rise with mixed red and green candles. The latest close sits near the middle of the range, so the fall was too shallow to read as a reversal top and the price action is best described as sideways after the rally.
2023-06-28.volume: Volume is flat, with the opening red day standing out as the tallest bar and most later bars at similar moderate heights. Heavier green and red days are mixed through the window, so volume does not clearly rise on up days or fall on down days.
2023-06-28.combined: With flat volume, the rally and the partial pullback show no strong buying or selling conviction, so the sideways, range-bound reading is not confirmed by a directional volume trend.

2023-06-29.kline: Price rallies from the lower left into a peak near the upper part of the window, then falls back through a series of red candles that give back most of the rise. The latest candle is a red bar sitting around the middle of the range, slightly above the lower half, after a small bounce from the post-peak lows, so this reads as a rounded top with the close only partly recovered.
2023-06-29.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the most recent bars are about the same size as those earlier on, with the tallest bars appearing during the rally and the mid-window selling, and no clear spike or dry-up at the end. Red and green bars alternate in size without a sustained increase on down days.
2023-06-29.combined: Flat volume during the fall does not strongly confirm the top, so the reversal signal is only moderately supported. Heavy selling is not evident, so watch whether volume expands on the next down move to confirm the reversal.

2023-06-30.kline: Price falls over the first several days from near the upper-middle of the range to a low near the window low, then rallies for about a week to a high near the top of the window (a V-shaped recovery). The rally recovers the full earlier decline, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, below the window high.
2023-06-30.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or drop-off. The tallest bars come on several green up days during the rally, while the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier levels, so there is no sign of a volume build-up at the end.
2023-06-30.combined: The rebound from the low is supported by up-day volume during the rally, but the flat volume in the latest sessions gives only weak confirmation of the reversal. The pattern would be stronger if volume expanded on the final up days.

2023-07-03.kline: Price starts low, drops to a trough near the early-window low, then rallies sharply to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window. It then gives back much of that rise through a run of red candles, and the last few days show a small recovery. The latest close sits in the upper-middle part of the range, below the window high, in a choppy, sideways-to-mixed path with no clear direction.
2023-07-03.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with tall green and red bars spread throughout and no single day dominating. The most recent bar is short and red, so volume is not expanding into the latest move.
2023-07-03.combined: Choppy price swings with flat volume and no volume expansion on the latest up move suggest no decisive breakout or trend, so consolidation fits better than a confirmed uptrend.

2023-07-05.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window from a low near the left side to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-right, with a pullback of about a third of the rise in the red candles that follows. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, roughly two-thirds up, below the window high, so the rise has not broken out of the prior range.
2023-07-05.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars sit mid-window, and the most recent bars are moderate, with the final up day slightly above the average of the prior few days.
2023-07-05.combined: Price has risen with volume that is steady rather than expanding, so the rally looks orderly but lacks strong volume confirmation. The uptrend is intact as long as the latest close holds in the upper part of the range.

2023-07-06.kline: The window starts near the lows with a few red candles, then rises through green candles to a peak near the window high around two-thirds of the way through. A sharp red selloff takes price back to roughly the middle of the range, and a partial recovery with small green candles leaves the latest close in the upper part of the range, below the peak. Overall the price rises across most of the window, so this is an uptrend with a pullback inside it.
2023-07-06.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early and mid-window bars are tall, with the largest spikes on up days, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter. The latest down day shows a short red bar and the recent green bars are also lower than earlier ones.
2023-07-06.combined: Price is still higher over the window, but the recent recovery is happening on fading volume, which suggests the uptrend is losing momentum rather than accelerating.

2023-07-07.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then falls back over several red candles to about the lower-middle before recovering in the final days. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, below the window high but well above the midpoint, so the rise is still intact despite the pullback.
2023-07-07.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars are tall, with a peak roughly a third of the way through the window, while the most recent bars are noticeably shorter. Red and green days are mixed through the middle of the window, and the last few green days show modest volume.
2023-07-07.combined: Price has recovered toward the upper range on lighter volume than earlier in the window, so the advance lacks the volume support seen during the initial rally and the uptrend is weakening rather than strengthening.

2023-07-10.kline: Price starts near the window low, then rallies in a series of mostly green candles to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window. A pullback of several red candles gives back part of that rise, followed by a renewed advance that ends near the upper-middle of the range, with the latest red candle closing about two-thirds of the way up the window range. The pullback is shallow relative to the overall rise, so the pattern reads as an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2023-07-10.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars occur early in the window during the initial rally, while the most recent days show clearly lower bars. Several down days in the pullback carried moderate volume, and the recent up and down days both show smaller volume than the earlier peaks.
2023-07-10.combined: Price is still making higher levels overall, but it is doing so on shrinking volume, which suggests the advance is losing conviction. Without a volume surge on the recent up days, the uptrend is intact but not strongly confirmed.

2023-07-11.kline: Price rallied sharply from near the window low to a high near the top of the range, then fell back to about the lower-middle with a large red drop, and has since chopped sideways with small bounces. The latest red close sits roughly 60% up the range, so the drop did not clearly reverse the rally and no clear direction has emerged.
2023-07-11.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars cluster in the early rally and the mid-window selloff, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter. The latest red day is moderate in size, and the recent up and down days show no volume surge.
2023-07-11.combined: Falling volume alongside sideways, choppy price action suggests the market lacks conviction in either direction, consistent with consolidation rather than a confirmed breakout or breakdown.

2023-07-12.kline: Price fell from a high near the window top in the early-middle part of the window to a low around the middle-late section, forming a V-shaped bottom. Over the last few days it rallied through several green candles and the latest green candle closes near the top of the 20-day range, recovering most of the earlier decline.
2023-07-12.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars sit in the first half of the window, while the most recent days show much smaller bars, with only a modest uptick on the latest green day. The most recent up days carry noticeably less volume than the heavy selling days earlier in the window.
2023-07-12.combined: The rebound from the lows is coming on lighter volume than the earlier decline, so the recovery lacks strong participation and is less convincing as a confirmed bottom. The V-shaped reversal is still present in price, but it needs volume to expand on follow-through days to be confirmed.

2023-07-13.kline: After a decline from the upper-left area to a low near the lower-middle of the window, price recovered through several green and red candles. The final bar is a long green candle that closes at the top of the window, clearly above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it is a breakout from the prior range, with the latest close near the window high.
2023-07-13.volume: Volume is flat: the most recent bars are about as large as the earlier bars, with the tallest volume bars on the left side of the window. The final up day shows no clear spike and is about the same height as the surrounding bars, so volume does not stand out on the breakout day.
2023-07-13.combined: The upward breakout is not confirmed by volume, since the rise to the window high came on ordinary volume rather than an expansion. The breakout is therefore weaker evidence and would need follow-through on higher volume to be trusted.

2023-07-14.kline: After a decline to a low near the lower-middle of the window, price rallied in the final few days, with a large green candle pushing up to the upper part of the range and the rightmost red candle printing a long upper wick to the window high. The last close sits in the upper part of the range, just below that high, so price has left the earlier range upward.
2023-07-14.volume: Volume is flat: recent days are about the same size as earlier in the window, with no sustained surge. The last bar is tall and red, which stands out, but the green up-days just before it are only moderate.
2023-07-14.combined: The price move above the earlier range is not backed by a clear volume expansion, so the breakout is only weakly confirmed. Follow-through on the next session would be needed to validate it.

2023-07-17.kline: Price fell from the early part of the window to a low near the bottom of the range, then rallied steadily from about the 11th bar, with a large green candle and a spike high on the second-to-last day. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, above the highs of the earlier window, so price has left the prior range upward.
2023-07-17.volume: Volume is roughly flat: the first day's bar is the tallest, volume fades through the middle of the window, and the most recent days return to levels similar to earlier bars without a clear surge. The up days at the end do not stand out against the rest of the window.
2023-07-17.combined: Price closing above the earlier range on only average volume suggests a breakout that lacks strong volume confirmation, so it needs follow-through on higher volume to be convincing.

2023-07-18.kline: Price fell for about ten sessions from near the upper-middle of the range to a low near the bottom, then rose in a V-shaped recovery. The last three candles push well above the highs of the early and middle window, with the latest green close near the window high, so the price has left the prior range upward.
2023-07-18.volume: Volume is expanding: the early and middle sessions show mixed bars, while the most recent sessions are tall, including a very tall red bar before the final green bars that are also high. Volume rises into the breakout days, with the largest bars around the late-window up moves.
2023-07-18.combined: Rising price on rising volume during the final sessions supports the breakout, suggesting buyers are driving the move above the prior range.

2023-07-19.kline: Price falls for about nine days from the left side to a trough near the middle-left, then rallies for several days to finish near the top of the window, forming a V-shaped double-bottom-like recovery. The rally recovers more than half of the decline, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below the recent high.
2023-07-19.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the highest bars appearing on the sharp rally and the late-window moves rather than during the early decline. Several green up days in the rally carry above-average volume, and the most recent days stay well above the quiet early-window bars.
2023-07-19.combined: Rising prices on rising volume during the rebound support a bottom reversal, with buyers stepping in more strongly as the trend turned up. The latest red day on still-elevated volume suggests some near-term selling pressure, so confirmation depends on the next few sessions holding the recovery.

2023-07-20.kline: Price spent the first half of the window in a low, choppy range with small red and green candles, then broke upward over the last several bars. A large green candle and a tall spike with a long upper wick near the window high pushed well above the earlier highs. The latest candle is a red day that pulled back, leaving the close in the upper part of the range but below the spike high.
2023-07-20.volume: Volume expands clearly in the second half of the window. The tallest bar is a red day near the breakout spike, and the recent bars stay well above the quiet early-window volume, with the latest day also elevated.
2023-07-20.combined: Heavy volume on the up-move and the spike supports the upward break out of the prior range. The red pullback on still-elevated volume is a caution that the breakout needs to hold above the prior range to be confirmed.

2023-07-21.kline: After a steep rally from the lower part of the window to a peak near the window high, price fell over the last several days in a head-and-shoulders-like top with a sharp final red candle. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, having given back more than half of the rise.
2023-07-21.volume: Volume was modest through most of the window, with a large red spike on the most recent day that towers over the earlier bars. The spike falls on a down day, and a tall red bar also appears near the middle of the window.
2023-07-21.combined: A high-volume down day after a rally into the top of the range suggests distribution and supports a reversal from the top. The selling pressure looks heavier than the buying that drove the rise.

2023-07-24.kline: After a choppy start near the window low, price climbed in a series of larger green candles to a spike high near the right side, then fell over the last few sessions with red candles. The pullback gave back more than half of the rise, leaving the latest close a little above the middle of the range, so the top shape is only partly formed.
2023-07-24.volume: Volume spikes on one of the last three days, when a tall red bar far above the window's typical level marks heavy selling. Volume was mostly moderate during the rise, and the sell-off days carry the largest bars, so the spike lines up with down days.
2023-07-24.combined: Heavy volume on the decline alongside falling price suggests distribution after the rally, which supports a reversal from the top. The latest close is not yet clearly in the lower half, so confirmation would need further weakness.

2023-07-25.kline: The window starts low with small candles, rises steadily through the middle, and peaks near the top of the range around the 15th day before pulling back on red candles. The latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, so the rise is still intact despite the pullback.
2023-07-25.volume: Volume is mostly moderate during the rise, with a clear spike on a red down day about three bars from the end, far above the window's typical level. The most recent green day trades on noticeably lower volume than that spike.
2023-07-25.combined: The heavy volume on the down-day spike suggests selling pressure during the pullback, while the lighter volume on the latest up day means buyers are not yet confirming a renewed advance, so the uptrend looks weaker but not broken.

2023-07-26.kline: Price rises from near the window low through a large green candle to a high near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then pulls back in a series of red candles before a small bounce. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, so the net move is up despite the pullback.
2023-07-26.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the bars stay at similar heights, with one tall red spike near the middle-to-late part of the window and a few modest green bars on the advancing days. Volume does not clearly expand or shrink from the early days to the recent days.
2023-07-26.combined: Rising prices on roughly steady volume give a modest, unconfirmed uptrend, and the pullback without a volume surge leaves the trend intact but not strongly supported.

2023-07-27.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from the lower part of the range with small candles and then climbing through a strong rally of tall green candles to a peak near the window high, with a long upper wick marking the top. After the peak, a few red candles pull back to about the middle of the range, and the latest candles recover into the upper-middle part of the range, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range.
2023-07-27.volume: Volume is flat, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days compared with earlier in the window. The chart shows a mix of green and red bars of similar height, with one tall red spike mid-to-late in the window on a down day, while green up days are generally moderate and consistent.
2023-07-27.combined: The rising price path on mostly steady volume suggests the uptrend is intact but without strong volume conviction behind the latest advance. The large red volume spike on a down day during the pullback suggests some selling pressure, so the pattern is best read as a continuing uptrend rather than a confirmed breakout.

2023-07-28.kline: Price starts near the bottom of the window with small-bodied candles, then rallies sharply through a large green candle to a high near the top of the range around the middle-right of the window. A pullback of several red candles gives back only a modest part of that rise, and the latest candle is a small green close in the upper part of the range, well above the window low.
2023-07-28.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. The clearest spike is a tall red bar in the middle-to-late part of the window, on a down day during the pullback, while recent bars are moderate and close to earlier levels.
2023-07-28.combined: The higher lows and the latest close in the upper range support an uptrend, but volume is not expanding on the recent up days, so the advance lacks strong volume confirmation. The pullback's largest volume came on a down day, which is a mild caution rather than a sign of reversal.

2023-07-31.kline: Price rose from near the window low to near the window high, with a sharp green rally, a long-wicked spike high, and a pullback of several red candles in the middle. The latest candles recover into the upper part of the range, about 20% below the window high, so the rise is intact.
2023-07-31.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest volume bar is a red day in the middle-to-late window, and the most recent bars are visibly smaller, with alternating green and red days at lower levels.
2023-07-31.combined: Price is still rising overall while volume shrinks, so the uptrend is losing momentum on the latest days. The pattern is still an uptrend rather than a reversal, but the falling volume leaves it less convincing.

2023-08-01.kline: Price starts near the window low with small choppy candles, then rallies sharply on a large green candle to a peak near the window high around the middle of the window. A sizable red pullback follows, sliding to roughly the middle of the range, before a bounce with small green candles pushes the latest close into the upper part of the range.
2023-08-01.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the large red spike on the sell-off near the peak is the heaviest day, while the most recent bars are visibly smaller, mostly green with lower volume than the mid-window selling.
2023-08-01.combined: The net rise from the window low and the recovery into the upper range suggest the uptrend remains intact, but the shrinking volume on the latest up days shows weaker buying conviction after the heavy selling, so the pattern needs confirmation.

2023-08-02.kline: Price climbs from near the window low over the first several days to a high in the upper part of the range, then turns down with a choppy decline and a partial rebound, and the final red candle drops sharply to leave the latest close in the lower half of the range. The rise is only partly given back, and the close sits well below the window high, so this reads as a top rather than a clean downtrend.
2023-08-02.volume: Volume contracts over the most recent days compared with the earlier part of the window, where the largest spike occurred in the middle-to-late stretch. The last few bars are visibly smaller, with the final red bar being the one notable exception.
2023-08-02.combined: The price peak came on heavier volume and the subsequent decline has come on lighter volume, which suggests waning buying interest behind the top. The contracting volume means the reversal is not strongly confirmed by selling pressure yet.

2023-08-03.kline: Price rallied from the lower-middle of the window to a spike high near the top of the range around the 8th day, then fell back in a series of red candles with small bounces, reaching a low near the bottom of the range around the 18th day. The latest green candle bounces modestly, leaving the close in the lower half of the range, so the pattern reads as an inverted-V style top that gave back most of the rally.
2023-08-03.volume: Volume is contracting: the largest bar is a red spike around the 8th day, which is the peak of the rally, and volume then falls off through the decline. The recent bars are mostly smaller than the early and mid-window bars, with only a moderate rebound on the final day, so the decline and bounce are occurring on lighter participation.
2023-08-03.combined: The high-volume spike at the top followed by fading volume on the decline and the weak final bounce suggests selling pressure has faded without a strong recovery, which supports the reversal top but does not yet confirm a new downtrend.

2023-08-04.kline: Price starts low, rallies over the first half of the window to a spike high near the top of the range, then trades choppy and sideways with wide swings and no sustained direction. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, well below the window high and not above the prior highs.
2023-08-04.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the tallest bar, a red down day, comes mid-window, and the most recent sessions show clearly smaller bars than the earlier spikes, with the last few days near the low end of the scale.
2023-08-04.combined: Sideways price action on shrinking volume suggests a pause without conviction rather than a breakout or breakdown. Nothing in the recent bars shows volume expanding in either direction, so the range is likely to persist until a decisive move appears.

2023-08-07.kline: Price rises from a low near the window's left side to a peak in the upper part of the range around the middle-early candles, then falls over several red sessions with a deep low near the window's right side. The latest candle is a green rebound that sits roughly around the middle of the range, so the rise is only partly recovered and the latest close is not clearly in the upper half.
2023-08-07.volume: Volume is contracting: a large red spike appears in the middle of the window, and the most recent bars are visibly smaller and mostly lower than earlier bars. The recent bars alternate between green and red without any surge.
2023-08-07.combined: The price peak followed by a multi-day decline on a volume spike, then a weaker rebound on shrinking volume, suggests the rally is losing momentum and a top may be forming. Because the latest volume is light, the rebound lacks conviction, so the reversal is tentative rather than confirmed.

2023-08-08.kline: Price is choppy across the 20 days, with a rise from the early candles to a peak around the fifth to sixth candles, a fall to a low zone near the middle, a partial recovery, and a sharp red drop near the late-middle candles that was only partly reclaimed. The latest candle is a small red bar sitting roughly in the middle of the range, with no clear net direction.
2023-08-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat, with most bars at moderate levels and one tall red spike around the eighth candle that stands out. Recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones, with no sustained surge or drop, and up and down days show similar volume.
2023-08-08.combined: Sideways price action on flat volume suggests no strong conviction from either buyers or sellers, consistent with consolidation rather than a breakout or trend.

2023-08-09.kline: Price rises from the middle of the window to a peak near the upper part of the range, then falls over roughly the last 8 to 10 sessions in an inverted-V shape. The fall gives back more than the whole earlier rise, and the latest close sits near the bottom of the range, close to the window low.
2023-08-09.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge. The tallest red bars come early and around the middle of the window, while the most recent sessions show moderate volume similar to earlier days, with no climax on the final decline.
2023-08-09.combined: Price has turned down and closed near the lows, but volume is not expanding on the decline, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume. The falling price on steady volume suggests a weakening rally rather than a heavy-volume capitulation.

2023-08-10.kline: Price falls from the upper left of the window toward the lower right, with several bounces along the way, including a sharp red drop near the end. The latest candle is a small green day sitting near the window low, so the close is in the lower part of the range.
2023-08-10.volume: Volume is flat across the window: bar heights are similar early and late, with the tallest bar a red down day in the earlier part of the window. The final green bar is moderate, not a spike, and the heavier bars fall on both up and down days.
2023-08-10.combined: The falling price path with no clear volume expansion suggests the decline lacks strong conviction, and the small green bounce on the last day is not confirmed by rising volume. The downtrend remains the dominant read unless volume picks up on the upside.

2023-08-11.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, falls in a series of red candles with a few small green bounces, and then drops sharply in the final 1-2 sessions. The last red candle closes well below the lows of the earlier window, near the bottom of the range, so the window leaves its prior range to the downside.
2023-08-11.volume: Volume is flat overall, with bars of similar size across the window and no sustained surge. The tallest bar is an early red day, and the most recent red day is only moderate, so the final drop does not come with a volume spike.
2023-08-11.combined: The price break below the prior lows is not confirmed by heavier volume, which weakens the breakdown signal. Traders would want to see volume expand on the downside to treat the move as a convincing breakdown.

2023-08-14.kline: The window falls from the upper left to the lower right with several small bounces, including a green rebound mid-window. The final candle is a large green day that rises sharply off the window low but stays in the lower-middle part of the range, below the early-window highs. The latest close sits roughly 45% up from the window low, so the broader fall still dominates.
2023-08-14.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest red bar early in the window is the main spike, and the most recent days are at moderate levels similar to earlier bars. The final green day's volume is about average, not a clear expansion.
2023-08-14.combined: A sharp green bounce on only average volume suggests the rebound lacks conviction and does not yet confirm a reversal. The downtrend structure remains intact unless the price reclaims the prior highs on expanding volume.

2023-08-15.kline: Price fell for much of the window from near the top of the range to a low near the bottom, then formed a V shape with a large green candle that rallied sharply off that low. The latest candle is a small red day that closes in the upper half of the range, having recovered more than half of the decline.
2023-08-15.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the early bars include a large red spike, the middle bars are moderate, and the most recent bars, including the large green rally day and the tall final bar, are clearly higher than the earlier mid-window volume. Up days such as the rally candle carry the heavier volume.
2023-08-15.combined: The rally on rising volume supports the bottoming signal, suggesting buyers are stepping in with conviction. The latest small red day on still-elevated volume suggests some profit-taking, so the recovery is not yet confirmed as a sustained trend.

2023-08-16.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from highs near the top of the range early on to lows near the bottom late in the window. A sharp green rebound in the last few days recovers part of the drop, but the latest red close sits in the lower part of the range, so the bounce does not change the downtrend.
2023-08-16.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the most recent days clearly heavier than the early bars. The tallest bar is an early red down day, and several later red and green bars run well above the mid-window levels, including a tall green bar on the late rebound.
2023-08-16.combined: Heavier volume on the down days confirms selling pressure within the downtrend. The large green rebound on elevated volume is a notable counterpoint, so the next few sessions will show whether buyers can sustain the recovery.

2023-08-17.kline: Price falls across most of the window from near the upper area to the window low, then bounces sharply in the last several days, led by a tall green candle near the lows. The latest close sits about midway to upper-middle of the range, after recovering roughly half or more of the earlier decline, so this reads as a V-shaped reversal bottom rather than a breakout.
2023-08-17.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the oldest bar is very large, the middle bars are moderate, and the most recent bars are the tallest, with the tall green day and the bars after it showing clearly higher volume than the early-middle sessions.
2023-08-17.combined: The rising price on higher volume during the rebound supports the bounce as a genuine reversal attempt, though the latest close is not yet at the window high, so confirmation is still incomplete.

2023-08-18.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, falls across most of the 20 days with a few bounces, and bottoms near the window low around the middle-to-late bars, followed by a sharp rebound. The latest green candle closes in the lower half of the range, roughly halfway down from the window high, so the fall still dominates and the rebound does not recover half the decline.
2023-08-18.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are modest, while the most recent days show the tallest volume bars, including several red down-day bars and the tall green bar at the end. The volume chart confirms that activity is clearly higher in the latest stretch.
2023-08-18.combined: Heavy volume on the recent red down days confirms active selling pressure within the downtrend. The latest green day on higher volume hints at a bounce attempt, but it is not yet strong enough to change the downtrend.

2023-08-21.kline: The window starts in the upper-middle of the range, falls through several red candles, and bottoms with a long red-then-small-green stretch near the window low. The final bar is a very large green candle that opens near the lows and closes near the top of the window's range, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range. The rebound is a single day rather than several, so this reversal shape is only partly confirmed.
2023-08-21.volume: Volume expands into the end of the window: the most recent bars, especially the final large green day, are among the tallest in the chart, well above the quieter early and middle bars. The biggest volume bars line up with the largest price moves, both the mid-window selloff and the final surge.
2023-08-21.combined: Heavy volume on the final rebound day suggests real buying interest behind the reversal, which supports a bottom forming. Confirmation would require follow-through on several more days of rising price and volume.

2023-08-22.kline: Price fell from the middle of the window to a low near the bottom around the 15th day, then rallied through several days of mostly green candles. The latest day is a red candle whose high reaches the window's top, and its close sits in the upper part of the range, recovering most of the earlier decline. The price path is a V-shaped recovery, but the latest close stays below the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it is not a breakout.
2023-08-22.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the bars on the right side clearly taller than the early bars. The tallest recent bars are green and red alternating with several large bars near the end, and the latest bar is the largest, a red down day that still sits on heavy volume.
2023-08-22.combined: Rising prices on rising volume in the recovery suggest a genuine bottoming rally, but the latest red day on the highest volume shows sellers are active near the window high. This supports a reversal from the lows rather than a confirmed breakout.

2023-08-23.kline: Price fell in a steep, multi-day slide from the upper-left area to a low near the window's middle-right, then rebounded sharply over several days, with the latest candles near the top of the range. The rebound recovers most of the decline and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2023-08-23.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the most recent days clearly higher than the early bars. The tallest bars cluster in the rebound and include both green up days and red down days, and the final bars are among the largest on the chart.
2023-08-23.combined: Heavier volume on the rebound supports the recovery, but the mix of red and green high-volume days shows the buying is not yet one-sided, so the V-shaped reversal needs follow-through to be confirmed.

2023-08-24.kline: Price fell from the upper-middle of the window to a low near the bottom in the middle of the window, marked by a large green candle, then rose over the following days into a V-shaped bottom. The latest candle is a tall red bar that opened near the window high and closed about two-thirds of the way up the range, so the latest close sits in the upper half but is not clearly above the earlier highs.
2023-08-24.volume: Volume is low to moderate through most of the window, then the final bar spikes far above the recent levels, matching the volume state. That spike falls on a red down day, the same day the price made the window high.
2023-08-24.combined: The V-shaped recovery is supported by volume rising through the rally, but the latest spike on a red day suggests heavy selling into the highs, so the reversal needs confirmation on the next session.

2023-08-25.kline: Price climbed from a low near the bottom of the window in a series of mostly green candles, with small pullbacks along the way, and reached its highest point at the second-to-last day, near the window high. The latest day is a red candle that closed lower but still sits in the upper part of the range, so the rise dominates the window.
2023-08-25.volume: Volume rises through the window and spikes on the second-to-last day, which is the tallest bar, while the latest day's volume stays high but below that peak. The biggest volume comes on a red day, and the elevated volume on the last red day shows heavy selling after the rally.
2023-08-25.combined: Rising prices on mostly rising volume support the uptrend, but heavy volume on the high and the red latest day suggests distribution and a possible pause. Confirmation would need the next close to hold above the recent highs.

2023-08-28.kline: Price fell from the early part of the window to a low near the middle-left, marked by a tall green candle at the bottom, then rallied over the last several sessions to a tall red spike near the window high before easing slightly. The latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, so this forms a V-shaped reversal bottom that recovered the full decline.
2023-08-28.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the early bars are modest, while the last several bars are clearly taller, with the largest spike on the tall red candle near the window high. Up days in the rally are mostly green with growing volume, and the most recent sessions keep volume elevated.
2023-08-28.combined: Rising prices on rising volume during the recovery suggest the reversal from the decline has real buying interest behind it. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, but the red down day on heavy volume near the high shows some selling pressure, so confirmation is not yet complete.

2023-08-29.kline: Price fell for roughly the first half of the window, forming a V-shaped bottom near the middle-left, then rallied over the following days and recovered past the starting level. The latest candle is a green day near the top of the range, below the tall red high set earlier in the rally, so it is a V-shaped reversal rather than a breakout.
2023-08-29.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, while the bars from the rally onward are taller, with the tallest red bar near the late-middle of the rally and several tall green bars among the most recent days. Green up days carry most of the larger recent volume.
2023-08-29.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume support the V-shaped reversal from the bottom, with buyers becoming more active as the rally progressed. The latest close near the top of the range confirms the recovery, though the tall earlier red day shows sellers were still active near the highs.

2023-08-30.kline: The price falls for about the first ten days from the upper-middle of the range to a low near the bottom of the window, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then rises over several days, with tall green candles, and recovers the full decline, so the latest close sits near the window high in the upper part of the range.
2023-08-30.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the earlier days moderate and the recent days clearly higher. The tallest red bar, a heavy-volume down day, appears in the upper-middle of the window, and the recent green rally days carry large volume bars.
2023-08-30.combined: Heavy volume on the rally days alongside the recovery to the upper range supports a bottoming reversal, though the heavy red volume spike during the rebound shows that sellers were active at higher prices.

2023-08-31.kline: Price falls from the middle of the range to a low near the 9th to 10th candles, forming a V-shaped bottom, then rises for about ten days and recovers most of the decline. The latest close is a small red candle in the upper part of the range, just below a tall red spike near the window high.
2023-08-31.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge or drop-off in recent days. The tallest bar is a red down day in the middle-to-late window, and the green up days during the rally are of similar size to the red days.
2023-08-31.combined: The V-shaped recovery is not backed by a volume surge, so the rebound looks like a broad, steady recovery rather than a strongly confirmed reversal. The latest red day in the upper range is a sign of hesitation near the highs.
