2024-04-11.kline: Price rallied from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high around bars 9-11, with a cluster of green candles including a tall wick at the top. It then fell over roughly six to seven sessions, giving back the whole rally and reaching near the window low before a partial bounce into the final green candle. The latest close sits near the middle of the range, so this is a rally-then-fall top rather than a clean breakout or breakdown.
2024-04-11.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop-off, which fits the flat state. The tallest bars are early in the window, and the most recent days show moderate volume with a few red and green bars of similar size.
2024-04-11.combined: The price peak followed by a deep decline with flat volume gives no clear volume confirmation of the reversal. The partial recovery on steady volume suggests the top is not yet strongly confirmed and needs follow-through to hold.

2024-04-12.kline: Price rises from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high around the 9th-10th candles, then falls for several sessions down to near the window low around the 16th-17th candles. A small bounce follows, but the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, so the rally is largely given back in an inverted-V shape.
2024-04-12.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars sit near the left side and the most recent bars are similar in height, with red and green days mixed throughout.
2024-04-12.combined: The rise and fall occurred on similar volume, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest close in the lower half after giving back the rally suggests a top, but the flat volume means it is not strongly confirmed.

2024-04-15.kline: Price rallies from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the top around the middle of the window, then falls for roughly ten days in an inverted V shape, giving back most of the gain. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2024-04-15.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the early bars are tall, the middle bars are somewhat lower, and the most recent bars are close to the earlier average, with no clear surge or drop. Large red and green bars appear on both up and down days, so no single side dominates.
2024-04-15.combined: The decline from the peak is not accompanied by a volume surge, so the top looks like a gradual fade rather than a high-volume reversal. The flat volume means the reversal signal is not strongly confirmed by participation.

2024-04-16.kline: Price rises from about the middle of the window to a high near the top of the range around the middle-right section, forming a rounded, inverted-V shape. It then falls for several days, giving back most of the rise and reaching near the window low before a small green bounce. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range.
2024-04-16.volume: Volume stays fairly flat across the window, with bars of similar height and no sustained surge. The tallest bar is the first day, and the lowest is a red down day near the middle-right, while the most recent bars remain moderate and similar to earlier levels.
2024-04-16.combined: Price rose and then fell back into the lower range on volume that did not expand meaningfully, so the top is not strongly confirmed by volume. The reversal reads as a tentative distribution pattern rather than a high-conviction one.

2024-04-17.kline: Price starts with a brief rally to the window high in the first few bars, then makes a series of lower highs and lower lows across most of the 20 days. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so this is a downtrend with small bounces along the way.
2024-04-17.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars cluster in the early part of the window, while the most recent days are at moderate levels, with a few red down-day bars standing out mid-to-late in the window.
2024-04-17.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest a persistent but not capitulating sell-off, so the downtrend is intact without clear signs of exhaustion or a reversal.

2024-04-18.kline: Price staircases down across most of the 20-day window, from a high cluster of green and red candles on the left to lower lows toward the right, with short green bounces along the way that do not reverse the fall. The window high sits near the left side and the latest close is in the lower part of the range, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2024-04-18.volume: Volume stays roughly the same across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days compared with earlier ones. The tallest bars appear early and on some red down days, while many green up days carry moderate volume, so the chart shows no clear expansion.
2024-04-18.combined: Falling price on steady, unremarkable volume suggests a gradual downtrend without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. Without rising volume on the down days, the decline lacks confirmation of a capitulation or a breakdown.

2024-04-19.kline: The window starts with higher prices and then falls in a staircase pattern with small bounces, ending in a large red candle on the latest day. That last close sits near the bottom of the 20-day range and below the lows of the earlier window, so price leaves the prior range downward.
2024-04-19.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish and no sustained surge. The latest red bar is the tallest in the chart, but it is not much above the earlier bars, so it does not stand out from the rest of the window.
2024-04-19.combined: A large down day on volume that is only about average suggests the breakdown has price behind it but lacks strong volume confirmation. A follow-through move on higher volume would make the breakdown more convincing.

2024-04-22.kline: The window starts near the top of the range and falls through most of the period with several small bounces, then a large red candle in the last few sessions drops to the lowest level of the window, closing below the earlier lows. The latest candle is a small green bounce that sits near the bottom of the range, so the close is in the lower part of the range.
2024-04-22.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the recent sessions. A few taller red bars appear near the end, but they do not form a clear sustained rise above the earlier level.
2024-04-22.combined: The breakdown to new lows is not backed by a sustained volume increase, so its conviction is limited. The small green bounce on the latest day has no volume surge behind it, which suggests it may be a minor relief bounce rather than a reversal.

2024-04-23.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from a high near the top of the range, with small bounces along the way. The latest bars drop to near the window low, and the most recent green candle sits in the lower part of the range, so the last close is in the lower portion of the range.
2024-04-23.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the earlier bars are mostly moderate, while the tallest bar is a red down day in the latter part of the window, with another high green bar nearby. The most recent days carry clearly higher volume than the start of the window.
2024-04-23.combined: Heavy volume on the large down days alongside the falling price supports the downtrend, showing sellers are active with conviction. The green bounce on the latest day is less certain, since its volume does not yet show a clear reversal in direction.

2024-04-24.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range at the start to a low near the bottom, with several small green bounces along the way that do not reverse the decline. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so the pattern is a downtrend rather than a reversal or breakdown.
2024-04-24.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the earlier bars are mostly moderate, while the largest bar sits near the right side and the most recent bars are also tall. The tallest spikes fall on red down days, while the green up days carry smaller volume.
2024-04-24.combined: Falling prices on rising volume, concentrated on down days, suggest sustained selling pressure and confirm the downtrend. Without a clear break below an earlier low or a strong reversal candle on heavy volume, there is no sign of a bottom yet.

2024-04-25.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting from the upper left with a few small green and red candles, then dropping through a series of mostly red candles to the window low near the bottom right. The last few days show a modest green bounce, but the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high, so this is a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2024-04-25.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are fairly uniform, while the most recent days show larger red bars, with the tallest spike on a red down day near the right side. The latest green day shows moderate volume, lower than the recent selling bars.
2024-04-25.combined: Heavier volume on the falling red candles confirms that selling pressure is driving the decline. The bounce on lighter volume suggests weak buying interest, so the downtrend looks intact unless price recovers on rising volume.

2024-04-26.kline: The window starts near the upper part of the range and drifts lower with a steep decline through the middle and late sections, bottoming near the window low about three-quarters of the way through. A rebound of several green candles then climbs back to the upper part of the range, with the latest close near the top of the window and recovering most of the prior fall, which fits a V-shaped double bottom style reversal.
2024-04-26.volume: Volume stays broadly even across the 20 days, consistent with the flat volume state, with no sustained surge. The tallest bar is a red down-day spike in the late-middle section, while the final days show moderate green bars of similar size to earlier bars.
2024-04-26.combined: The rebound to the upper range is not clearly backed by rising volume, so the reversal lacks volume confirmation. Price recovery on steady, unremarkable volume suggests a tentative bottom that needs follow-through on higher volume to be trusted.

2024-04-29.kline: Price fell sharply over roughly the middle of the window from near the upper range to a low near the bottom around the 14th-15th candles, then rebounded in a V-shaped recovery over the last five or six days. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range, having recovered roughly two-thirds of the decline.
2024-04-29.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, consistent with the flat volume state, with no sustained surge or drop. The most notable bar is a tall red down-day spike in the middle of the window, while the recent green up-days show moderate, not heavier, volume.
2024-04-29.combined: The rebound off the low is not backed by a clear increase in volume, so the V-shaped recovery is only partly confirmed. The reversal signal is credible on price alone, but it needs follow-through on rising volume to be trusted.

2024-04-30.kline: Price fell from the early highs through a series of lower highs and lows to a sharp low near the middle-late part of the window, then rebounded in a V-shaped recovery over the last six or so sessions. The rebound has recovered roughly three-quarters of the decline, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the window range, just below its highs.
2024-04-30.volume: Volume is broadly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the most recent days compared with earlier ones. The tallest red bar appears on the sell-off low day, and the rebound days show mostly green bars of similar size to the earlier sessions.
2024-04-30.combined: The recovery is occurring on volume that is not clearly expanding, so the rebound lacks strong volume confirmation. The V-shaped price move fits a reversal bottom, but the flat volume means buyers are not yet showing a decisive increase in participation.

2024-05-01.kline: The window starts near the top of its range and falls across most of the 20 days, with a sharp red drop to the window low around the middle-to-late section. Small green bounces follow, but the latest red candle closes in the lower-middle of the range, below the midpoint, so the fall is not reversed.
2024-05-01.volume: Volume is flat, with bars at similar heights across most of the window and no sustained build-up or fade. The tallest bar is a red down day at the sharp drop, and the recent days show a mix of green and red bars of similar size.
2024-05-01.combined: Price is falling with volume roughly steady, so the downtrend lacks strong volume conviction. The recent bounces on mixed volume do not yet show a reversal.

2024-05-02.kline: Price falls for about six candles from near the top of the window into a sharp V-shaped low near the window's bottom, then rebounds for several days and recovers roughly 80% of the decline, peaking near the upper part of the range. The latest green candle sits in the upper half of the range after a small pullback, so the V-shaped reversal bottom is the best fit.
2024-05-02.volume: Volume stays broadly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. The standout is a very large red bar on the sell-off day near the low, and the rebound days show only moderate green bars with no comparable surge.
2024-05-02.combined: The sharp V-shaped recovery is not backed by a volume surge, so the reversal lacks strong confirmation. The heavy selling on the low day followed by flat, moderate buying suggests a tentative bottom that still needs higher volume on up days to confirm.

2024-05-03.kline: Price fell from the upper area of the window through a series of red candles to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-late window, then recovered through a run of green candles in a V-shaped shape. The latest close is near the upper part of the range, about 80 percent of the way back from the low toward the early highs, so the recovery is large but has not cleared the earlier highs.
2024-05-03.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no clear sustained surge or drop-off in recent days. The tallest bar is a red down day near the low, and the recent green up days are of similar size to the earlier bars.
2024-05-03.combined: The price recovery on roughly steady volume shows a V-shaped rebound without strong volume conviction, so the reversal is plausible but not yet confirmed by a volume surge. A close above the earlier highs on rising volume would strengthen the bottom reversal.

2024-05-06.kline: After a choppy high early in the window, price fell sharply to a low near the lower-middle of the range, then recovered over about eight sessions in a V-shaped rebound. The latest green candle closes near the top of the 20-day range, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so the rebound leaves the prior range upward.
2024-05-06.volume: Volume is flat, staying roughly similar across the window. The largest bar is on one of the sell-off days in the decline, and the recent green up days are at moderate levels close to earlier readings, with no pronounced surge.
2024-05-06.combined: The price breakout above the earlier highs is not backed by a volume surge, so the move is only partly confirmed. Rising price on average volume suggests the breakout needs follow-through on heavier trading to be convincing.

2024-05-07.kline: Price fell in a sharp decline through the middle of the window to a low near the 60% mark, then recovered in a V-shaped rebound of several green candles. The rebound has retraced most of the drop and reached the upper part of the range, with the window high near the second-to-last candle. The latest candle is a small red bar near the top of the range, so the close sits in the upper part of the range.
2024-05-07.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in activity. The one standout is a tall red bar on the sharp down day, which is well above the others. Volume during the rebound and in the most recent days stays near the earlier average level.
2024-05-07.combined: The V-shaped recovery is not backed by a volume surge, so the reversal looks tentative and unconfirmed. The large volume on the selloff followed by ordinary volume on the rebound suggests selling pressure eased without strong buying conviction.

2024-05-08.kline: The window shows a V-shaped path: a multi-day slide with a long red drop near the middle that bottoms around the lower-middle of the range, followed by a steady rally of green and red candles back toward the window high. The latest close sits near the top of the range, so the rise has recovered most of the fall.
2024-05-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with the largest spike on a red down day during the selloff near the low. Recent bars are of similar size to earlier ones, and the rally days are mixed between green and red without a clear volume surge.
2024-05-08.combined: The recovery from the low is not backed by a clear pickup in volume, so the V-shaped reversal is only partly confirmed. Price is rising, but the lack of expanding volume on the up days suggests the bottom is not yet strongly validated.

2024-05-09.kline: Price falls over roughly the first half of the window into a sharp V-shaped low, then rallies over several days and recovers most of the decline, with the latest red candle closing in the upper part of the range near the window's recent highs. The shape is a V bottom.
2024-05-09.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade in recent days. The tallest bar is a red down day during the sell-off near the low, and the recent bars are similar in size to earlier ones, with green and red days mixed.
2024-05-09.combined: The recovery from the low is not backed by a clear pickup in volume, so the V-shaped reversal is suggestive but only moderately confirmed. Rising prices on steady volume point to a bottoming attempt rather than a strong buying surge.

2024-05-10.kline: Price falls for about eight days from near the top of the window to a low about two-thirds of the way down the range, forming a sharp V-shaped bottom. It then rises over the following days, with the largest green candle near the window high, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, below the window high. This is a V-shaped reversal bottom that has recovered more than half of the decline.
2024-05-10.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the earliest days include a very large red spike during the sell-off, while the most recent days show shorter bars. Recent bars are mixed between green and red, with no volume surge on the rebound.
2024-05-10.combined: The sharp rebound from the low is not backed by rising volume, so the recovery looks less convincing. Declining volume on the rise suggests the reversal may lack strong participation.

2024-05-13.kline: After an early decline to a low about a third of the way in, price rallied in a series of higher highs and higher lows to a window high near the right side, with the latest closes pulling back slightly beneath that high but still in the upper part of the range. The rise is the dominant feature, so this is an uptrend with a shallow recent pullback rather than a breakout.
2024-05-13.volume: Volume is contracting: a large spike appears early in the window on a red down day, and the most recent bars are visibly shorter than the earlier ones. Up and down days both show smaller volume near the end, with no standout bar on the latest sessions.
2024-05-13.combined: The rising price is no longer backed by the heavy volume of the earlier rally, so the uptrend is intact but its momentum is weakening. Fading volume on the recent pullback suggests a lack of selling conviction, but it does not yet confirm a new breakout.

2024-05-14.kline: Price starts near the window high, drops sharply over the first 3-4 days to the window low in the lower part of the range, then rallies for about 10 days, forming a V-shaped bottom. The rally recovers nearly the whole fall, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the highest candles near the right-middle of the window.
2024-05-14.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the early red down days include one very tall spike, and volume then fades steadily, with the most recent bars clearly smaller than those earlier in the window. The largest volume came on a down day, while many of the later green up days carry only modest volume.
2024-05-14.combined: The V-shaped recovery is not supported by volume: the rally has been accompanied by shrinking volume, so the reversal looks less convincing and may lack conviction. Confirmation would need rising volume on the up days.

2024-05-15.kline: After a sharp early drop to the window's low, price climbed in a staircase pattern with several small pullbacks, a rising path that ends in the upper part of the range. The final green candle closes near the window high, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2024-05-15.volume: Volume is contracting: the early red spike near the start of the window is the largest bar, and volume falls over the middle and later days. The last green bar rises from the prior low but stays well below the early volume.
2024-05-15.combined: Rising price into a new high on shrinking volume is a weak confirmation of the breakout, so the move lacks strong volume support and needs follow-through to be convincing.

2024-05-16.kline: The window starts with a drop from the early highs into a low-range base, then rises in a series of higher highs and higher lows, with a few red pullbacks inside the climb. The latest close, a small red candle, sits near the upper part of the range, close to the window high, so the rise remains intact and the pattern is an uptrend.
2024-05-16.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars are the tallest, with several large green and red days near the start, and the bars steadily shrink toward the right, so the most recent sessions trade on noticeably lighter volume than earlier in the window.
2024-05-16.combined: Price rising to the upper range on falling volume suggests the uptrend is losing participation, so the advance is less convincing than its early phase and needs volume to return to confirm further gains.

2024-05-17.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window in a staircase of higher swings, with several small red pullbacks along the way, such as the dip in the middle and the sideways stretch of small candles near the top. The window low sits near the left-middle, and the latest candle closes in the upper part of the range close to the window high, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2024-05-17.volume: Volume is flat as stated: the earliest bars are tall, but the bars over the most recent days are roughly the same height as the middle of the window, with no sustained surge or fade. Up-day (green) and down-day (red) bars are mixed in size, and the volume bars on the latest up days are not standing out.
2024-05-17.combined: Rising price with volume that is not expanding gives only modest confirmation of the uptrend, so the advance looks steady but not strongly driven by new buying. Watching whether a future rally comes with higher volume would show whether the trend is gaining strength.

2024-05-20.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window after an early dip, then rises over most of the 20 days with a few pullbacks, reaching the window high in the last several sessions. The latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, just below the highest highs, so the rise is intact and the pattern is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2024-05-20.volume: Volume is flat: the bars stay at roughly similar heights across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars appear early and mid-window, and recent bars are about the same size as earlier ones, with both green and red up and down days mixed throughout.
2024-05-20.combined: Price has been rising while volume has stayed flat, so the advance lacks strong volume confirmation. The uptrend is still intact, but the lack of expanding volume on up days suggests limited conviction behind the latest highs.

2024-05-21.kline: Price climbs across most of the 20-day window, from a low base on the left to a series of higher highs near the right edge. The latest green candle sits near the window high, in the upper part of the range, with small pullbacks along the way that don't reverse the rise.
2024-05-21.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge or drop in the most recent days compared with earlier ones. The tallest bars appear early on, and recent green and red days carry similar volume.
2024-05-21.combined: Rising prices on flat volume suggest the uptrend is orderly but lacks strong conviction, since buying pressure isn't clearly expanding. The pattern is intact, but confirmation would need volume to pick up on the up days.

2024-05-22.kline: Price climbs from a low near the start of the window to a high at the right edge, with pullbacks such as the red candles in the middle that do not reverse the rise. The latest close sits near the top of the window range, so the pattern is an uptrend.
2024-05-22.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in the most recent days. The rightmost red bar is among the taller bars, but it does not break the overall flat level, and up and down days carry similar volume.
2024-05-22.combined: Rising prices on flat volume suggest the uptrend is steady but lacks strong new buying conviction. The trend continues without clear volume confirmation of acceleration.

2024-05-23.kline: Price spent the early part of the window in a choppy, mostly sideways band with small swings, then stepped higher through the middle and late window. The final candle is a tall green bar that closes at the top of the window, well above the earlier highs, which were set in the upper-middle of the range. The latest close sits at the window high, so the price has left the prior range upward.
2024-05-23.volume: Volume is mostly moderate through the window, with several red down days of similar size. The rightmost bar is a very tall green spike, far above the normal level of the window and the clear outlier on the chart. Its height confirms the volume spike, and it falls on the up day.
2024-05-23.combined: A sharp rise on a volume spike confirms the upside breakout above the prior range. Heavy buying on the breakout day suggests strong demand, though one day alone does not guarantee follow-through.

2024-05-24.kline: Price climbs through most of the 20-day window from low on the left to high on the right, with small pullbacks along the way. The last two sessions break above the earlier highs: a strong green candle closes near the top of the range, then a large green gap-up candle pushes the latest close well above the prior range, near the window high.
2024-05-24.volume: Volume is quiet through the first half of the window, then rises as price advances. The standout is a very tall green volume bar on the second-to-last day, a clear spike that matches the big up move. The latest day's volume is elevated but below that spike, and it is on an up day.
2024-05-24.combined: Sharply rising price on a volume spike on up days confirms the breakout above the prior range. The slightly lower volume on the final day is a minor caution, but the overall pattern supports continuation.

2024-05-28.kline: After a choppy stretch of small red and green candles in the lower-middle of the range, the last four or five candles climb sharply, with the final green candle closing near the window high and above the earlier highs. The latest close sits at the top of the range, so price has left the prior range upward.
2024-05-28.volume: Volume expands clearly over the window: the earlier bars are mostly moderate and mixed in color, while the most recent days show the tallest bars, with a very large green bar near the end followed by another tall green bar on the final day.
2024-05-28.combined: Sharply rising price on rapidly rising volume, concentrated in up days, confirms the breakout and suggests strong buying interest behind the move.

2024-05-29.kline: After a rising start from the window low and a sideways stretch in the middle, price jumps in the last three sessions with large green candles that close well above the earlier highs of the window. The latest close sits near the window high, so the price has left its prior range upward.
2024-05-29.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are mostly moderate, while the last several sessions show the tallest green bars, with the single largest bar on the breakout day. The high-volume bars line up with the strong up days, and the few red down days carry smaller volume.
2024-05-29.combined: Rising price on rising volume confirms the breakout, since the strongest advances come with the heaviest trading and the price closes above the prior range.

2024-05-30.kline: Price drifted up in small-bodied candles through the middle of the window, then gapped sharply higher over the last four to five days into the upper part of the range, above the earlier highs. The latest red candle sits near the window high, so the close is in the top of the range after leaving the prior range upward.
2024-05-30.volume: Volume was modest and fairly even through the early and middle part of the window, then expanded, with the tallest bars in the window appearing in the final several days. The largest green day comes just before the end, and the most recent red day also prints high volume, so the expansion lines up with the strongest up days.
2024-05-30.combined: Rising price on rising volume confirms the breakout above the prior range, though the high-volume red final day suggests some selling pressure at the top that needs follow-through to confirm.

2024-05-31.kline: After a long sideways-to-rising base in the lower half of the window, price jumps sharply in the final three to four sessions, with two tall green candles closing above the earlier highs and then two red candles at the top of the window. The latest close is in the upper part of the range, just below the window high, after a pullback with a long lower wick on the last day.
2024-05-31.volume: Volume expands clearly into the end of the window: the earlier bars are modest, while the tallest bar sits on a green breakout day near the end and the most recent red days also carry large volume. Volume is highest on the strongest up day and stays elevated through the pullback.
2024-05-31.combined: Rising price on sharply rising volume confirms the breakout above the prior range. The heavy volume on the last two red days, however, shows meaningful selling into the high, so the breakout needs to hold above the prior highs to remain confirmed.

2024-06-03.kline: Price starts near the window low with small, mixed candles, then climbs in a series of green up-days through the middle of the window with a few red pullbacks. The latest stretch reaches the highest levels of the window, and the most recent candle is green, closing near the top of the range. The rise is steady rather than a sharp breakout above a distinct prior range.
2024-06-03.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate and mixed in color, while the most recent days show larger bars, including one of the tallest spikes of the window near the rally's strongest up-days. Several of the highest-volume bars fall on green (up) days, while some red days also carry heavy volume.
2024-06-03.combined: Rising prices on expanding volume suggest the uptrend has real participation and is not just a thin drift higher. The heavy volume on the latest up-days supports continuation, although the red high-volume days near the top hint at some selling pressure at the highs.

2024-06-04.kline: Price rose from a low base at the left of the window, with small candles near the bottom and then a steep climb, including gap-up moves, to the top-right. Several red down days near the window high formed a brief pullback, and the latest candle is green, closing in the upper part of the range close to the window high.
2024-06-04.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear increase or decrease across the window. A tall green spike appears in the middle of the window, and recent bars are moderate and similar in height to earlier bars, with red and green days mixed.
2024-06-04.combined: The rising price with flat volume suggests the uptrend is not being strongly driven by increasing participation. The latest green day near the highs is a modest positive, but the volume does not add much confirmation to the trend.

2024-06-05.kline: Price starts near the window low with small candles, drifts up, then jumps in the later half and climbs to a tall green final candle at the top of the window, so the latest close sits near the window high and above the highs of the earlier part of the window, a rising move that leaves the prior range upward.

2024-08-01.volume: Volume expands toward the right: the early bars are moderate, while the most recent several days show the tallest bars in the window, including a large green day and a large red day near the end. Volume is heavier on many of the falling candles in the middle and late decline, so the selling days stand out.
2024-08-01.combined: The fall from the peak is occurring on rising volume, which supports a genuine top rather than a quiet drift lower. The latest green bounce on high volume is not enough to reverse the decline, so the reversal pattern is supported by the volume.

2024-08-02.kline: The window starts near the top of its range with a few green days and an early red spike, then falls in a series of lower highs and lower lows toward the lower right. Bounces, such as the green candles in the middle and the final green candle, are small and do not reverse the fall. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the window low.
2024-08-02.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, while the most recent bars are the tallest in the chart, including a large red day and two strong green days at the end. Red down days carry much of the heaviest volume, and the latest bars show clearly higher activity than earlier in the window.
2024-08-02.combined: Heavy volume on the falling days confirms active selling pressure behind the downtrend. The final green day on high volume is a meaningful bounce, but it is not yet enough to show a reversal, so the downtrend view holds until price recovers above the recent highs.

2024-08-05.kline: Price opens near the top of the window with a brief early rise, then falls across most of the 20 days with a few bounces, such as the green candles near the middle-right. The latest candle is a tall green day at the bottom of the range, so the close sits in the lower part of the window, near the window low.
2024-08-05.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window: the earlier bars are moderate, while the most recent several bars are noticeably taller, with the last bar the tallest. Heavy red bars cluster in the later decline, and the final green bar also carries high volume.
2024-08-05.combined: Heavy volume on the down days alongside falling prices supports continued selling pressure and the downtrend. The high-volume green bar on the latest day hints at a possible bounce attempt, but one day is not enough to confirm a reversal.

2024-08-06.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, with a stepped decline of lower highs and lower lows from the upper-left to the lower-right. Small green bounces interrupt the slide but do not reverse it, and the latest candles sit in the lower part of the range near the window low, with the most recent green candle still well below the window high.
2024-08-06.volume: Volume expands over the window: the earlier red down days carry several tall bars in the middle, while the most recent days show taller bars, with the latest green up days reaching the highest levels on the chart.
2024-08-06.combined: Price is still in a downtrend, but the rising volume on recent green days suggests buyers are becoming more active near the lows, so the pattern stays DOWNTREND without yet confirming a reversal.

2024-08-07.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top-left to lows near the bottom-right, with a few brief bounces such as the green candles in the middle. The latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, well below the window high, which fits a downtrend rather than a reversal.
2024-08-07.volume: Volume expands over the window: the earlier bars are mostly moderate, while the most recent bars are clearly taller, including several large red down-days and a large green day near the end.
2024-08-07.combined: Heavier volume on the falling days alongside the lower closes suggests selling pressure is strengthening and supports the downtrend, though the recent green day shows some buying interest.

2024-08-08.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range at the left to a low near the bottom around the 17th day, with several small bounces along the way. The latest green candle sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2024-08-08.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, and the bars from roughly the middle onward grow larger, with the tallest bars in the final stretch. The largest volume comes on red down days, while the most recent green day carries heavy but not peak volume.
2024-08-08.combined: Falling prices on expanding volume confirm persistent selling pressure and support the downtrend. The latest green day on high volume suggests a possible short-term bounce, but it does not yet show a reversal.

2024-08-09.kline: The window falls overall from near the top of the range toward the bottom, with several bounces along the way such as the green candles in the middle of the window. 2024-08-09.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained build-up or fade. The tallest bars cluster in the middle and late-middle sections, and the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones, so the chart does not show a clear surge or drop in activity.
2024-08-09.combined: Steady declines on similar volume suggest the selling pressure is persistent but not accelerating, and the late bounce lacks volume confirmation. The downtrend remains the dominant read unless a later move shows a clear volume surge in either direction.

2024-08-12.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from near the top of the range to a low near the bottom, including a long green candle near the window low. 2024-08-12.volume: Volume stays fairly steady across the window, with no clear surge or drop-off at the end. The tallest bars cluster in the middle, where the large green down-to-up candles are, and the most recent bars are at roughly the same level as earlier bars.
2024-08-12.combined: The rebound is not supported by a volume increase, so the bounce looks like a weak recovery within the broader decline rather than a confirmed reversal. Price remains in a downtrend unless volume expands on the upside.

2024-08-13.kline: Price fell over roughly the first 12 days from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range around day 15, then rallied for about five days, recovering most of the drop. The shape is a V-shaped bottom, and the latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, near the upper part of the recent rally.
2024-08-13.volume: Volume stays flat: bars are mixed through the window, with some tall red bars early and several tall green bars in the middle and later days. The most recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier bars, so there is no clear surge or drop-off, and up and down days carry similar volume.
2024-08-13.combined: The recovery off the low is not backed by a volume surge, so the V-shaped reversal is only moderately supported. The flat volume suggests the rebound is steady rather than decisively confirmed.

2024-08-14.kline: Price falls from the early part of the window, with highs near the window top, to a low near the window bottom around the 15th trading day, marked by a large green candle near the bottom. It then rises over the last several sessions and recovers most of the decline, so the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom.
2024-08-14.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no strong spike or fade. The taller bars appear mid-to-late in the window on several green up days, and the most recent bars are moderate, similar to earlier levels.
2024-08-14.combined: The price recovery is not accompanied by a clear volume surge, so the rebound is supported only modestly by volume. This fits a V-shaped reversal from the low, but it lacks strong volume confirmation.

2024-08-15.kline: Price fell from the upper-left area of the window to a sharp low near the bottom, then rallied in a V shape with several consecutive green candles, ending with the latest close near the top of the range, well above the midpoint. The rally recovered most of the earlier decline, but it did not clearly close above the early-window highs, so this is a reversal rather than a breakout.
2024-08-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: bars are moderate in height at the start, peak in the middle of the window, and the most recent bars are close to the earlier levels rather than expanding or fading sharply. 2024-08-15.combined: The price recovery from the low is not backed by a clear rise in volume, so the reversal lacks strong volume confirmation. Flat volume suggests the bounce is steady but not yet showing strong buying conviction.

2024-08-16.kline: The window shows a V-shaped reversal: price falls from the upper area through the middle of the window to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-to-late bars, then rises over several days. 2024-08-16.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: heavy red selling days early on and a large green spike mid-window are followed by moderate, fairly even bars through the recent green up days, with no clear expansion or drying up in the latest sessions.
2024-08-16.combined: Rising price on volume that is about the same as earlier in the window gives only modest confirmation of the bottom reversal, so the recovery is not yet backed by a clear surge in buying interest.

2024-08-19.kline: After a decline from the upper area of the window to a low about two-thirds of the way through, price formed a rounded V-shaped recovery and climbed steadily in the final several sessions. The last few candles pushed above the highs of the earlier part of the window, and the latest close sits near the top of the 20-day range.
2024-08-19.volume: Volume is flat: the early bars were tall, the middle bars shrank, and the recent bars are roughly similar in size to the earlier ones, with no clear surge on the breakout days. 2024-08-19.combined: The price breakout above earlier highs is not confirmed by a volume surge, so the move looks less convincing and needs follow-through on higher volume to validate it.

2024-08-20.kline: The window starts near the middle of the range, falls over about ten sessions to a deep low near the bottom of the chart, then rallies over the remaining sessions with mostly green candles. This forms a V-shaped bottom, and the latest red candle closes in the upper part of the range, close to the window high but not clearly above the earlier highs.
2024-08-20.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window: the early red-day bars are tall, the big green rebound days in the middle are also high, and the most recent bars sit at moderate, steady levels with no sudden spike.
2024-08-20.combined: The rebound off the low recovered most of the earlier decline, which supports a reversal, but volume did not surge on the rally days, so the recovery lacks strong volume confirmation.

2024-08-21.kline: The window opens near the upper-middle of the range, falls for about eight days into a sharp low near the lower third, then rallies steadily into the last few sessions. The final 3 candles (a red and two greens) close near the window high, above the highs of the earlier part of the window, so price has left the prior range upward, though the shape also resembles a V recovery.
2024-08-21.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars are tall, including red selling bars and a peak green bar during the rally, while the most recent bars are shorter and mostly green, with the last bar the lowest in the window. 2024-08-21.combined: Price is breaking above the prior range, but the breakout is happening on falling volume, which means it lacks the strong participation that would confirm it. Traders should watch whether the next up days recover volume to confirm the move.

2024-08-22.kline: Price fell from the upper-middle of the window through a trough of several days near the lower part of the range around the middle of the window, then rallied steadily over the following days. 2024-08-22.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no sustained surge or drop. Red down-day bars are mixed in with green up-day bars, and the most recent red bar is of moderate size rather than standing out.
2024-08-22.combined: The rally off the low closes near the top of the range, but volume is flat rather than expanding on the up days, so the reversal is only weakly confirmed by volume. Confirmation would be stronger if volume rose on the advancing sessions.

2024-08-23.kline: Price falls over the first half of the window, with a sharp drop to a low about a third of the way in, forming a V-shaped bottom. 2024-08-23.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, consistent with the measured state. Early red down-day bars are tall, and later bars are similar in height, with no clear surge on the rally days, and the most recent bars are not notably larger than earlier ones.

2024-08-28.kline: After a sharp early decline to a low near the bottom of the range over the first few days, price rallies through most of the window to highs near the top, forming a V-shaped recovery. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, just below the window high.

2024-08-30.kline: Price climbs from near the window low at the left to near the window high in the middle-right, with a choppy top, then the last three or four candles drop sharply. 2024-08-30.volume: Volume stays about the same as earlier in the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars are the earliest green bar and the most recent red bars, which are high but similar in size to the mid-window bars, and the volume chart shows no clear trend.
2024-08-30.combined: The recent sell-off comes on volume that is not unusually heavy, so it looks like a normal pullback rather than strong distribution, and the uptrend stays intact while the latest close holds in the upper range.

2024-09-03.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge or drop-off. The most recent red down days are about as large as the earlier bars, and the mix of green and red days shows no clear volume spike on the decline.

2024-09-04.kline: Price rises for about 12 days from a low near the bottom of the window to a peak in the upper part of the range, then falls over the last several days, giving back most of the rise. 2024-09-04.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The most recent red down days are somewhat taller than the earlier bars, but the change is not persistent and the green bounce day shows no pickup.

2024-09-05.kline: Price rose steadily from the lower left to a peak near the upper part of the window, then formed an inverted-V top and fell back sharply, with the latest candles sitting near the bottom of the range. 2024-09-05.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge or drop. The tallest bars cluster on several red down days during the decline, while the most recent bar is green but only moderate in size.

2024-09-06.kline: Price rises from near the window low through a steady climb, peaks around the middle-to-late part of the window near the high, then falls over several days with a few red bodies, forming a rounded inverted-V top. 2024-09-06.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or fade relative to the early days. The tallest bars are red down-day bars in the middle and later part of the window, but the overall level is about the same as earlier, consistent with the flat volume state.

2024-09-09.kline: The window shows a rise from the left that peaks around the middle of the window, forming a rounded inverted-V top. The fall then gives back most of that rise through the right side, and the latest green candle sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2024-09-09.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, with no clear surge or drop in the most recent days compared with earlier. Several tall red bars appear in the middle and late window, but the final days are not notably higher or lower than the early days.

2024-09-10.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to a peak in the upper-middle part of the range around the middle-to-late days, then falls sharply over several sessions into the lower part of the range, forming an inverted V shape. The latest close sits near the bottom of the window range after giving back more than half of the rise.

2024-09-11.kline: The window opens with a brief rise to a high near the top of the range, then falls steadily over about ten days in mostly red candles to a low near the bottom. The last few candles form a sideways base near the lows, and the final green candle bounces to roughly the middle of the range, so the latest close sits in the lower half of the range.

2024-09-12.kline: The window opens with a rise to a high near the top of the range, then declines over most of the period, including a sharp red drop mid-to-late in the window that finds a low near the bottom of the range. 2024-09-12.combined: The price bounce over the last few days is not backed by a volume surge, so it does not strongly suggest a trend change and the downtrend remains the dominant read.

2024-09-13.kline: Price fell in a sustained decline of several days from the upper part of the window to a low near the bottom of the range, then rebounded over several green candles. 2024-09-13.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: the tallest red bars came during the mid-window selloff, while recent green bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier days, with no sustained surge on the rebound.

2024-09-16.kline: Price fell sharply from the upper part of the window to a low near the bottom, then rebounded through several green candles, recovering roughly half of the decline, forming a V-shaped bottom. 2024-09-17.kline: Price opens the window near the top of the range, then falls steeply over about ten days to a low near the bottom of the range, with a large red candle in the middle of the decline. 2024-09-18.kline: The window starts near its high, then falls through most of the 20 days, with a sharp selloff of large red candles that reaches the window low about two-thirds of the way across. 2024-09-19.kline: Price fell steeply from the upper part of the window to a low near the bottom of the range around day 12, forming a V-shaped bottom. 2024-09-20.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the left edge to a low in the lower-right area, with a shallow rebound of small green candles at the end. 2024-09-23.kline: The price path forms a V shape: a sharp multi-day fall from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range, followed by a steady rebound of green candles that recovers roughly two-thirds of the decline. The latest closes sit around the middle of the range, just below the recent highs, so the rebound has not fully returned to the upper part of the window.

2024-09-24.kline: Price opens near the top of the window, falls steeply over roughly the first 12 days into a V-shaped low near the lower-middle of the chart, then rallies in a series of green candles back to about the middle of the range. 2024-11-22.combined: Rising price on rising volume suggests the advance has real participation and supports the uptrend, though the red latest day on still-elevated volume hints at some near-term selling pressure.

2024-11-25.kline: Price starts mid-range, dips to a low near the window bottom about a quarter of the way in, then climbs over several days to a peak near the top of the range in the later part of the window. 2024-11-25.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest bars clustered on the recent red down days near the peak and the final sessions. Green up days earlier in the window carry lower volume than the heavy red selling bars on the right.

2024-11-26.kline: Price falls from a low near the start of the window, rallies through the middle and peaks near the window high around the 17th day, then drops sharply on several long red candles over the last few sessions. 2024-11-26.combined: Heavier volume on falling prices after a rally to the highs suggests distribution and confirms the top reversal, with sellers gaining control as the price gives back its gains.

2024-11-29.kline: Price rises from near the window low through several green days to a peak near the top of the range around the middle of the window, then falls over the following days in a rounded, inverted-V shape. 2024-12-02.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window into a sharp spike high a little right of center, then falls back to near the window low before a small green bounce on the last few days. 2024-12-02.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars cluster around the spike high in the middle of the window, and the most recent sessions are not notably higher than earlier ones, with mixed red and green days.

2024-12-03.kline: Price rose from the lower part of the window to a spike high near the window top around the middle of the window, then fell for several days to a low near the bottom of the range, giving back well over half of the rise. 2024-12-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest bars cluster around the spike high and the selloff, with heavy red bars on the decline, while the most recent sessions show clearly smaller bars than the earlier part of the window.
2024-12-03.combined: Heavy volume on the decline after the peak confirms selling pressure, and the lighter volume on the recent rebound suggests the bounce lacks conviction, so the top pattern is more likely to persist than to reverse.

2024-12-04.kline: The window falls from the upper-middle of the range through a series of red candles, with a long red drop near the window's lows, then recovers in a V-shaped rebound of several green candles. 2024-12-04.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge. The largest spikes come on red down days in the middle and late part of the decline, while the recovery days show moderate, mixed volume.

2024-12-05.kline: Price peaked near the top of the window around the middle, then fell in a sharp multi-day slide to a low near the window's lower end, forming a V-shaped bottom. 2024-12-05.volume: Volume was heaviest during the mid-window sell-off, with the tallest red bars standing out around the peak and the steep decline. 2024-12-05.combined: The recovery from the low is occurring on contracting volume, which suggests the rebound lacks strong conviction and the reversal is not yet confirmed by heavy buying.

2024-12-06.kline: Price fell for several days from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range around the middle-to-late part of the window, then rose over the final four or five days with mostly green candles. 2024-12-06.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained surge or dry-up. The largest bars come on several of the heavy red down days in the middle of the window, and the most recent green up days show only moderate volume, similar to earlier levels.
2024-12-06.combined: The rebound from the low happens on roughly unchanged volume, which gives only weak confirmation of the reversal. Buyers are stepping in, but without a clear pickup in volume the recovery is not yet strongly backed.

2024-12-09.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, then falls over most of the 20 days with a few red candles stepping lower, reaching a low about two-thirds of the way through. 2024-12-09.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up. 2024-12-10.kline: Price peaks early in the window with a spike near the top around the middle, then falls over most of the period with a mid-window bounce on green candles, and the latest red candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window lows.
2024-12-10.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear build-up or fade toward the end. The tallest bars come on red down days in the middle of the window, while the most recent days show moderate bars similar to the earlier levels, and green up days do not stand out in size.

2025-01-03.kline: Price falls from near the top of the window to a low around the middle-to-lower part of the range, then rallies in a V-shaped recovery that climbs back to near the window high; the latest close is a green candle in the upper part of the range, so the recovery has regained most of the decline. 2025-01-03.volume: Volume stays broadly flat across the window, with bars at similar heights throughout and no dominant surge. A few taller bars appear mid-window, including one tall green bar, while the most recent days are roughly in line with earlier volume rather than clearly expanding or shrinking.

2025-01-06.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge in the most recent days. The tallest bars sit mid-window and the last few green up-days are about as large as the red down-days earlier, so the breakout day does not stand out.

Because volume is flat overall and the latest close is not decisively in the lower half, the reversal is not yet confirmed and needs follow-through lower.

2025-01-10.combined: Heavy volume on the sharp declines after the peak supports a top and suggests sellers are taking control, consistent with a reversal rather than a routine pullback.

2025-01-13.kline: Price rose from the lower-middle of the window into a peak near the window high, forming an inverted-V shape, then fell sharply over the last three to four sessions. The latest green candle sits near the bottom of the range, in the lower half, after giving back most of the rally.

2025-01-16.kline: Price climbs over most of the window from low levels to a sharp spike near the window high around the middle-right, then falls over the last several days, giving back well over half of the rise.
