2025-09-03.kline: Price starts in the upper-middle of the range, then drops sharply to near the window low around the middle-late bars, bounces partway back, and then falls again into the bottom of the range. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range near the lows, so the bounces are minor relative to the overall decline.
2025-09-03.volume: Volume expands over the window, with the tallest bars clustered in the recent red down days near the end. The most recent session is still well above the early-window volume, though it is not the single largest bar.
2025-09-03.combined: Falling prices on rising volume point to strong selling pressure and suggest the downtrend is being confirmed rather than exhausted. A sustained move on heavy volume would be needed before calling a bottom.

2025-09-04.kline: Price starts mid-range, then drops in a sharp red selloff after a brief high, with a long-wicked low near the middle-to-late window and only partial bounces. The last few candles sit near the bottom of the window range, so the latest close is in the lower part of the range, and the window shows a falling trend without a clear breakdown below earlier lows.
2025-09-04.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are modest, while the bars from the middle to the right side are taller, with several of the largest red and green bars in the second half. This matches the expanding volume state, with the most recent days clearly heavier than the start.
2025-09-04.combined: Falling prices on rising volume suggest the downtrend has strong participation and selling pressure, though the late green bars show some buying interest near the lows.

2025-09-05.kline: Price opens the window in a choppy, mid-to-upper range, then falls sharply through a series of large red candles to a low near the middle-left of the window, with a long lower wick marking that low. A partial green bounce follows, but the bounce stalls well below the early highs, and the latest candle is red and sits in the lower part of the range. The overall path is a downtrend with bounces inside it.
2025-09-05.volume: Volume is flat across the window: the recent bars are roughly the same height as earlier ones rather than clearly rising or falling. The tallest bars are red down days in the middle and late window, and the most recent bar is red and fairly large, but there is no sustained build-up or fade in activity.
2025-09-05.combined: Down days are not accompanied by a clear volume surge, so the selling pressure looks steady rather than capitulating, and the downtrend is not confirmed by an accelerating volume climax. The latest red day on near-average volume keeps the bearish bias intact without signalling a reversal.

2025-09-08.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from highs near the top of the chart on the left to lows near the bottom on the right, with a few green bounces along the way. The steepest drops are large red candles in the middle and late window, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, a little above the window low.
2025-09-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no clear surge in the most recent days. The tallest bars cluster around the mid-to-late red down days, while several green up days carry moderate volume.
2025-09-08.combined: Falling prices on roughly steady volume point to a persistent downtrend without strong selling climax or accumulation signals. The latest bounce is small and unsupported by a volume increase, so the downtrend remains intact.

2025-09-09.kline: Price falls from the upper part of the window through a sharp slide of large red candles in the middle-to-late stretch, reaching a low near the bottom of the range. A small bounce of green candles follows, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, so the bounces are minor and the decline dominates the window.
2025-09-09.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drying up in the latest days. The tallest volume bars cluster on the red selloff days in the middle and late window, while the most recent bars are at moderate levels similar to earlier sessions.
2025-09-09.combined: The heaviest volume coincides with the steepest down days, which supports the selling pressure behind the downtrend. Recent green bounces are not accompanied by a volume surge, so the rebound looks weak and the downtrend pattern remains intact.

2025-09-10.kline: The window opens near the high, falls over several days into a low zone with a long lower wick, then rebounds over the last several sessions. The rebound recovers most of the decline, and the latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, a little below the window high.
2025-09-10.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or dropoff in the latest days. Tall red bars appear during the early selloff and mid-window, while the recent green up-days are of similar size to earlier bars.
2025-09-10.combined: The rebound off the lows is not backed by a volume increase, so the bottom reversal is only partly confirmed. Price recovery on steady volume suggests a tentative turn that would need heavier buying to strengthen.

2025-09-11.kline: Price opens the window near the upper part of the range, falls several days to a low near the lower part of the range, then chops sideways at the base before a sharp two-day rebound. The latest red candle closes in the upper half, recovering roughly 70% of the decline (a V-shaped bottom), but it stays below the early-window highs, so it is not a breakout.
2025-09-11.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window with no sustained surge: a few taller red bars appear in the middle of the decline, while the most recent bars are moderate and close to the earlier average. The rebound days do not show a clear volume increase, which matches the flat volume state.
2025-09-11.combined: The rebound from the low is not confirmed by a volume surge, so the recovery looks less convincing than a V-bottom on heavy buying would. Price and volume together suggest a possible bottoming attempt that needs follow-through on higher volume to validate the reversal.

2025-09-12.kline: Price falls from the high near the top of the window to a low about two-thirds of the way across, then rebounds in a series of higher closes and finishes near the upper part of the range. The latest close sits in the upper half, roughly three-quarters of the way up from the window low, so this reads as a V-shaped reversal from a bottom rather than a breakout.
2025-09-12.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout and no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars cluster around the mid-window selloff, mostly red, while the recent green up-days show moderate volume with no clear expansion.
2025-09-12.combined: The recovery off the low is not backed by rising volume, so the reversal is plausible but not strongly confirmed. Flat volume suggests the rebound lacks conviction for now and needs higher-volume green days to firm up the bottom.

2025-09-15.kline: Price fell over roughly the first 12 days from near the window high to a low near the bottom of the range around day 13, then rose over the last six or so days, recovering a little more than half of the decline. The latest green candle closes in the upper half of the range, though below the window high, forming a V-shaped bottom with a partial recovery.
2025-09-15.volume: Volume is flat overall, with the tallest bars in the middle-left of the window on mostly red down days, while the recent rally days show similar, moderate volume rather than a clear surge. Volume on the up days in the last week is about the same as on the earlier down days.
2025-09-15.combined: The rally off the low is not supported by any volume expansion, so the recovery looks tentative rather than a confirmed reversal. The V-shaped bottom and upper-half close still fit a reversal, but the flat volume means buyers have not clearly taken control yet.

2025-09-16.kline: The window starts near the top of its range, falls over roughly the first 60% of the bars to a low near the window's bottom, then rises over the last several days in a V-shaped recovery. The rebound recovers about half of the prior fall, and the latest close sits near the middle of the range, just above it.
2025-09-16.volume: Volume stays fairly even across the window, consistent with a flat state. The largest bars come on several red down days in the middle and early part of the window, while the recent up-day bars are moderate and not clearly larger than earlier bars.
2025-09-16.combined: The price recovery on only average, non-expanding volume is weak confirmation of a bottom, so the V-shaped reversal needs a close higher on rising volume to be fully convincing.

2025-09-17.kline: The window starts near the middle of the range, rises over the first several days to a peak near the window high, then falls for many days, forming an inverted-V shape. The decline gives back the whole rise and pushes lows toward the window bottom, with a brief green bounce in the middle. The latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, well below the peak.
2025-09-17.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no clear surge or drying up. The tallest volume bars come during the rise and the early part of the decline, and recent bars are roughly average, so the volume chart does not show a clear pickup in selling at the end.
2025-09-17.combined: The price path fits a top followed by a decline, but volume stays at a similar level throughout, so the fall is not backed by heavier selling. The reversal is plausible but only moderately confirmed, and it needs follow-through on higher volume to be convincing.

2025-09-18.kline: Price rallied in the first part of the window to a high near the top of the range, then fell for several days to a low near the bottom, forming a V-shaped bottom. It then recovered roughly 60% of that decline over the last several days, and the latest green close sits in the upper half of the range, a bit below the window high.
2025-09-18.volume: Volume stays fairly flat across the window, as the stated state says, with no sustained surge or drop. The tallest bars are a few red down-day bars early and in the middle of the window, while the most recent bars are similar in height to earlier ones.
2025-09-18.combined: The rebound off the lows came on volume roughly in line with the selloff, so it does not show strong accumulation. The recovery into the upper half would need follow-through on steady volume to confirm the reversal.

2025-09-19.kline: The window starts with a large green candle, rises to a red spike near the window high, then falls back into the lower-middle of the range. The middle section chops sideways in the lower-to-middle band. The last several days rebound, and the latest green candle closes in the upper part of the range, so the pattern reads as sideways movement with a late recovery rather than a clear trend.
2025-09-19.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout and a few spikes, including a tall red day near the middle and a tall green day at the right edge. Up and down days carry similar volume, with no sustained build-up.
2025-09-19.combined: Price has been moving sideways with a late recovery, but flat volume gives no strong confirmation of a new direction. The recent green days are not backed by a clear volume surge, so the move looks like range trading rather than a confirmed breakout.

2025-09-22.kline: The window opens near the upper part of the range, then falls over several days through a sharp run of red candles to the lows in the middle-to-late section. A rally of several green candles recovers most of that drop, forming a V-shaped bottom, and the latest close sits near the top of the range close to the window high.
2025-09-22.volume: Volume is flat: the early red down-days show heavy bars, and the later green up-days are of similar size rather than clearly larger, so volume does not swell as the price recovers. The most recent bars are about as tall as the earlier ones.
2025-09-22.combined: The recovery from the low is not backed by a volume surge, so the V-shaped reversal looks less convincing than it would with strong buying volume. Confirmation would need the rally to continue on rising volume.

2025-09-23.kline: Price falls steeply from the early highs to a low near the bottom of the window, then chops sideways in a base before rallying over several days, with a tall green candle near the window high. The rally recovers most of the decline, and the latest red candle closes around the upper-middle of the range, just below the peak, so this reads as a V-shaped reversal bottom.
2025-09-23.volume: Volume stays flat across the window, with no clear spike or drying up, and the most recent days are about the same size as earlier bars. Green and red bars are mixed through the recent rally rather than concentrated on the up days.
2025-09-23.combined: The rebound from the low is not backed by a volume surge, so the recovery looks less convincing than a V-bottom on heavy buying. Confirmation would need the price to keep climbing on rising volume.

2025-09-24.kline: Price starts near the top of the window, drops sharply over the first half to a low near the window bottom around day 9, then recovers in a V-shaped rise to a spike near the window high around day 17. The last two red candles pull back, leaving the latest close in the upper half of the range, roughly two-thirds of the way back up the fall.
2025-09-24.volume: Volume is flat, with no clear surge or fade from the early window to the recent days. Bars are mixed in height throughout, and the most recent red days carry volume similar to the earlier sessions.
2025-09-24.combined: The recovery from the low is not accompanied by a clear volume expansion, so the V-shaped bottom has only modest volume confirmation. The pattern is still supported by price, but the lack of volume increase makes the reversal less convincing.

2025-09-25.kline: Price rose from lows near the bottom of the range into a tall green spike near the window high, then fell back over several red and green candles, giving back roughly half the rise. The latest green close sits near the middle of the range, around the halfway level, so the reversal is not decisive.
2025-09-25.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish and no clear surge on the peak rally or the decline. Recent days are about the same as earlier days, with no standout spike.
2025-09-25.combined: The price reversal after the rally is not confirmed by volume, since the decline came on ordinary volume rather than heavy selling. The top pattern is therefore tentative and the latest close near mid-range leaves direction unresolved.

2025-09-26.kline: Price starts near the middle of the range, dips in the early bars, then rises across most of the window to a tall green peak near the window high. After the peak it pulls back with a few red candles, and the latest close sits in the upper-middle part of the range, so the rise has held. The latest close does not clear the window high, so this is not a breakout.
2025-09-26.volume: Volume is flat: recent bars are about the same size as those earlier in the window, with no clear surge. The tallest volume bars come in the middle-to-late rise, with green up-days mostly taller than red down-days in that stretch, and the most recent bars are moderate and mixed.
2025-09-26.combined: Rising prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest the uptrend is intact but not accelerating. The lack of a volume surge on the latest days means the pullback has no clear sign of heavy selling, and there is also no volume confirmation of a new leg higher.

2025-09-29.kline: Early candles slide from the middle of the range down to a low near the window's bottom, around the seventh day, then a multi-day rally lifts price back toward the top. The rally recovers more than half of the earlier fall, a V-shaped bottom, and the latest close sits in the upper part of the range, below the window high.
2025-09-29.volume: Volume stays flat: the most recent bars are about the same height as those earlier in the window, with no single day standing out sharply. Green up-days and red down-days are mixed through the window, and the latest bars show no surge.
2025-09-29.combined: Price recovering from the low on steady volume gives only modest confirmation of the bottom reversal, since the rebound is not backed by a volume surge. A follow-through with rising volume would strengthen the case.

2025-09-30.kline: Price starts low, rises in steps with a few small pullbacks, then jumps sharply in the middle of the window. The latest green candle closes near the top of the range and above the earlier highs, so it leaves the prior range upward.
2025-09-30.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height throughout. The final up day's bar is tall but comparable to earlier peaks, with no clear surge.
2025-09-30.combined: Rising price on non-surging volume gives only weak confirmation of the breakout. A clear volume expansion on the breakout day would be needed for stronger confirmation.

2025-10-01.kline: Price rises from a low cluster on the left, with a choppy middle, and climbs to the window's highest levels in the final 2-3 sessions, with the latest close near the top of the range. The last green candles clear the highs of the earlier part of the window, a breakout above the prior range.
2025-10-01.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no clear surge. The most recent green bars are around the same height as earlier bars, and a few tall bars appear mid-window on both up and down days.
2025-10-01.combined: The upside break is not confirmed by volume, since the recent up days trade at about the same volume as earlier days. The breakout is therefore weaker and would need volume expansion to be convincing.

2025-10-02.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from a low start near the bottom of the range to a series of higher highs, with a pullback in the middle. The latest candle is a small red day that sits near the top of the window range, so the close is in the upper part of the range.
2025-10-02.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster in the middle and mid-late sections, mostly on green up days, while the most recent day is a moderate red bar about average in size.
2025-10-02.combined: Price has trended higher with a steady, unremarkable volume profile, so the uptrend is intact but volume does not strongly confirm it. Without a volume expansion on the recent up moves, the advance looks less convincing than a rally on rising volume would.

2025-10-03.kline: Price climbs from the low left side of the window to near the window high on the right, with a few pullbacks along the way such as the red candles in the middle and a red candle at the top right. The latest close sits in the upper part of the range, close to the highest highs of the window, which fits an uptrend rather than a reversal.
2025-10-03.volume: Volume is flat: bar heights stay in a similar band across the window with no clear surge or drop-off. The tallest bars are scattered through the earlier and middle sessions, and the most recent red days show moderate, similar volume to earlier days.
2025-10-03.combined: Price is rising steadily while volume stays at a similar level, so the uptrend is intact but without volume expansion to strongly confirm it. The recent red days on steady volume suggest some selling pressure near the highs that bears watching.

2025-10-06.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, starting from a low green candle at the bottom left and climbing with a few small pullbacks, to a peak near the window high on the right. The last two days pull back from that high with a red candle and a small green bounce, leaving the latest close in the upper part of the range, so this is a pullback within a rise rather than a reversal.
2025-10-06.volume: Volume stays in a similar band throughout the window with no sustained surge or drop, and the most recent bars are at moderate levels, about the same as earlier. The tallest volume bars sit mid-window on up days, while the two recent red down days show moderate volume.
2025-10-06.combined: The steady rise on roughly unchanged volume suggests a persistent uptrend without strong conviction behind the latest pullback. The lack of a volume surge on the recent down days points to a mild pause rather than distribution, though the uptrend is not confirmed by expanding volume.

2025-10-07.kline: After a sharp drop to a low about a third of the way into the window, price rallies across most of the remaining candles to the window high, with a few pullbacks along the way. The latest close is a red candle near the upper part of the range, just below the recent peak, so the rise is intact.
2025-10-07.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade. The tallest bars appear in the middle of the rally, and the most recent days are about average, with a few red down days carrying similar volume to green up days.
2025-10-07.combined: Price has risen from the low while volume has stayed flat, so the uptrend lacks strong volume confirmation. The latest red day on ordinary volume looks like a modest pullback rather than a sign of reversal.

2025-10-08.kline: After an early decline to a low near the left-third of the window, price rallies through most of the window in a series of higher highs and higher lows, with a few red pullbacks along the way. The latest close, a green candle, sits in the upper part of the range, near the window high but not clearly above the earlier highs, so this is an uptrend rather than a breakout.
2025-10-08.volume: Volume is contracting: the tallest bars cluster in the middle of the window, around the strong green rally days, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter. Up days (green) carried the heaviest volume, and the recent red and green bars at the right are lower than the earlier peaks.
2025-10-08.combined: Price is still rising, but it is doing so on falling volume, which suggests the uptrend is losing participation and conviction. The pattern remains an uptrend, though the shrinking volume is a caution that the rise may be running out of steam.

2025-10-09.kline: Price was choppy in the first half of the window, dipped to a low near the bottom of the range around the fourth bar, then climbed in a series of higher highs and lows. The final bar is a green candle that spikes to the top of the window, above the highs of the earlier part, so the latest close sits near the window high.
2025-10-09.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no clear surge, and the tallest bars occur on both up and down days in the earlier and middle sections. The most recent green bar has moderate volume, similar to the surrounding days, which matches the flat volume state.
2025-10-09.combined: The new high on a green day is not accompanied by a volume surge, so the breakout has weak volume confirmation. Traders would want to see higher volume on the breakout day or the next few sessions to confirm it.

2025-10-10.kline: Price rises across most of the 20-day window, from low candles on the left to high candles on the right, with several pullbacks along the way, such as the red candles mid-window. The latest candle is a large red day that drops sharply from near the window high, but its close sits just above the midpoint of the range, in the upper part, so the uptrend is not broken.
2025-10-10.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction in the recent days compared with earlier. The tallest bar is the final red day, but it is comparable to the strongest green bars earlier, and the mix of green and red bars shows no clear trend in volume.
2025-10-10.combined: Rising prices on roughly even volume support the uptrend, but the sharp down day on the latest bar without a volume surge suggests a pullback rather than a confirmed reversal, so the picture is mixed and needs more confirmation.

2025-10-13.kline: Price climbs from the lower left of the window to the upper right, with the window high set by the tall wick near the right side. A sharp red pullback near the end takes price down to about the middle of the range, and the latest green candle recovers to the upper part of the range, so the rise is intact.
2025-10-13.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window with no sustained build-up. The tallest bar is a red day that matches the sharp drop near the end, and the most recent days are at moderate levels similar to earlier in the window.
2025-10-13.combined: The rising price path with a pullback that stays within the uptrend is not clearly supported by volume, since volume does not expand on the advance. The heavy-volume red day on the sharp decline adds some caution to the uptrend.

2025-10-14.kline: The window rises from a low near the left edge to a high near the right side, with pullbacks along the way, then turns sharply lower over the final few candles. The latest red candle closes in the lower half of the window range, having given back more than half of the late rise, so this reads as a top-reversal shape, though the decline is short.
2025-10-14.volume: Volume stays broadly similar across the window with no sustained build-up, so the flat state holds. The tallest bar is a red down day near the right side, which stands out, while the most recent bars are moderate and not clearly larger than earlier ones.
2025-10-14.combined: The sharp late sell-off is not backed by a clear volume surge, so the reversal signal is tentative. Confirmation would need several more down days on rising volume or a close back above the recent highs to invalidate it.

2025-10-15.kline: Price rises steadily for most of the window, from near the lower part of the range to a peak near the top, then reverses sharply over the last three to four days with long red candles. The latest close sits in the lower third of the range, below the midpoint, after giving back more than half of the rise; the shape is an inverted V rather than a breakdown below earlier lows.
2025-10-15.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained increase. The tallest bars appear early in the rally and on the sharp red day near the peak, while the latest red sessions show moderate volume similar to earlier days.
2025-10-15.combined: The rally came on mixed volume, and the decline is marked by one high-volume red day at the top, which suggests selling pressure emerging near the high. Because the volume increase is not sustained, the reversal signal is suggestive rather than fully confirmed.

2025-10-16.kline: Price rises steadily from the lower part of the window to a peak near the top of the range around the middle-right, then falls over several red candles, giving back roughly 60% of the rise. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, forming an inverted-V shape that suggests a reversal top.
2025-10-16.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no clear surge or drop in recent days. The tallest bars appear early in the window and near the peak, while the recent red down days show moderate, similar-sized bars, consistent with the flat volume state.
2025-10-16.combined: The price reversal lower is not backed by a volume surge, so the top looks tentative rather than strongly confirmed. Flat volume during the decline suggests selling pressure is steady but not accelerating.

2025-10-17.kline: The window rallies from a low near the middle-left into a sharp spike to the window high around the 16th day, then falls back through several red candles to a low near the lower-right area before a small green rebound. The rally was largely given back, and the latest close sits in the lower half of the range, so this looks like a rounded spike top followed by a decline.
2025-10-17.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no single day standing out dramatically. The largest bars appear early and near the mid-to-late window, and the recent red and green days carry volume close to the window average.
2025-10-17.combined: Flat volume during the rise and the decline gives little confirmation of the reversal, so the top is supported by price alone. The lack of heavier selling volume on the drop makes the decline less convincing.

2025-10-20.kline: Price rises from a low near the start of the window through a series of green candles to a peak near the top of the range, then drops sharply on a large red candle, giving back most of the rise. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, forming a rounded, inverted-V style top.
2025-10-20.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained increase in recent days. The tallest volume bar is a red day during the sharp sell-off near the peak, and the most recent bars are close to the earlier average.
2025-10-20.combined: The rally came on modest, mixed volume and the decline was marked by one heavy red day, so the top looks like distribution rather than a confirmed trend change. Flat recent volume gives little support to a new downtrend, so the reversal is suggestive but not yet strongly confirmed.

2025-10-21.kline: Price rises from a low near the start of the window to a peak near the window high around the middle-right, then falls over several sharp red days, giving back most of the rise into the lower half of the range (an inverted V shape). A small green bounce follows, but the latest red close sits in the lower half of the range, below the midpoint.
2025-10-21.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window with no sustained surge or drop. The biggest bars come on a tall green day early in the rise and on the red day at the peak, while the most recent sessions show moderate, similar-sized bars.
2025-10-21.combined: The rise-then-fall shape with a close in the lower half suggests a top, but flat volume means the selling pressure on the decline was not clearly stronger than earlier activity, so the reversal signal is only moderately supported.

2025-10-22.kline: Price climbs from the lower left to a peak near the top of the window, then drops sharply on one large red candle and stalls near the lower part of the range, forming an inverted V-shaped top. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, well below the peak, so the rise has been largely given back.
2025-10-22.volume: Volume stays broadly similar throughout the window, with no sustained rise or fall, though one tall red bar on the sharp sell-off day stands out. Up days (green) and down days (red) carry similar volume overall, with the largest bar on a down day.
2025-10-22.combined: The reversal lower is supported by price falling on a day of heavy volume, but otherwise flat volume gives only weak confirmation that the top has formed and selling pressure is sustained.

2025-10-23.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window to a sharp spike high about two-thirds of the way across, then falls over several days, with a large red candle breaking down through the middle of the range. The rightmost closes sit in the lower half of the range, giving back more than half of the rise, which forms an inverted-V shape.
2025-10-23.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The tallest bars cluster around the price spike and the sell-off in the middle of the window, and the recent red down days show moderate volume similar to earlier days.
2025-10-23.combined: The rise and fall with no clear volume expansion on the decline suggests the reversal lacks strong conviction, though the lower-half close still points to a top. Confirmation would need heavier volume on the down days or a follow-through lower.

2025-10-24.kline: The window starts with a multi-day rally that peaks near the upper end of the range around the 11th-12th candles, then a sharp multi-day fall with large red bodies drops to near the window low. The latter part shows a partial bounce, and the latest green candle closes in the lower half of the range, well below the peak, giving back roughly all of the earlier rise. This forms an inverted-V shape, a reversal top.
2025-10-24.volume: Volume is contracting: the early bars include tall spikes, notably a large red bar during the sharp peak-and-drop, while the most recent bars are noticeably shorter and cluster at moderate-to-low heights. The heaviest activity is concentrated around the peak and the initial sell-off, and the final days show lighter volume on both down and up days.
2025-10-24.combined: The large volume during the peak and sharp decline supports the reversal from the top, but the shrinking volume in the recent bounce suggests weak buying interest and a lack of conviction in the recovery. Lower volume on the latest up candle means the bounce is not yet confirmed as a new uptrend.

2025-10-27.kline: Price falls from a tall spike near the window high through several red days to lows in the lower part of the range, then rises over the last few green days to finish near the upper part of the range, forming a V-shaped bottom. The latest close sits in the upper half of the range but below the earlier spike high.
2025-10-27.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no clear expansion or contraction. The largest bars come early on the red spike and the red selloff days, while the recent green up days carry moderate volume similar to earlier levels.
2025-10-27.combined: The rebound on recent green days is not supported by rising volume, so the recovery looks less convincing than a V-shaped bottom on heavy volume would. The reversal is plausible but unconfirmed until volume picks up on the up days.

2025-10-28.kline: After a decline from the early highs down to a low zone in the middle of the window, price stages a sharp two-to-three-day rally of green candles, with the final long green candle closing near the window high and above the earlier highs, so price leaves the prior range upward.
2025-10-28.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge; the bars are mixed red and green at similar heights, though the last green up day is one of the taller bars.
2025-10-28.combined: The upside close above the earlier highs is a breakout, but volume is not expanding to confirm it, so the move is less convincing than a breakout on rising volume.

2025-10-29.kline: After dropping from mid-range to a cluster of lows near the bottom third of the window, price rallied through several green candles and the final day gapped up to the top of the range, clearing the highs of the earlier window. The latest close sits near the window high, though the candle itself closed below its open.
2025-10-29.volume: Volume is roughly level across the window, with no sustained increase; the earlier spike on the large red drop day and the taller bars in the final days are not part of a broad surge, and the most recent bar is only the largest of the recent set. Up days and down days carry similar volume overall, so the volume chart does not show a clear buying push.
2025-10-29.combined: The final-day jump above prior highs is a breakout, but volume is flat rather than expanding, so the move has weaker confirmation. Follow-through over the next sessions on higher volume would be needed to validate it.

2025-10-30.kline: The window starts with choppy, mostly lower prices and a sideways stretch with large red candles in the lower-middle range. The last five or so days show a sharp rally of large green candles that closes well above the earlier highs in the window, so the price leaves the prior range upward. The latest candle is a red day with a high near the window top, and its close sits in the upper part of the range.
2025-10-30.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early days are moderate, while the rally days carry clearly larger bars. The tallest bar is near the end, on a red day, and the green up days in the rally also show elevated volume, with a few quieter green and red days in the middle.
2025-10-30.combined: Rising prices on rising volume support the breakout above the earlier range. The large red day at the end on high volume hints at some selling into the spike, so the breakout still needs follow-through to be fully confirmed.

2025-10-31.kline: Price fell from the middle of the window to a low near the bottom around the middle-late days, then rallied in a V-shaped recovery with a large green candle near the top, followed by a spike high at the window top and a pullback; the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, below the spike high.
2025-10-31.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early and middle sessions are moderate, while the most recent sessions show the tallest bars, including a very large green bar near the window high and a large red bar right after it.
2025-10-31.combined: The V-shaped recovery with its latest close in the upper half, backed by expanding volume on the rally and the spike, suggests a bottom reversal is underway, though the sharp red pullback on heavy volume shows sellers are active near the highs.

2025-11-03.kline: After a decline from the early-window highs to a low around the middle-left of the window, price rallied sharply with a tall green candle, then the last three sessions closed well above the early-window highs, with the latest close near the top of the range. The move resembles a V-shaped recovery that has broken out of the earlier range.
2025-11-03.volume: Volume expands over the window: early bars are moderate, volume dips in the decline, then the rally days and the last several sessions show the tallest bars, with the two most recent sessions near the window's volume peak. Up (green) days in the rally carry noticeably higher volume than the red days before them.
2025-11-03.combined: Rising price on rising volume, with the latest closes above the earlier highs, supports a confirmed upside breakout from the prior range.

2025-11-04.kline: The window opens mid-range, drifts down over several red candles to a low near the middle-left of the window, then rallies over several days with a large green candle to a high at the window's top. The latest candle is a red pullback that closes in the upper half of the range, roughly halfway-plus up from the low, having recovered more than half of the earlier decline in a V-shaped path.
2025-11-04.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained expansion or contraction. Large red bars appear in the early and middle decline, the tallest bars cluster around the rally peak, and the final days show steady mid-to-high bars that do not clearly exceed earlier levels.
2025-11-04.combined: The V-shaped recovery with the close in the upper half suggests a bottoming attempt, but flat volume gives the rally little conviction. Because volume did not expand on the advance, the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2025-11-05.kline: Price dips to a low near the lower-middle of the window, rallies over several green days into a sharp peak near the window high, then falls back over the last five or so sessions, giving back roughly half the rise. The latest close sits in the lower half of the range, forming an inverted-V shape.
2025-11-05.volume: Volume is roughly flat overall: the tallest bars come from the early red sell-off and the peak-area red day, while green rally days show moderate volume and the most recent red days stay at a steady, mid-level pace without a clear rise or drop.
2025-11-05.combined: Rising green-day volume during the rally followed by steady red-day volume on the decline suggests the advance has lost momentum, but the flat volume gives only moderate confirmation of a top, so the reversal signal is not strongly backed by volume.

2025-11-06.kline: Price fell to a low base in the first third of the window, then rallied in several green days to a sharp peak near the window high around the 14th-15th bar. A multi-day decline followed, giving back most of that rally, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, near the lower third. This forms an inverted V shape.
2025-11-06.volume: Volume stays roughly even across the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off in the latest days. The tallest bar lines up with the peak day, and the later red down days carry volume similar to the earlier bars.
2025-11-06.combined: The rally was followed by a multi-day decline that gave back most of the gains, which supports a top, but the flat volume means there is no clear volume-driven confirmation of the reversal.

2025-11-07.kline: Price rallied sharply from the lower-middle of the window through a series of green candles, peaking near the window high, then fell over several days in a steep run of red candles that gave back most of the gain. The latest candle is a small green body sitting near the bottom of the range, so the close is in the lower part of the window, forming an inverted V top.
2025-11-07.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with the latest sessions running at about the same level as earlier days. The tallest bars cluster around the strong green rally days and the first big red decline days, while the most recent bars are no larger than the earlier ones.
2025-11-07.combined: The rally and the subsequent sell-off both occurred on similar volume, so the volume does not strongly confirm either move. The inverted-V price shape stands, but without a volume surge on the decline the reversal is not strongly confirmed.

2025-11-10.kline: Price was flat near the window's lower-left, then rallied sharply to a peak in the upper part of the range around the 12th to 14th bars (an inverted-V shape), followed by a multi-day decline of red candles that fell back to the window's low near the 18th bar. The last bar is a green bounce that sits roughly at the midpoint of the range, so the latest close is only slightly above halfway.
2025-11-10.volume: Volume is flat across the window, with no sustained surge or fade: the tallest bars cluster on the rally and early decline, and the most recent green bars are moderate, about the same as earlier in the window. Red down days carry volume comparable to the green up days.
2025-11-10.combined: Price gave back the whole rally on steady, non-dwindling volume, which points to distribution after the peak rather than a healthy pullback. The last green bounce on unchanged volume is not strong enough yet to confirm a reversal back up, so the top pattern stands.

2025-11-11.kline: Price starts near the lower part of the window, rises over several days with a large green candle to a peak near the window high, then falls over several days, giving back roughly half or more of the rise. The latest red close sits just below the middle of the range, forming an inverted-V shape.
2025-11-11.volume: Volume is fairly steady across the window, consistent with the flat state. The biggest bars come on the green rally days and the peak days, while the later red decline days stay at moderate levels rather than fading to near zero.
2025-11-11.combined: Heavy volume on the up-moves followed by sustained, not fading, volume on the down-moves suggests sellers are active, but the lack of a clear volume surge on the decline leaves the top reversal only moderately confirmed.

2025-11-12.kline: After a quiet, low-range start, price rallies sharply on large green candles to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over several days on large red candles, with a long lower wick near the window low. The rally is largely given back, and the latest close sits around the middle of the range, slightly below it, after a modest bounce, so this reads as a rise followed by a fall (an inverted-V style top).
2025-11-12.volume: Volume is flat overall: the biggest bars come during the rally peak and the first part of the decline, while the most recent days are roughly in line with the earlier window, with no clear drying up or surge at the end. Up days and down days carry similar volume, with the strongest spikes on red days near the top.
2025-11-12.combined: Heavy volume on the rally and on the early selling is consistent with a top forming, but the flat volume at the end does not show strong conviction in the latest bounce. The price reversal is more convincing than the volume pattern, so the top is plausible but not strongly confirmed.

2025-11-13.kline: Price rallies from the lower-middle of the window to a peak near the window high around the 10th-11th sessions, forming an inverted-V shape with a large green candle on the rise. It then falls over the following 8-9 sessions, giving back most of the rise, and the latest red candle closes near the window low, in the lower part of the range.
2025-11-13.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with a few taller bars around the rally peak and the big red decline days but no sustained surge or fade. Up days (green) and down days (red) show similar volume levels, with the latest red bar only moderate.
2025-11-13.combined: The price path shows a topping rise and a sell-off that retraces most of the gain, but volume stays about the same throughout, so the decline is not backed by a clear volume surge and the reversal signal is only moderately confirmed.

2025-11-14.kline: Price rallied from near the window low to a peak near the top of the range about two-thirds of the way through the window, then fell back nearly all the way to the lows over roughly ten days, forming a rounded, inverted-V style top. The latest close sits in the lower part of the range, close to the window low.
2025-11-14.volume: Volume is flat, as the state says: the recent bars are about the same height as earlier in the window, with no clear surge. The tallest bars came during the mid-window rally (a large green day and a very large red day at the top), and the recent red and green bars stay at moderate levels.
2025-11-14.combined: The decline unfolded mostly on red days without a volume surge, so the selling lacks strong conviction. Heavy volume on the rally and at the top, combined with a fall that gave back the whole rise, supports a topping pattern, though the flat recent volume leaves the reversal only moderately confirmed.

2025-11-17.kline: Price starts near the bottom-left of the window, climbs through several green days, and peaks in an inverted-V rally near the window high around the middle-right. It then falls over many days, giving back most of the rally, and the latest small green candle closes in the lower half of the range, so this is a reversal top.
2025-11-17.volume: Volume is flat overall, with no sustained surge or fade into the latest days. The tallest bars cluster during the early rally, the middle of the window runs at a steady mid-level, and the most recent bars are moderate and similar to earlier levels.
2025-11-17.combined: Heavy volume on the up days of the rally followed by steady, non-expanding volume on the decline suggests the rise is losing momentum and the decline is not accelerating, so the reversal top is plausible but not strongly confirmed by volume.

2025-11-18.kline: Price rises from the lower left of the window to a peak near the upper part of the range about two-thirds of the way across, forming an inverted V with several sustained up days. A multi-day decline follows through mostly red candles, giving back most of the rise, and the latest close sits near the lower part of the range.
2025-11-18.volume: Volume is about the same across the window, with the tallest bars in the early-to-middle stretch around the rally peak and similar-sized bars in the recent days. Green up days and red down days are mixed in the latest stretch, without a clear surge or drop-off.
2025-11-18.combined: The price path points to a top, but the flat volume gives no sign of heavy selling pressure or buying exhaustion, so the reversal is not strongly confirmed by volume.

2025-11-19.kline: Price rises for about eight days from low green candles to a peak near the top of the window, then falls over the remaining days, giving back most of the rise. The shape is an inverted V with the latest close in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2025-11-19.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with the tallest bars early on during the rise and around the peak, and similar-sized bars during the later decline. Recent days are about the same size as earlier ones, so the volume chart shows no clear surge or fade.
2025-11-19.combined: Flat volume gives little confirmation for the top: the rise and the decline both trade at similar activity, so the reversal signal rests mainly on the price shape rather than on volume expansion.

2025-11-20.kline: After a brief early rise to a high near the top of the range, price fell across most of the window, with lower highs and lower lows. The latest red candle closes near the bottom of the range after a sharp final drop, so the pattern is a downtrend.
2025-11-20.volume: Volume is roughly even across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish. The final red day is the tallest bar, but it is only modestly above earlier levels, so there is no clear volume surge.
2025-11-20.combined: Falling prices on steady volume point to a persistent downtrend, but the lack of a volume expansion on the final drop gives little extra conviction that the selling is accelerating.

2025-11-21.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, with a few green bounces along the way, making lower highs and lower lows. The window high sits near the left side, and the latest red close is near the bottom of the range after a long red candle at the far right.
2025-11-21.volume: Volume stays roughly level across the window, consistent with the flat volume state, with bars of similar height from left to right. The last few red bars reach somewhat higher than the mid-window bars, but not enough to mark a clear volume surge.
2025-11-21.combined: Steady selling with broadly unchanged volume suggests the decline is persistent rather than driven by a sudden burst of selling pressure, so the downtrend is intact but not confirmed by a volume climax.

2025-11-24.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range with a green candle and then stepping lower through a series of red candles with small green bounces. The lowest area sits near the right-hand third, where a long red candle with a long lower wick marks the low, and the latest candle is a green bounce closing in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2025-11-24.volume: Volume expands toward the end of the window, with the tallest bars appearing in the last four or five sessions, including the large red selloff day and the latest green day. Early volume is more mixed, with the first two bars tall and the middle of the window quieter.
2025-11-24.combined: Heavy volume on the late red down days confirms persistent selling pressure behind the downtrend. The latest green day on high volume is a notable bounce, but it does not yet reclaim prior range levels, so it reads as a relief rally within the decline rather than a reversal.

2025-11-25.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from a high near the top-left, with a few green bounces along the way, including a sizable red candle near the end. The latest green candle sits in the lower part of the range, close to the window low, so the decline is still in control.
2025-11-25.volume: Volume expands over the window: the early bars are moderate, and the most recent sessions show the tallest bars, including a large green day at the far right and tall red days just before it. Heavier volume on the recent down days matches the falling price.
2025-11-25.combined: Price has been falling while volume grows, which supports continued selling pressure and the downtrend. The higher-volume green bars at the end suggest some buying interest near the lows, but they have not yet reversed the trend.

2025-11-26.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window from near the top of the range toward the bottom, with a sharp red bar mid-window and a few green bounces that fail to recover the prior highs. The latest closes sit in the lower part of the range, near the window low, so the pattern is a downtrend.
2025-11-26.volume: Volume is expanding: the earlier window is mostly modest red-day volume, while the last several days show much taller bars, including the two largest volume spikes near the right side. Several of the high-volume days are red down days, with green up days showing mixed volume.
2025-11-26.combined: Heavier volume on falling prices confirms selling pressure and supports the downtrend continuing, though the rising volume on green days shows some buying interest at lower levels.

2025-11-28.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from near the top of the range at the start to the lower part by the latest session, with a few green bounces along the way, such as a small rally in the middle and a brief bounce near the end. The window high is at the left edge, the window low sits near the right side, and the latest close is in the lower part of the range, so no breakdown or reversal is clear.
2025-11-28.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with bars of similar height from start to finish. The tallest bars come on several red down days in the middle and late part of the window, while the most recent bar is short, so there is no volume surge into the latest decline.
2025-11-28.combined: Falling prices on roughly unchanged volume suggest a steady downtrend without strong conviction or capitulation from sellers. The lack of a volume spike on the latest move means it does not confirm a reversal or a breakdown.

2025-12-01.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range at the left to lows near the bottom on the right, with a brief green rally in the middle and small green bounces near the end. The latest close is a green candle in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2025-12-01.volume: Volume stays roughly flat across the window, with no sustained rise or fall in the most recent days. The tallest bars sit in the middle of the window on red down days, and the most recent green up day is moderate rather than a clear surge.
2025-12-01.combined: Price is still in a downtrend, and the flat volume gives no sign of a reversal or breakout. The recent green bounce on ordinary volume looks like a small relief rally rather than a change in direction.

2025-12-02.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the chart to a close in the lower part of the range, with several green bounces along the way that do not reverse the decline. The window high sits near the start and the window low is near the most recent days, and the latest red candle closes in the lower quarter of the range.
2025-12-02.volume: Volume stays roughly flat overall, with no sustained rise or fall as the window progresses. The tallest bars cluster in the middle of the window on red down days, while recent bars are moderate and similar in size to earlier ones, and the most recent day is not a standout.
2025-12-02.combined: The falling price with no volume expansion suggests the decline is persistent but not accelerating on heavy selling. Flat volume alongside lower highs and lows fits a steady downtrend rather than a capitulation or a reversal.

2025-12-03.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, starting near the top of the range and dropping toward the lower part with a few green bounces along the way. A large red candle near the middle-right marks a sharp drop, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range, well below the window high.
2025-12-03.volume: Volume contracts over the window: the largest red bars cluster around the middle-to-late sessions, while the most recent bars are visibly smaller. Recent down days carry less volume than the heavy selling days earlier in the window.
2025-12-03.combined: Falling prices with fading volume suggest the downtrend is losing momentum rather than accelerating, but there is no sign yet of a reversal or breakout. The pattern remains a downtrend unless price recovers on rising volume.

2025-12-04.kline: Price falls across most of the 20-day window, from a high near the top of the range on the left to lows near the bottom around the middle-right, with several sharp red candles and only brief green bounces along the way. The latest close is a green candle sitting in the lower half of the range, about 40-45% up from the window low, so the window reads as a downtrend with bounces rather than a reversal.
2025-12-04.volume: Volume contracts: the tallest bars cluster in the earlier and middle part of the window, around the large red down days, while the most recent bars are visibly shorter. The last several days show lower, fairly even volume, and the down days are not especially heavy.
2025-12-04.combined: Price continuing lower on shrinking volume suggests selling pressure is fading rather than accelerating, so the downtrend is losing momentum but no reversal is confirmed yet. The green latest close on modest volume is a weak bounce that needs follow-through on higher volume to signal a turn.

2025-12-05.kline: The window opens near the upper part of the range, spikes briefly to the window high, then falls across most of the 20 days to a low near the window bottom around the middle-to-late section. A modest rebound follows, but the latest red candle closes in the lower half of the range, about 60% of the way down from the high.
2025-12-05.volume: Volume is contracting, with the tallest red and green bars clustered in the early-to-middle part of the window, around the sell-off and the big down candles. The most recent sessions show shorter bars than those peaks, and recent up and down days are of similar, moderate size.
2025-12-05.combined: Falling prices on fading volume suggest the selling pressure is easing, but the latest close is still in the lower half and there is no volume-confirmed upturn, so the downtrend has not clearly reversed.

2025-12-08.kline: Price opens near the window high, falls for about 11 days with a large red bar near the middle, and bottoms near the 12th-13th bars, close to the window low. It then rebounds through several green candles, recovering roughly half of the decline, with the latest close around the middle to upper-middle of the range, forming a rough V-shaped double-bottom-like reversal.
2025-12-08.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window, with no sustained surge or drop in recent days. The tallest bars sit around the sell-off near the middle of the window, mostly on red down days, while the recovery days show similar or moderate volume.
2025-12-08.combined: The rebound from the low is not backed by a clear rise in volume, so the reversal is only partly confirmed. Heavy volume on the decline and steady volume on the recovery suggest the bounce may need stronger buying to establish a true bottom.

2025-12-09.kline: The window starts near the top of the range, falls over several sessions to a sharp red spike down that sets the window low near the bottom, and then rallies over the last several days in a V-shaped recovery. The latest close sits near the upper-middle of the range, having recovered roughly half of the prior decline, which fits a reversal from the bottom rather than a breakout.
2025-12-09.volume: Volume was heavy during the sell-off, peaking on the large red down days near the low, with a strong green day during the early rebound. Volume then tapered through the recovery, and the most recent bars are clearly smaller than the earlier peaks, consistent with contracting volume.
2025-12-09.combined: The price recovery is occurring on fading volume, so the bottom reversal is less convincingly confirmed than it would be on expanding volume. The pattern still points to a bottoming attempt, but buyers' conviction appears to be waning as the rally matures.

2025-12-10.kline: Price spikes to the window high around the 7th day, then falls over several days to a low near the lower-middle of the range (roughly the 12th day), forming a V-shaped bottom. It then recovers over the last 8 days with mostly green candles, and the latest close sits in the upper-middle part of the range, having recovered roughly half of the drop.
2025-12-10.volume: Volume is contracting: the heaviest bars cluster around the spike and selloff days in the middle of the window, while the final days show visibly shorter bars, with the most recent volume clearly below the earlier peaks.
2025-12-10.combined: The recovery from the low is occurring on fading volume, so the rebound lacks strong participation and the bottom is not yet confirmed by heavy buying. The reversal signal is tentative until price holds its gains on rising volume.

2025-12-11.kline: The window opens near the top of the range, then a sharp multi-day decline with a long red candle drives price down to near the window low around the middle of the window. Price then recovers in a choppy rise over the last several sessions, and the latest close sits in the upper half of the range, about halfway to two-thirds up from the low, so the recovery fits a rounded bottom after a V-shaped drop.
2025-12-11.volume: Volume was heavy during the initial selloff, with the tallest red bars early in the window, and it contracts steadily afterward. The most recent sessions show clearly lower bars than the early window, with mixed green and red days of modest size.
2025-12-11.combined: The rebound is occurring on shrinking volume, so the recovery lacks the conviction that would confirm a durable reversal. Price has regained a meaningful part of the decline, but the falling volume suggests the bounce may stall unless buying picks up.

2025-12-12.kline: Price opens the window near the upper part of the range, with a tall red candle dropping sharply from the window high area to a low near the bottom of the range. After that, price mostly falls with several green bounces, and the latest red candle closes near the lower part of the range, close to the window low.
2025-12-12.volume: Volume is roughly flat across the window: the tallest bars are red sell-off days in the early-middle section, while the most recent days are similar in height to earlier bars and show no clear surge or drying up. Up and down days are mixed in size, with no single day standing out in the final stretch.
2025-12-12.combined: Price falling toward the lower part of the range on steady, unremarkable volume suggests a gradual downtrend without strong conviction from either buyers or sellers. The lack of a volume spike on the latest down days means there is no clear confirmation of a fresh breakdown.

2025-12-15.kline: Price opens the window with a spike to the top of the range, then falls sharply on a tall red day and drifts lower with choppy bounces in between. The window low is near the bottom of the range, and the latest close sits in the lower part of the range after a final red day, so the overall pattern is a downtrend.
2025-12-15.volume: Volume is flat: the early red bars near the top of the chart are the tallest, and the recent bars are of similar height, showing no clear surge or drop. Up (green) and down (red) days both appear at similar volume levels across the window.
2025-12-15.combined: The falling price with no volume expansion suggests the decline lacks strong conviction from either buyers or sellers, so the downtrend is not clearly confirmed by volume.

2025-12-16.kline: Price starts near the middle of the range, spikes to the window high with a tall red candle early on, then falls across most of the window with a long red decline and wicks reaching the window low in the middle-to-late section. A small rebound with several green candles at the end leaves the latest close in the lower part of the range, well below the early highs.
2025-12-16.volume: Volume is flat: the early bars are the tallest, the middle bars are moderate, and the most recent bars are roughly the same size as earlier ones, with no clear surge or drying up. Up (green) and down (red) days both carry similar volume, so no single day stands out strongly.
2025-12-16.combined: The falling price path on steady, unremarkable volume supports a persistent downtrend without signs of a capitulation or a strong accumulation; the late green bounce on flat volume is weak evidence of a pause rather than a reversal.

2025-12-17.kline: Price opens the window mid-range, spikes up on a long-wicked candle near the top, then falls over most of the window with only small bounces, and the latest red candle sits near the window low in the lower part of the range. It does not clearly close below the earlier lows, so this is a downtrend rather than a breakdown.
2025-12-17.volume: Volume is flat: the tallest bars cluster in the first few days, but the recent bars are roughly similar in height to the middle of the window, with no clear surge in the latest sessions. Red and green bars are mixed, with the latest down day showing moderate rather than heavy volume.
2025-12-17.combined: Falling prices on steady, unremarkable volume suggest a persistent but unforced decline without a volume climax or signs of capitulation. The lack of a volume surge on the latest down move gives no confirmation of an accelerating breakdown.

2025-12-18.kline: Price opens the window near the high after a very large red candle, then drifts lower with choppy trading, rallies over several days from the middle-lower area to a peak in the upper part of the range, and then falls over the last several sessions. The fall gives back more than half of the rally, and the latest small green candle closes in the lower part of the range, near the window low, forming an inverted-V shape.
2025-12-18.volume: Volume stays about the same throughout the window, with no sustained surge or drop-off. The early red bars are tall, the mid-window green bars are moderate, and the most recent sessions show mixed moderate bars, including a taller red bar near the end.
2025-12-18.combined: The rally and the subsequent decline occurred without a clear volume expansion, so the volume does not strongly confirm either move. The lack of heavy volume on the late decline gives the reversal only modest support.
